tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༈bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi chos sde'i them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gas
༈bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi chos sde'i them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gas

tei:div.tei:p: ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi chos sde'i them byang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /pad+ma sbas tshal las byon zhi khro rmad/ /na raka dong sprugs chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de yang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni yi dam bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rtsa ba'i chos sde las 'phros pa'i zhi khro na raka dongs sprugs kyi sgrub skor yin no/ /de'ang rab 'byams zhi dang khro bo ma lus pa yongs su 'dus pa'i sgrub sde rtsa ba lta bu yin te/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ khyad par lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mtha' med 'khor ba'i sems can las ngan rigs: mi dge'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zad mtha' med: rigs drug gang yang duḥkha'i rang bzhin nyid: mi bzod srid pa'i me 'obs dong chen du: lhung ste yun ring mnar med myong ba rnams: mthong thos dran rig thugs rje lcags kyu yis: bzod glags med par snying rje'i rtsal phyung bas: brtse chen rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'dren pa'i thabs: na raka dong sprugs cho ga 'di kho na: cho ga'i gsal 'debs tshig tsam thos pas grol: dkyil 'khor ngo sprod rgyud tsam mthong bas grol: bskyed rdzogs gnas lugs don tsam bsgoms pas grol: gzungs sngags snying po lus la btags na grol: byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i ro bcud myong tsam grol: theg chen lta ba'i dgongs pa gtad tsam grol: 'khor 'das chos sku'i rang bzhin ye nas grol: 'di ni thog ma'i kun bzang dgongs bzhed de: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas lam nyid rten 'brel gnad: sdig can btsan thabs mngon sangs rgyas pa'i chos: zhi khro 'dus pa'i cho ga 'di yin pas: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ grol ba drug ldan zab khyad rmad du byung ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la/

ka) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po/ kha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: kun bzang zhi ba'i sngon 'gro bla sgrub byin rlabs gter chen/ ga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: kun bzang zhi ba'i cho ga na raka dong sprugs kyi las byang thos grol bla med/ nga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ kun bzang zhi ba'i 'dzab bskul/ ca) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dkar gtor 'dod yon char 'bebs/ cha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi cho ga bla med snying po/ ja) bdud rtsi lag mchod/ nya) bum sgrub/ ta) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i phyag rabs dug lnga rang grol ye shes/ tha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i thun mong spyi'i bshags pa/ da) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i lta ba'i klong bshags ye shes zang thal/ na) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i smre bshags bag chags dbyings grol/ pa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i bskang mchod byin rlabs kyi pra khrid/ pha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i rgyud bskang ka dag rang grol/ ba) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i brda bskang chen mo/ ma) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil non las: zhi khro'i mar me'i smon lam ye shes rab 'bar/ tsa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i bar do drug gi rtsa tho/ tsha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i bar do'i thos grol/ dza) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i chos spyod na raka mtsho skem/ wa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gter bdag gter srung kyi las byang dregs dpung nag po dgra snying dmar 'byin/

zha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gshin po rjes 'dzin mkha' spyod myur lam/ za) zhi khro na raka dong sprugs las/ gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga bklag chog tu bkod pa 'brel tshad rang grol/ 'a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i las mtha' gshin po'i sbyin sreg ya) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi/ zhi khro'i las mtha' gshin po'i sbyin sreg gi zin bris sngon med gsar du bskrun pa thugs rje lcags kyu'i lde mig ra) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi zin bris 'don sgrigs/ la) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi las tshogs snang brgyad kyi cho ga lha 'dre dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ sha) phyag rgya chen po ye shes mthong grol las: bdun tshig gnas lung gi cho ga ye shes 'od phung*/ bcas da lam rnyed son byung rigs chos tshan bzhugs so/ /slar smras pa/ pad+ma'i bka' srol sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyi/ /bcud phul gsang ba zil gnon chos sde che'i/ /cha lag zhi khro na raka dong sprugs zhes/ /grol ba drug ldan ngo mtshar bla med zab/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/ /em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /

ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing*/ glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen 'gro ba kun grol bde gshegs snying po bzhugs so: bde gshegs ye shes kyi snying po zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: e maḥ kun mkhyen nyin mo'i byang chub klong chen pos: rang bzhin ltar khyab mgon po rigs kyi bdag: bstan gnyis 'od stong rab 'khyil rgya gar pa: mtshungs med rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang : zab yangs nam mkha' 'thug po'i gter khyim nas: kun gsal thugs rje'i 'phrul chen gzi 'od che: mi zad nar mar 'gro la g.yo byed pa: 'da' dka' ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyun bzang po: kun smin dbang gi shes rab mdzod chen bstan: gzhon nu dbyangs can mtsho rgyal sgeg mos zungs: rab 'byams 'dus sde'i shog ser dpe'u bris: bder gshegs mtha' yas kun grol klong du sbos: ma 'ongs kho bo'i zer gyi rnam rol ba: mtshan nyid dpag dka'i lung rigs rtsa gsum gling: rgyas mdzad mi pham mdzod 'dzin mgon der sprod: bka' yi rgya 'di gnyer cig legs ldan gzugs: chos can bdag med tha dad gtad pa'i rgya: ga ga me gha so ri li khi ti: shamatha/ny+yany+yany+ya: cha/kha/ghaghargya: ga/khadzab/ : : zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang bskur bya ba'i rim pa ni: mchod rdzas dgram pa dbang gi chas la sogs gang dgos rgyud bka' brgyad ltar lag len phra zhib byas nas dbang la 'jug: 'di ru pra khrid yig chung ma bgyis pa zur bkod du gsal: da ni snod ldan slob ma la bka' yi lung 'bog pa'am: bstan 'gro spyi'i chos sbyin ris su ma chad pa'i don brtson pa sogs dgos ched gang du mchis pa de la bskur ba ni:

slob ma thams cad me chus sbyangs te dag par bya: dang po dkyil 'khor sgrub khang shar sgo nas: phyag rgya dang bcas nas 'di skad zhu: hoḥ sgo ba chen pos dgongs su gsol: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: snod ldan bdag cag 'jug pa'i slad: lta bas rang rig 'char sgo phyes: sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams las kyi pho nya'i rigs: snod ngan ma rungs 'joms byed pa: ma dag srid 'khrul rab tu mthar: de bas khyed rnams snod ldan nam: phyi nas: hoḥ nged rnams dam tshig las 'phro can: mos gus dwang 'dun snod dang ldan: de phyir sgo skyong che rnams kyis: shes rab rang la sgo phyes 'tshal: mi 'da' rdo rje'i bkar gnas so: de nas ging dkar nag gis rdo thun brdeg cing bgegs bskrad: rol mo'i gdangs kyang drag tu bgyis: slob bu rnams rim gyis nang du zhugs shing: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan 'jug cing smin grol la: gnod pa'i log 'dren gang yin pa: phyung brdeg thun gyis tshar chod cig: om̐ kro ta kro ti hūm̐ hūm̐ ghṛ wa ging ka ra ya gnod byed 'byung po 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs tshogs raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas ging chen bco brgyad kyis thun brdeg cing dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bgegs bcom: gang phyir dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 'dir 'jug pa rnams bgegs bskrad pa dam tshig ma blang bar gdong gsar mi 'jug: de nas yol ba'i phyi nas las kyi slob dpon la zhu ba ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug pa'i phyir: dpa' bo chen po'i bka' stsal 'tshal: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni ka dag ye shes dbyings: bde gshegs zhi khro'i pho brang ste: khyed rnams snod mchog ldan lags na: khas longs bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: slob mas: kyaiḥ gsang sngags rlabs chen dkyil 'khor la:

mos pa'i bdag cag cis mi dad: skal ldan bdag la gnang bar stsol: phyin chad dam tshig srog ltar bzung: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga'i dar thag dpyangs la: slob ma rnams kyis 'ju zhing thar pa'i lam du 'khrid: rol mo dbyangs snyan btang zhing legs par bsu: e ma nga ni bde gshegs he ru kaḥ bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan 'jug phyir ye shes lam du shog: ma dag the tshom mchis rnams phyir dengs shig: om̐ ma ma ru tra shag pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces gral du 'god nas dam chu sbyin: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: 'thung zhing bsrungs pas dngos grub brnyes: ma bsrung nyams na dmyal bar ltung: de bas ma 'da' sa ma ya: om̐ na ra kan i dan+te swā hā: de nas slob ma rnams la dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du log 'dren bgegs tshogs bsrung ba'i phyir: sngags kyi rgya chings 'dogs pa ni: snying po lan brgyad bzlas shing srung skud la bstim: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su ṣa dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas pho'i lag pa g.yas mo'i lag pa g.yon du 'dogs pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bsten par bya ba dang: sgrub pa'i bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir: ye shes lnga yi gur khang gis: rten 'brel legs par sngags rgyas btab: om̐ om̐ om̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: tsakra tsakra ye swā hā: des snying po mi 'gyur bar brtan pa dang lus yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor du brtan pa'i phyir: gnas lngar: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ bris la: hūm̐: rten 'brel chen po rgyu yi mchog: rang byung lnga ldan pho brang du: phung po byin rlabs ston pa yi: sku lnga 'bras bu ye shes sgoms: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.ā tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes pa'i yi ge rin po che'i zhun khus byugs:

de nas ku sha gtad pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal ba rig 'dzin gyis: rtswa mchog 'di la gdan byas te: rten 'brel mngon 'byung brtag pa yis: kun kyang 'grub pas rdzas 'di zungs: om̐ sarba tri ṇa u ta dha ra swā hā: zhes pas bsnol thabs gtad: de nas rten 'brel brtag pa ni: maṇ+ḍal steng du rigs lnga bzhag pa'am ras bris dkyil 'khor zhig gi khar: so shing dor ba ni: bden tshig dang bcas te 'phang: de'i tshe skal ba dang ldan na so shing me tog gyen du phyogs par 'gyur: las dang mi ldan na so shing rang rang la mgo ldog par 'gyur: skal dang ldan par gyur na dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur: mi ldan na dkyil 'khor la bshags pa 'bung zhing tshogs 'khor btang: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la bzod gsol 'bul: de nas so shing 'phen pa ni: hūm̐: 'byung lnga dbang po'i so shing la: las 'phro ci mchis me tog brgyan: de ring rten 'brel 'byung gyur tshogs: bden tshig don bzhin rtags la phob: om̐ mu la dan+ta sa ma ye swā hā: so shing rten 'brel brtag pa gong bzhin la: rtswa mchog de dum bu gnyis bya zhing sngas kha dang mjug tu bzhag: nub mo seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis dkyil 'khor la mgo bstan nas gsol ba btab ste gnyid log: de nas sgrib sbyong sngon 'gro'i lung 'bog pa ni: hoḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor lha la bdag skyabs mchi: 'gro ba'i don phyir dbyings nas bzhengs: mos pa'i snying khar rtag tu bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: mya ngan mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor: dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo: de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni: hoḥ rang rig spyi bor nyi zla seng khri'i steng: bcom ldan rdor sems shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdog: rdo rjes bsnol thabs snyems ma yum dang sbyor: rdo rje'i skyil krung longs spyod phrin las rdzogs:

thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgya g.yas g.yon 'khor: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus ltem gyis gang: tshe rabs bag chags kun dag 'od lus bsgom: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la yaḥ sogs? badz+ri bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: hoḥ bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa dpal yon gyis: rab tu brgyan pa rig pa'i tshom bu 'di: kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ i daṃ gu ru maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rgyud ltar bya: dmigs pa ni: nub mor rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' gsal gdab cing: byol song bzhis khri btegs par bsam: mgo bo sngas khar btegs pa'i tshe: spyi bor zla ba dang hūm̐: rkang mthil nyi ma dang raṃ bcas bsgom: rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas raṃ la me sbar bas lus kun khyab: hūm̐ yig zhu nas me chen mched: phung po sgyu lus bag chags dang bcas pa tshig ste: snang stong 'ja' ltar gsal bar bsgom: de'i ngang la bzang ngan gyi 'phro mi mthud te nyal: rmi lam bzang rtags byung na las dang ldan zhing 'phro bzang ba'i brda: rmi lam ngan na las 'phro med pa'am: chos skyong gi 'khu ba yin pas: tshogs brgya tsam dang bshags tshan legs par ma byas na: dbang bskur bgyis kyang byin rlabs mi 'jug: des na rten 'brel rmi lam brtag pa yang shin tu gtso: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas zhag phyi ma'i skabs su dngos gzhi dbang la 'jug par byed pa ni: bgegs bskrad de srung 'khor bsgom: slob ma sagos dkar gyon zhing khrus bstsal te gral du 'khod: dri bzang gi dud pa btang zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: tshom bu dang bcas pa rgyas shing yid du 'ong ba dgod: oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐: gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi: oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐: phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab:

shar lus 'phags po: lho 'dzam bu gling: nub ba lang spyod: byang sgra mi snyan: shar du lus dang lus 'phags: lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan: nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro: byang du sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla: rin po che'i ri bo: dpag bsam gyi shing : 'dod 'jo'i ba: ma rmos pa'i lo tog: 'khor lo rin po che: nor bu rin po che: btsun mo rin po che: blon po rin po che: glang po rin po che: rta mchog rin po che: dmag dpon rin po che: gter chen po'i bum pa: sgeg pa ma: phreng ba ma: glu ma: gar ma: me tog ma: bdug spos ma: snang gsal ma: dri chab ma: nyi ma: zla ba: rin po che'i gdugs: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan: dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa: tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba bdag gzhan lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin dang ldan pa 'di nyid: mtshungs med 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum dang: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mchog gsum rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs khyad par bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: om̐ i daṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: 'di ni bla med byang chub chu: myang zhing dkyil 'khor srog ltar zungs: nyams na mnar med duḥkha myong: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya khaṃ i dan+te na ra kan: de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing slob mas: hoḥ rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: 'khor dang bcas la bdag lus kyi: dbang po'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul lags na: bdag cag 'jug smin gnang bar stsol: om̐ badz+ra bhi dho bi shwa maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: rdo rje slob dpon gyis:

hoḥ khyed rnams yang dag skal bar ldan: 'di ni 'da' ka rdo rje yi: dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar bla na med: gdung ba'i yid kyis 'dun pa bskyed: om̐ badz+ra tsit+ta ash+tsa t+t+ya hoḥ slob mas: hoḥ bla ma sangs rgyas nyid mchog rig: dam chos ye shes lnga ru myong: snying po dwangs ma'i srog ltar bsrung: dge dang smon 'dun mi 'bral gnas: bla mas: hoḥ khyed rnams snod ldan ya mtshan can: sngon dbang bag chags sad pa'i bu: bdag gis ngo sprod dal du 'jug: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs smin par bskur: om̐ ma hā a nu bhā wa ye swā hā: slob mas: hoḥ sa mkhan chen po 'gro ba'i mgon: bdag gi rab rib mun pa'i tshogs: deng 'dir gtso bos bsal bar stsol: de nas mig dar phye ba ni: gser thur ram dam tshig gi rdo rje thogs la: hoḥ nga ni ye shes sman pa'i rgyal: khyod kyi ma rig ling thog tshogs: shes rab lta ba'i thur mas bsal: phyin chad zang thal la gnas shog: om̐ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ thur mas mig dar bsal te slob mas mos pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas nas phyag 'tshal te: 'di skad zhu: kyaiḥ bla med gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'di: ya mtshan che ba'i pho brang ste: mjal bas spro zhing thugs drin bstsal: 'di don ngo sprod gnang bar stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: ye shes nam mkha'i mdzod dang ldan: ye nas rang byung lta ba'i klong: rang gsal ngo mtshar cher bstan no: om̐ dzñā na maṇ+ḍa la shū n+ya ta āt+ma ko3 haṃ: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bshad chen mo bya ba ni: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i pho brang chen po 'di: thog mar rlung lnga'i steng du chags pa ni: phung po lnga po gnas su dag pa'i brda: sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram rab tu brtan pa ni: ting 'dzin dbyings la 'gul bskyod med pa'i brda: bh+rūm̐ yig gnas gyur zhing rang byung shugs las grub pa ni: chos dbyings kyi bzhin mdangs la rang rtsal ma 'gags pa'i brda:

gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa ni: tshad med bzhi mngon du gyur pa'i brda: rin po che'i rtsig pa sna lnga ni: ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i brda: 'dod snam dmar po lha mos brgyan pa ni: tshogs drug sgyu mar rtogs pa'i brda: pha gu ser la drwa ba dkar ba ni: nyon mongs pa dag nas ma rig pa'i bdud bzhi bcom pa'i brda: shar bu bskyod cing mda' yab dkar ba ni: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: 'phan dar 'phyang zhing g.yer kha'i sgra sgrogs pa ni: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i sgra grags stong yin pa'i brda: ka ba brgyad dang ka zhu ldan pa ni: rnam par thar pa brgyad dang thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i brda: gdung ma bcu drug bres pa ni: stong nyid snying rje bcu drug dang ldan pa'i brda: mu men gyi dral lcam btags pa ni: rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnas su dag pa'i brda: thog steng thams cad brdal khyab tu phub pa ni: rim dgu'i lta ba ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: rta babs rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa ni: byang chub kyi lam bzhi mngon du gyur pa'i brda: ri dwags kyis chos sgra nyan pa ni: kun tu snang ba'i chos thams cad brdar bden pa'i brda: mthongs skar nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa ni: dbang po'i sgo dgu shar grol yin pa'i brda: chos 'khor bcu gsum la gdugs tog gis mdzes pa ni: rdo rje theg chen sa mchog rgyun gyi rtse mo yin pa'i brda: thog steng 'phan dang gdugs kyis brgyan pa ni: sna tshogs ma 'gags shing sgyu ma'i gar dang ldan pa'i brda: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa me ris bskor ba ni: phrin las bzhis mdzad pa so sor ston pa'i brda: gter bum chen po bzhi dang ldan pa ni: gnas lugs 'od gsal gyi dbyings nas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i brda: pho brang gi dbus su byol song bzhi dang nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan spel nas brtsegs pa ni: srid pa'i rgya mtsho skems shing ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i brda: de'i steng hūm̐ yig gnas gyur te thog ma'i mgon po chos sku kun bzang wal gyis gsal ba ni:

ka dag thig le chen por bya rtsol dang bral yang ye shes kyi rang rtsal ma 'gags pa'i brda: sku mdog mthing ga ru bzhugs pa ni: kun gzhi skye ba med pa'i brda: zhal ras 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa ni: snang srid kun la thugs rje snyoms par gnas pa'i brda: spyan gnyis zim bus phyogs bcur gshis lugs kyis gzigs pa ni: dbyings rig thugs la mtha' dbus bral ba'i brda: spyi bor 'od dang ldan zhing gtsug tor mtho ba ni: mkha' dbyings zhing khams ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: snyan gshog rgyas la snyan lam yangs pa ni: grags stong gi sgra rnams sgra tshig gcig la rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag cing mtheb mos srin rtsa mnan pa ni: ka dag gi dgongs pa gdod nas lhun grub tu gnas shing srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor rtsol med du gzhom pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa ni: lta ba khregs chod gcig la sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i brda: kun tu bzang mo dkar gsal gyis pang du 'khyud pa ni: chos rnams ngo sprod kyi brdar drang don phyi'i theg pa thams cad lam pho nya bgrod pa'i them skas mtshon byed rnams thabs la brten dgos pa'i brda'o: rang bzhin gsal stong yin cing byed las gnyis su med par ston pa ni: kun gzhi rang shar yin pas shes rab yum la dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bzhi'i mtshan nyid kun rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag gnyis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa ni: rang rig 'od gsal lhan cig skyes mos ye nas 'khyud te 'bral blag med pa'i brda: yab yum gyi zhal sbyor te rlung gi 'gro 'ong bsre ba ni: 'khor 'das gnyis med ro gcig tu ston pa'i brda: nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa ni: shes rab kyi ye shes ye nas bde stong dang ldan pa'i brda: mnyen cing lcug la 'jam pa ni: chags med bde ba chen por gnas shing khengs sems bral ba'i brda: zhabs gnyis sked la mdud thabs su 'khril ba ni:

phyag rgya drug gi 'khrul 'khor la skye med kyi gar thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i brda: bha ga rgyas shing nor bu'i tog gis bkag pa ni: gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī bde shas che zhing 'khrul 'khor bzhi'i rang rtsal gyis dga' ba mngon du phyung ste ye shes chen po mi rtog pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i brda: yum gyi sku la 'od zer cher 'bar ba ni: lhun grub dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs pa'i brda: kun tu bzang po'i spyi bo bde chen gyi pho brang klong du 'bar bar khrag 'thung lnga bcu bzhugs pa ni: spyi bo'i gnas su haṃ sprul sku'i zhing khams yin pas: bskyed rim rol pa'i khro tshogs sgyu ma'i sprul skur bzhengs pa'i brda: mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum shar ba ni: gsang ba sgra skad grags stong gi ngo bor gnyis med dbyings rig brda'i gar rang bzhin sgyur ba tsam yin pas: zung 'jug dag snang du gnas pa'i brda: thugs kar zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs gsal ba ni: dran rig kun gyi 'char sgo snying kha yin zhing kun gzhi la bde sdug dang bral ba'i phyir zhi bar mtshon pa'i brda: lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga gsal ba ni: rlung lnga'i rang bzhin rnam shes la gnas shing thog mar srid par 'jug kyang lte ba'i pho brang du chags: de'ang don la shes rab kyi rang rtsal chags med de tsaṇ+ḍa līr gnas pa'i brda: gsang bar phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs gsal ba ni: ye nas rang byung gi phur bu yin zhing: 'khor 'das kun gyi sgyu ma'i lam srid pa'i rdo rjer mtshon pa'i brda: 'khor yang phra men gyis bskor ba ni: mtshan mor rab rgyu 'tshogs pa'i dur khrod yin pas: las kyi ma mo gnas pa'i brda: sprul pa yang sprul zhi ba khro bo grangs med pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa ni: bskyed rim sgyu ma mkhan gyi khyad chos su mtshon pa'i brda: zhi ba'i lha rnams zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan mnyen lcug 'khril ba ni:

kun gzhi'i rig pa shes rab ma'i klong yin zhing : bu gsal stong 'dzin med kyi khye'u chung gzhon nu yon tan kun ldan gyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i brda: khro bo'i lha rnams rngam gshe gtum la dpa' ba'i stobs rtsal gyi shugs dang ldan pa ni: chos sku lhun grub rang byung bde chen rgyal po 'khor 'das kun la dbang bsgyur nus shing thugs rje'i rtsal dang nus shugs: byin rlabs kyi stobs: gzi byin gyi rngam: zil gnon gyi gtum: kun 'dus kyi mthu chen po ste nyon mongs pa'i tshogs rnams bde stong rol pa'i he ru kas rab tu gshe ba'i brda: gdan yang byol song ni 'khor 'das gnyis su med pa'i brda: pad+ma ni skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brda: nyi ma ni rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i brda: zla ba ni dri ma med pa'i brda: bam ro ni bdag 'dzin gyi ru tra bsgral ba'i brda: dbugs song zhing drod dang ma bral ba ni: chos thams cad dngos po dang mtshan nyid brjod bya mtha' las 'das pa'i brda: zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'ja' 'od lug gu rgyud du gtibs pa ni: ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: khro bo'i tshogs rnams me 'od 'khrugs pa ni: shes bya'i bud shing gdod ma nas bsregs pa'i brda: sngags rnams skye med kyi sgra sgrogs pa ni: rlung 'byung 'jug thams cad rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin pa'i brda: srog yig mi 'gul zhing sngags rnams 'khor ba ni: chos sku la g.yo 'gul med cing mtha' dbus dang bral yang: rang rtsal ma 'gags pa'i ngo bo kun tu rgyu zhing snyoms par mi sdod pa'i brda: sngags sgra ring ba dang thung ba dgos pa ni: ye shes kyi rlung dang nyon mongs kyi rlung zung 'jug tu gnas pas 'phar bskyed che chung gi brda: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' ru mchod pa sna tshogs bkram pa ni: rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dang 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs don gnyis zung 'jug tu rdzogs pa'i brda:

drwa ba dang : ral gri: phur bu: me long : mda' dar: nyi zla: 'phan gdugs: cod pan: stag sham: rus rgyan rnams kyis brgyan zhing rdo rje la sogs pa kun tshang ba ni: zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde kun gyi 'byung gnas yin zhing kun rtog brgyad bcu'am nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por sgyu ma tsam du ston pa'i brda: de la sogs pa rang gzhung chen po 'dir so sor ngo sprad na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud lung sogs gnas kyang 'di nyid bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i ngo sprod ces bya ba yin pas: deng phyin chad pho brang dgu ldan spel sgrub brtson gsum byed du rung ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so:

zhes ngo sprod rgyas par bya: de nas dar tshon gang rung gi me tog dang tsam pa ka'i me tog sogs thog mar srin mdzub kyi bar du 'dzin nas: sgo skyong rnams dang dkyil 'khor rnams la bden tshig brjod pa ni: langs te: hoḥ che ba'i mchog dag 'gro ba'i mgon: bla med dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i gtso: rtsa gsum lha tshogs bdag la dgongs: bdag ni tshe rabs lha btsal lo: zhes dung dung gis brjod: de nas pho brang la bskor ba zhig brgyab nas: hoḥ shar phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: zhi zhing byams pa'i sgo phyes la: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ lho phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: rgyas shing snying rje'i sgo phyes la: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ rat+na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ nub phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: dbang dang dga' ba'i sgo phyes la: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ pad+ma pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ba sgo ma rnams: btang snyoms drag po'i sgo phyes la: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ karma pra be sha ya phaṭḥ hoḥ pho brang dkyil 'khor chen po yis: dbus su 'khod pa'i lha yi tshogs: bdag gi tshe rabs bsgrub pa yi: yi dam gang yin de dang sprod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dha ra a li kā li ye swā hā: zhes dkyil 'khor la me tog 'thor zhing lha gang la phog pa'i ming dang gsang mtshan sbyin: de nas cod pan spyi bor btags pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags phyir: sna lnga'i cod pan spyi bor brgyan: deng nas lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid: yang dag mchog reg 'dzin par gyis: oṃ gu ru bi dho dhe wa dha ra ni: u ta ra badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: de nas khyed ma 'ongs pa'i dus ming gang yin zer na: hoḥ sangs rgyas pad+ma'i snying po ye shes gsal byed bya ba'o: zhes lan du gdab: de nas phur pa gtad de: hoḥ bla med snying po'i gsang phur 'di: yang dag dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i phyir:

phrin las lnga'i rten du 'chang : deng nas srog ltar sgrub brtson zungs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya a nu ta ra maṇ+ḍa la ghan+dha hūm̐: de nas me tog 'thor zhing: hūm̐: tshe rabs las sad smon lam ldan: deng 'dir zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: yi dam lha dang skal par mnyam: nam yang de dag la gnas shog: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ye su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra satwaṃ: de nas shes bya'i bag chags rang rgyud la ma dag pa rnams sbyangs shing dag pa ye shes su 'char ba'i phyir: yi dam lha'i bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: bsang chu 'thor zhing: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad ye shes zang thal rgya yan lhun grub tu gnas pa: de'i rang dbyings kyi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma a las zla ba ste: gdan sum brtsegs spel ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig mthing ga nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs dang ldan pa: de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod sprin spros: tshur 'dus pas rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo: bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing 'od baiḍūr+ya'i mdangs dang ldan pa: zhal rab tu 'dzum la thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs pa: dbu'i gtsug tor mtho zhing nor bu ltar 'phags pa: phyag gnyis rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis mnyam par bzhag cing: zhabs bde stong skyil mo krung gis 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa: de'i pang du dbyings phyug kun tu bzang mo sku mdog dkar gsal shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdangs bzang ltar cher 'bar zhing mdzes 'dzum chags pa: phyag gnyis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing: zhabs gnyis zung 'jug sked la 'khril ba: mkha' gsang ye shes kyi phyag rgyas bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha tshogs bskul ba'o:

chos sku kun tu bzang po'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor 'bar ba khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs: mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor dag pa rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs: gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lor phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs: ba spu'i bu ga rnams su sprul pa dang nyid sprul zhi ba dang khro bo nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'khrigs pa: zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams gsal 'tsher mdzes pa: khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams sgeg bzhad dgyes la rngam pa: de ltar bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs thams cad 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i klong du ye shes gar dgu rol pa'i cho 'phrul dang bcas te gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar swāḥ gsang bar hāḥ ste sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas: rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: de nas rol mo bya zhing spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen du: rang snang ma 'gags rtsal bcu'i pho brang nas: bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i klong yangs shugs kyis gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir dbang bskur stsol la byin chen phob: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes pas rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor bzhag ste brtan par bya: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku'i bla ma dbyings nas gshegs: āḥ rtog med rang byung gdan la bzhugs: om̐ gnyis med sprul sku la phyag 'tshal: hrīḥ phyi nang yid spyod mchod pa 'bul:

hoḥ lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa bshags: trāṃḥ chos 'khor bskor zhing dbang bskur stsol: de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing dngos gzhi dbang la 'jug pa ni: ngo sprod cing dang po bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med bum pa ru: bla med dam tshig bdud rtsis bkang: skal ldan spyi bor bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: gnyis pa gsung gi dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod cing bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: lhun grub rang byung bhan+dha ru: sku lnga ye shes rdzas kyis bkang: skal ldan mgrin par bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: gsum pa thugs kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod cing shel gyi mchod rten me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag ye shes snying po'i mdangs: rol rtsal shar ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid: skal ldan snying khar bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: bud+dha tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: bzhi pa yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod bya zhing gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: rmad byung bla med dam tshig rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub ngo bo nyid: skal ldan lte bar bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: rat+na ghu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: lnga pa phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod cing sku 'bag thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po kun tu bzang:

dbyings phyug shes rab pang du 'khril: skal ldan gsang bar bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: karma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me tog 'thor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: thabs mchog ngo bo bde zhing stong: bskyed rim sprul sku sgyu ma'i ngang: skal ldan lag g.yas rdo rje gtad: drang don bshad pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra dzñā na dharma tsakra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bhan+dha g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: shes rab ngo bo gsal zhing stong: ye rdzogs chos rnams mtha' bral ngang: skal ldan lag g.yon bhan+dha gtad: nges don bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dharma gar+bha bhan+dha dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas zhi ba'i chas prog zhu thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags phyir: rin chen 'bar ba'i prog zhu 'di: de ring skal ldan spyi bor brgyan: lta ba ye grol dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra rat+na te si dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: cod pan thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga lhun grub dbang rtags phyir: dar tshon lnga yi cod pan 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor brgyan: sgom pa rgya yan dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra mu ku ṭa dha ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: stod g.yogs thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi yi dbang rtags phyir: sna tshogs spel ba'i stod g.yogs 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi dpung par brgyan: spyod pa 'dzin med dbang thob shog: om̐ bhi dza ya ar+bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ga shal thogs te: hūm̐: bde stong zag med dbang rtags phyir: drwa ba 'phrul gyi ga shal 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi stod du brgyan: om̐ ru pa kan+thi ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rus rgyan thogs la: hūm̐: phar phyin drug gi dbang rtags te: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi chas su brgyan: grol ba bzhi yi dbang thob shog:

om̐ go ro tsa ya ma li a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas snyan rgyan sogs gdub bu rnams thogs la: hūm̐: rten 'brel sna tshogs dbang rtags phyir: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan cha 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi gzugs su brgyan: sa lam rab rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ bhi shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: smad dkris thogs la: hūm̐: 'khor 'das zil gnon dbang rtags phyir: bde chen bklubs pa'i ang rag 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi smad du dkri: 'bras bu ka dag dbang thob shog: om̐ a tri wasatra pra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rgyas pa ltar na skabs 'dir dam pa rigs brgya'i tsakli so sor phral te dbang bskur: dur khrod chas brgyad kyang so sor phral te bskur: 'bring po ltar na lha grangs tshom bus bskur ba ni: dang po rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: bde gshegs thog ma'i sangs rgyas lnga: 'byung lnga'i gsang ye pang du 'khyud: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ye shes lnga yi dbang thob shog: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sems dpa' yab yum brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: 'phags mchog 'gro don byang sems brgyad: lam brgyad mthar phyin yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rnam thar brgyad ldan dbang thob shog: om̐ sarba sa twa mum̐ dā sha ṣa ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: thub pa rigs drug thogs la: hūm̐: bla med bcom ldan thub pa drug: sde snod rgya mtsho'i lung rigs 'dzin: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phar phyin drug ldan dbang thob shog: om̐ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne shākya mu na ye swā hā: sgo ba bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ba: thabs shes yab yum gnyis su med: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: theg pa rnam bzhi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra dha ra wa la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum bcu thogs la: hūm̐: dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum bcu: bde stong ye shes ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro:

sa bcu theg rtse'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru bhi dho dha ra muṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: longs spyod 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma: grags stong ngo bo gnyis med skus: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: grol bzhi dga' chen dbang thob shog: om̐ pra mo ti ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: he ru ka yab yum rnams thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal chen po yab yum bcu: snang stong ye shes ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dug lnga rnam dag dbang thob shog: om̐ he ru ka kro ta kro ti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: kau rī ma brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: kau rī ma mo chen mo brgyad: kun tu khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: gnas brgyad rnam dag dbang thob shog: om̐ ma ma dhe wi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: siṃ ha ma brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: siṃ ha ma mo chen mo brgyad: rang bzhin klong las 'gyu ba'i ngang: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yul brgyad rnam dag dbang thob shog: om̐ ma tri ma ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma: thugs rje'i dbang mo las byed mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bskyed pa las bzhi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dzñā na u ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mkha' 'gro sde lnga thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga: zag med bskyed pa'i las byed mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: tsaṇ+ḍa 'bar ba'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma: skye gnas bzhi yi sgo gcad phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rdzogs pa gnad bzhi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dharma rā ga ho a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: bla med dpal chen he ru kaḥ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phrin las lhun grub dbang thob shog:

om̐ badz+ra ku mā ra baṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbang phyug nyer brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad: las rnams kun gyi mtha' sdud mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: spro bsdu sbyang ba'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra shwa ri ma satwaṃ dza la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma: sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i dbang mo ches: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: las bzhi mthar phyin dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas zhi khro rigs brgya'i tho grangs tsam dbang khrid 'bring po'i skabs 'dir tshang ba yin: sa ma ya: de nas ye shes bzhi sbyor nges don snying po'i dbang bskur ba ni: thog mar me long ngam 'ja' 'od gur khyim thogs la: hūm̐: sgyu ma lta bu snang ba bzhi: 'ja' lus ye shes drwa ba'i gzugs: bskyed rim sku yi dbang bskur ro: 'ja' lus chos sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ dharma shū n+ya ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ des snang zhing bdag med pa'i chos thams cad stong pa'i rang rtsal te mtshon byed kyi sgro btags pa tsam las don la bden par ma grub par ngo 'phrod nas gzugs su chags pa'i a 'thas grol te bskyed rim sgyu ma lta bu'i sprul bsgyur bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so:

zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas mgrin par pad phreng ngam bsnyen pa bzhag la: hūm̐: zab lam brda yi mkha' dbyings su: dgyes pa'i gsang ba sngags sder mo: khyer cig bde stong dga' bzhi rol: pho nya zung 'jug dbang thob shog: om̐ gu h+ya mu ṭa ha sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ des grags stong skye med zang thal gyi sgra thams cad brag cha lta bur shes shing khyad par lam rtsa rlung pho nya'i dbang bzhi mngon du gyur te lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin mngon du gyur: deng phyin chad bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod kun tu rung zhing dbang la shes rab gsang ba dbyings rig mngon du byas so: zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas shel rdo dang me long thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag bde chen 'dus ma byas: kun gzhi gsal stong 'dzin med ngang: ye grol lta ba'i mchog de yi: ngo sprod dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ badz+ra dzñā na swa bhā dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: hoḥ des gsal stong rig pa g.ya' bral rjen ne ba: sus kyang ma bcos gang du mi gnas med du mi rung smra ba'i kha las 'das pa ji bzhin ngo bo khyab brdal lhun grub 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po can de'i ngo sprod thob ste: deng phyin chad rdzogs rim 'od gsal dri med la gnas pa'i skal ldan du byas so: zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur ba ni: sgro mdangs thig le tshom bu thogs la: hūm̐: ngo bo gsal la rang bzhin stong: rnam pa byed las dbyibs su 'das: bdag med thig le stong pa yis: ngo sprod dbang bskur stsal du gsol: om̐ ā li kā li dha ra haṃ ga ga gar+bha satwaṃ: hoḥ des tshig dbang ye shes gsal 'debs: ma bsgoms gnas lugs rang shar: brdal khyab chos sku'i mtshan nyid: gnas lugs rig pa'i 'du tshan: gcig shes lta ba'i mthar thug: 'khor 'das nyag gcig kun tu brjod med shes pa rtag chad ris su med pa'i bya rtsol gdod nas rdzogs te lhun grub 'dus ma byas gang de'i ngo sprod thob pa yin pas:

deng phyin chad ma bsgom: ma yengs: ma 'byams: ma bkug: ma lta: ma spyad: byed las bsrung sbyang gi zhag phyal bar slod shar grol du 'bad par byos shig: zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul: gsang dbang sogs mos na zur du gsal: de nas gser gyi 'khor lo thogs la: hūm̐: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: dbang bskur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: 'gro la thugs rjes smin par gyis: bla med yang dag don ston 'tshal: om̐ dharma tsakra hrīḥ.āḥhūm̐: de nas dung thogs la: hoḥ skye med grags stong chos kyi sgra: ches cher lha mi'i rang skad du: ston cing spel skyong spyod par gyis: kun la dbang bskur don ston shog: om̐ dharma ghaṇ+ḍe shang kha āḥhūm̐: rdo rje rgya gram thogs la: hoḥ yang dag thabs mchog bde ba che: 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rab myos pa: ches cher spyod pa'i las sgyur ba: rdo rje dga' bas don ston stsol: om̐ badz+ra pra mo ti ha ra ga dha ra hoḥ dril bu thogs la: hoḥ snyan ma'i brda skad rab bskyed pa: ches cher dbang mo'i las brtsam pa'i: mkha' yi pad+mo'i spun du snyeg: g.yo zhing g.yo ba khyab ston shog: om̐ pradzñā pra mo ti ri a sha su ra hūm̐: hom gzar blugs thogs la: hoḥ zla ba'i snod bzang nor bu'i rtse: mu kha tsaṇ+ḍa mos byung ston: bskur bas las bzhi lhun gyis grub: kun kyang byed las dbang thob shog: om̐ a haṃ a hu ram̐ sa ma ya dha ra hūm̐ swā hā: gtor ma thogs la: hoḥ rgyu gcig 'bras bu gnyis rdzogs rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: don gnyis yang dag ldan pa'i ngang: dus mchod la sogs brtson par gyis: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra bha ling+ta ash+tsa t+ya dha ra hūm̐: bkra shis rdzas brgyad thogs la: om̐: dge bar gyur cig bden pa'i tshig: gang zhig bkra shis dpal 'bar ba: deng 'dir stsol te rab gnas shing: kun nas kun tu 'byung bar shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ shrī ye swā hā: de nas gzung thag rdo rje gtad cing: hoḥ

deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod nyid: bla med zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: dkyil 'khor snying po 'di zungs shig: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: om̐ badz+ra maṇ+ṭa tsakra sa ma ya tsit+ta gar+bha dha ra hūm̐: zhes rgyas gdab bya zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p de nas dam tshig bstan pa ni: hoḥ de ltar bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka ste nyid zhi rol ba'i cho 'phrul gyi rang rtsal zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dbang chen legs par thob pa yin te: gsang sngags kyi dam tshig sba bar 'os pa rnams gnas khang gi phyi rol du'ang mi tshor bar bya: sku'i dam tshig yi dam lha'i bskyed rim dang mi 'bral: gsung gi dam tshig bzlas brjod bsnyen la rab tu brtson: thugs kyi dam tshig rdzogs rim 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs dran shes dang bag yod kyis rgyun du gnas par bya: yon tan gyi dam tshig sbyang spel spro bsdu la sogs gegs sel bogs 'don gyi nyams len bya zhing rgyun du dben pa'i gnas su 'grim par bya: phrin las kyi dam tshig nya stong dus drug la sogs su 'os pa'i mchod tshogs skong bshags rgyun du ma chag par bya: gsang ba'i dam tshig ni: dbang rtags kyi mtshan gzhan du mi bstan: dkyil 'khor gyi lha'ang gsang dbang bde stong ye shes gud du sbas te: tha mal gyi lam log lta can la zur tsam yang mi bshad: tshogs gtor dang dam rdzas sgrub pa'i cha rkyen thams cad dbul po dang bya khyis mi mthong bar bya: sgrub pa'i tshe gzhan la gdong mi bstan: lha 'di bsgrub ces tshad mi bor: bsnyen sgrub la dum bu mi bgo: sgrub pa kun gyi mjug tshang la mtha' dril bar bya: rjes bsngo smon khyad 'phags kyis mtshams sbyar: khyad par gyi dam tshig ni: dbang lung khrid gsum zhus te dam rdzas lce ru myang bas: rdo rje slob dpon de sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed: skyon mtshang gang ltar 'dug kyang 'bar sha mi skur:

sras dang brgyud 'dzin la'ang dam tshig bsrung: dam tshig dus gcig bsgoms pa'i rdo rje mched lcam kun la dag snang sbyang: tha na srog la bab kyang chos spang gi las mi bya: dbang khrid zhu ba'i tshe rin po che sna tshogs kyi maṇ+ḍal dbul: bla ma mnyes pa'i rdzas dang yo byad dgram: yi dam dgyes pa'i tshogs mchod rgyas par dgod: mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma gtsang bar bsham: rnam pa kun tu dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral bar bya: gzhan yang dge rtsa rgya che bar khas len bya'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ yang zab snying thig bcud kyi dwangs ma las: bla med snyan brgyud ma bsgoms sangs rgyas lam: ji bzhin rgyud lung rgya mtsho'i rang gzhung nyid: na raka dong sprugs gsang sngags khyad can gyi: smin grol gdams pa dbang mchog thob grol bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: skal ldan thugs sras de dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor sbas yul yang le 'brog gi mtsho nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /bkra shis// // kha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: kun bzang zhi ba'i sngon 'gro bla sgrub byin rlabs gter chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// kun bzang yab yum thog ma'i mgon/ /brgyud gsum bka' bab gcig bsdus pa'i/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ /dngos grub gter chen skyabs gyur 'dud/ de la las rim kun gyi sngon du byin rlabs bla ma bsgrub pa'i brten bskyed la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa yan lag bdun pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba bla ma sgrub pa dang bdun gyi/ dang po brten bskyed sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan song ba de kas khyab/ bsdu na tshogs zhing ni/ na mo/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/

/brgyud pa drug ldan gyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la/ gzhan yang phyogs dus phyi nang gsang ba'i skyabs yul sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ khyed shes kyi 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas/ ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma rgyu dang bral/ /phra zhib bag yod bstan pa'i sgra grags chos/ /mi gtong yid kyis dran pa'i dge 'dun tshogs/ /dbyings rig 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ gsum pa sems bskyed pa la mar gyur rnams phan bder 'god phyir snying rje drag pos kun nas bslang ste/ ho/ snod bcud 'khor 'das ye nas ris med ngang*/ /ma 'gags shar ba'i spangs rtogs blang dor rnams/ /mtshan 'dzin skye med rang bzhin ci lta bur/ /snod bcud skye 'gag bral phyir sems bskyed do/ / lan gsum bya'o/ /bzhi pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun bzang mkha' dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas/ /ma 'gags rang shar zhi ba dbyings kyi lha/ /snod bcud thob pa bral phyir gnas 'dir gshegs/ /ma chags zhen pa bral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rang sems klong gyur ngang gis phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs drug shar grol rnam dag mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag gzhan ngos bzung lta bas mthol lo bshags/ /brdal khyab chos dbyings sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' yas sems can sangs rgyas mi 'bral bsngo/ /gnyug ma lhan skyes 'phrod phyir smon par bgyi/ lan gsum bya'o/ /lnga pa sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas bstan pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ e ma ho/ rang lus tha mal spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gsal stong rdor dril bsnol/ /dbyings phyug yum gyur bde stong skyil krung bzhugs/ /skyabs yul lha tshogs ye shes lnga ldan bskor/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas g.yas g.yon 'khor/

/bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag gzhan sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /slar yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams nas/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor phyi nang lha/ /spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med skyabs yul tshogs/ /byin rlabs khrus rgyun spyi gtsug nas zhugs te/ /lus kun ltem gang dug gsum sgrib gnyis sogs/ /'og sgo nas thon sa gzhir thim par gyur/ gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar zla dkyil hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor bas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas da lta yan chad du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag par bsam zhing*/ om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma y sogs brjod/ khri 'bum sogs rtags ma thon bar du bzla'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis las gsol ba 'debs pa ste dang po/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig / gnyis pa ni/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go gsungs te dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ dal gcig mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag /drug pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'i maṇ+ḍal spyi dang bye brag las/ dang po ni so bdun ma'am gzhung las bdag 'jug gi skabs kyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu ma 'chol bar bkod de 'bul/ gnyis pa ni/ ho/ gzhi khregs chod ka dag maṇ+ḍa lar/ /lam ye shes lnga ldan tshom bus spras/ /don chos nyid lta ba'i ngang la 'bul/ /gzhi zang thal rgya yan maṇ+ḍa lar/ lam gang shar rig pa'i tshom bus brgyan/ /rgyu ma 'gags longs sku'i ngang du 'bul/ /gzhi blo 'das ro gcig maṇ+ḍa lar/ /lam bya rtsol bral ba'i tshom bus brgyan/ /don nyag gcig sprul sku'i ngang la 'bul/ /dbyings snang ba snod kyi maṇ+ḍa lar/

/nang bcud kyi sems can tshom bus brgyan/ /de ngos bzung bral ba'i ngang la 'bul/ /lus 'dus byas phung po'i maṇ+ḍa lar/ /rlung rtsa thig srog 'dzin tshom bus brgyan/ /de bdag 'dzin bral ba'i ngang la 'bul/ /gzhi sems bskyed bsod nams maṇ+ḍa lar/ /lam rgyu tshogs dge ba'i tshom bus brgyan/ /de dgag sgrub dngos rtog med par 'bul/ /bdag 'khor 'das gnyis med maṇ+ḍa lar/ /blo sems bskyed dge bcu'i tshom bus brgyan/ /zhing skyabs yul dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /lha 'od zhu bdag thim dbang rdzogs nas/ /don tshogs rdzogs mngon gyur mthar phyin shog om̐ badz+ra bh+rūm̐ lā s+ye na maṇ+ḍal mu tri saṃ bhā swa bhā wa dharma ko3 haṃ nir+yā mi/ zhes pas 'bul lo/ /bdun pa byin rlabs bla ma'i sgrub pa las bskyed pa gdab pa len pa bsre ba bzhi las/ dang po ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ rang lus 'od phung snang stong chu zla'i dbyibs/ /dregs pa ru tra sde brgyad bsnol ba'i khrir/ /hūm̐ yig yongs gyur che mchog dpa' gcig sku/ /rdo rje bhan dmar 'dzin cing gnam zhal 'khril/ /yab yum dur khrod chas brgyad snang stong gsal/ /de yi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /rig 'dzin bcu dang bka' bab las dbang sogs/ /thog ma'i mgon po'i bar du tho brtsegs bzhugs/ /bar du yi dam bka' brgyad dpal dgu'i lha/ /'og tu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas mi zad nor bu'i mdzod/ /rtse gcig mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ gnyis pa deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bla ma ma gtogs re sa gzhan med pa thag chod nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ na mo hūm̐/ ka dag thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*/ /gsol ba 'debs so rang rig mngon gyur nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zang thal gtad med longs sku rdo rje sems/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag 'dzin g.ya' bral nas/

/chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang mdzod rgyud 'dzin las kyi dbang mo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rlung sems dbang thob nas/ /nyams rtogs gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul sku'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin 'dus pa bcur/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbyings rig mngon gyur nas/ /snang bzhi tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun bzang zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so snang stong zung 'jug nas/ khyab brdal lhun grub rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zil gnon kun 'dus bka' brgyad zhi khro'i lha/ /gsol ba 'debs so khregs chod don rtogs nas/ /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' bab brgyud 'dzin sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rim gnyis mngon gyur nas/ /gdos bcas 'od skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /las 'phro gter 'byin rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs nas/ /'ja' lus chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma skyabs yul kun 'dus la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bden gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /'od gsal chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang sngags bka' yi gnyer gtad bstan srung la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bar chad bgegs zhi nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/

gsum pa tshogs bsdu zhing dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ ho/ tshogs zhing 'od zhu rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od lnga 'phros/ /rang rig gnas lngar thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ /chu la chu bzhag ma bcos so mar gnas/ /kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ bzhi pa dbyings rig mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ na mo/ bsgom bya sems kyi 'du shes zhig /kun gzhi blo 'das de yi ngang*/ /shes shing rig pas mnyam par bzhag /ngo bo dbyings ltar khyab pa de/ /dgag sgrub bral bar mnyam par bzhag /tshogs drug gnas 'gyu'i 'gro 'ong de/ /shar grol thug phrad mnyam par bzhag /grags stong dran stong rig stong de/ /gsal le hrig ger mnyam par bzhag /bzang ngan blo dang bral ba de/ /rtog gzhi med par mnyam par bzhag /mkha' la bya khyung 'phur ba bzhin/ /bya rtsol med par mnyam par bzhag /rang rig bla ma 'grub gyur cig / ces dmigs med ngang du bzhag /rgyun khyer ngag 'don bde bar gter chen gyi bka' yi cod pan spyi bor 'chang ba gter blon seṅges dmar phyogs kyi dus chen du bris pa'o/ /bdag rig 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal sras su nam yang smon 'brel tsam mo/ /bkra shis// // ga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: kun bzang zhi ba'i cho ga na raka dong sprugs kyi las byang thos grol bla med bzhugs so: kun bzang zhi ba dbyings kyi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: 'gro kun ngan song las grol phyir: 'khor ba dong sprugs gdams pa bstan: thos grol bla med gsang sngags chos: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po dkyil 'khor rdzas rim ni: mthing ka dal thig legs par gdab: tshom bu lha grangs 'di ltar dgod: rin chen bum pa kha rgyan can: mgul chings gzung thag dung bcas tshang : nang du bum rdzas chu yis bkang : bgrang phreng rigs lnga tsakli yi: btags grol dbang gi chas rnams dang :

bha ling rgyan ldan dang bcas bsham: gzhan yang spyan gzigs tshogs bskang sogs: las gzhung lta bur bsham par bya: bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs: rnam snang ldan pa'i ngang nyid las: zang thal ma bcos spro bsdu byed: sngon 'gro gtong ba'i rim pa ni: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: gdod nas rang byung ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings: bya rtsol bral ba zang thal shar ba'i lha: kun tu rol pa cho 'phrul zhi khro'i dbyings: ma 'gags klong yangs shugs kyis bdag skyabs mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: na mo: bsam brjod bral ba blo bral ngang nyid las: 'khor 'das chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma nyid: bdag med gzugs brnyan chu zla'i snang tshul bzhin: ye nas gshis lugs de bzhin sems bskyed do: gsum pa bgegs gtor bran la: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs: chos dbyings rang byung klong yangs nas: ma 'gags snying rje'i 'od zer gyis: lhun grub lta ba'i dkyil 'khor la: gnod pa'i nyon mongs bar chad bgegs: gnyis med gtor ma len phyir 'dus: om̐ ma hā dzñā na gnod byed aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig nga bdag ma rig bgegs: sngon tshe las rlung rkyen gyis bsgyur: re dogs ngar 'dzin 'byung po khug: bag chags 'khor ba'i srid mtshor zhen: snying rje'i zhing gyur bgegs rigs rnams: 'khor 'das blo bral gtor ma bsngo: shar grol bden gnyis don rtogs nas: ldog med chos kyi dbyings su dengs: bag chags blang dor a 'thas na: rig pa shes rab ral gri yis: nyon mongs mgo lus tshal par 'gas: ngan song sa bon ming med brlag: de bas bdag 'dzin rang sar dengs: om̐ sarba dharma kā ya swa bhā badz+ra mu: gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: ye nas snod bcud gzhal yas khang : gzugs rnams bud+dha zhi khro'i lha: sgra rnams chos nyid ma 'gags gdangs: dran rig mtha' dbus ngo bo stong :

ye shes lnga ldan phyi nang gtibs: brdal khyab tsakras mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra dharma swa bhā āt+ma ko3 haṃ dzñā na tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: drug pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: ye nas snang srid zhi khro'i lha: de don lta ba'i lha mjal phyir: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sgo bcad nas: rang byung ye shes 'char sgo phyes: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dzñā na pañtsa pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bdun pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: ka dag chos dbyings rol pa las: kun bzang sgyu ma'i sna tshogs lha: rang byung ye shes zhal mthong phyir: kun khyab thig les brda phyag 'tshal: om̐ na mo pū ru sha ya ho: brgyad pa brda bshags bya ba ni: hūm̐: ye nas blo bral 'khor 'das mnyam: bzang ngan rtag chad 'dzin pa nyid: phra rags sbom gsum tshogs drug rnams: ye shes zang thal ngang la bshags: om̐ na mo badz+ra shud+dhe āḥ dgu pa brda'i mchod pa ni: bh+rūm̐: gnyis med rang byung ngo bo nyid: bde stong skye med mchod pa'i sprin: ma 'gags ting 'dzin 'od zer gyis: kun bzang dkyil 'khor mnyes phyir 'bul: om̐ na mo badz+ra pū dza ho: bcu pa brda'i bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gdod nas klong yangs zhi ba'i lha: ka dag rang byung cho 'phrul te: dbyings rig 'od gsal dkyil 'khor la: 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas bstod: om̐ badz+ra na mo a ti pū hoḥ bcu gcig pa dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: thog ma'i chos dbyings kun tu bzang : ma 'gags ye shes cho 'phrul gyis: rang byung zhi gar dkyil 'khor grub: de don dran pas mi btang bzung : om̐ na mo badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: bcu gnyis pa byin 'bebs pa ni: hūm̐: ka dag chos kyi klong yangs nas: khregs chod lta bas byin phob cig: zang thal ma 'gags pho brang nas: sna tshogs 'dzin med byin phob cig: lhun grub bde stong pho brang nas: rang byung rang shar byin phob cig: blo 'das rgya yan pho brang nas: bla med a tis byin phob cig: ye shes lnga ldan pho brang nas:

rang rig bla mas byin phob cig: dam tshig rten 'brel 'khor lo nas: rtsa rlung mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: bsdus bya rnam dag pho brang nas: dam can srung mas byin phob cig: byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur: rang byung ye shes de don stsol: om̐ badz+ra dzñā na bo dhi hūm̐: bcu gsum pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug dag pa'i snod mchog tu: rang byung dbang po rnam lnga lha mo'i tshogs: 'khrul 'dzin 'khri ba gcod pa'i gar sgyur ma: sna tshogs g.yo ba'i mchod rdzas zag med spel: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe sogs spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti āḥhūm̐: bcu bzhi pa nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yi bhan+dha ru: a haṃ byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi'i mchod: rang byung rlung lngas bsrubs bskyed spel ba yi: rnam dag ye shes ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ a haṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ bco lnga pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: mu kha bhan+dha yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: bla med thabs kyi rdo rjes bskul ba yis: dbyings phyug bzang mo'i bha ga'i rak+ta'i rgyun: legs byung dmar chen ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ ma hā rak+ta a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ bcu drug pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: phung po baṃ shun bhan+dha'i snod nang du: tsit+tas bha ling brgyan pa'i dpal bshos btsugs: māṃ sa go ro tsa na'i mtheb skyus bskor: sbyor ba bla med ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na om̐ āḥhūm̐: bcu bdun pa bum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung bde ba chen po'i bum pa ru: stong pa ye shes chen po'i bdud rtsis bkang : gsal ba bud+dha'i zhing khams ye nas grub: bla med pho brang ma bsgoms lhun gyis grub:

om̐ dharma rā ga lak+ṣa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod rdzas rang byung ltar byin gyis brlab: sa ma ya: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: kun tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin: kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin: kun tu rgyu ba'i ting nge 'dzin las dang po ni: hūm̐: ye nas rang byung brdal khyab klong : ka dag ma bcos dbyer med ngang : gsal stong 'khor 'das kun la gnas: kun tu bzang pos de ltar smras: om̐ dharma dzñā na sa man+ta bha dra hūm̐: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni: āḥ ma 'gags zang thal kun tu rgyu: dbyings rig dran rdzogs lhang nge ba: rang rtsal ye shes lnga dang ldan: 'khor 'das kun gyi bskyed pa'i lam: om̐ dharma swa bhā hṛ da hūm̐: gsum pa kun tu rgyu ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni: om̐: sna tshogs rang byung ngo bo nyid: kun tu sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: rang byung sprul pa'i dbyings su shar: 'byung lnga rnam dag badz+ra bh+rūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra dharma ko3 haṃḥ hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: e las nam mkha' chos dbyings stong pa'i klong : yam̐ las g.yo byed rlung gi rgya gram chags: ram̐ las ye shes bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: kham̐ las dwangs ma'i 'byung ba bdud rtsi khol: sum̐ las brdal khyab lhun grub dbang chen gzhi: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab phung po brjid: bh+rūm̐ las ye shes pho brang gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi tshad med bzhi dang ldan: dbang po rnam lnga dag pa'i rtsig pa mdzes: yul brgyad ma spangs rnam dag ka ba la: stong nyid bcu drug mi shigs gdung ma bres: skye mched bcu gnyis rnam dag dral lcam gtibs: lhun grub rang gsal brdal khyab thog steng phub: rgyu 'bras dkar nag phra zhib za ra tshags: kun rdzob don dam dbyer med ka gzhu la: kun gzhi 'gyur ba med pa'i ka gdan btsugs: tshogs drug snang ba ma 'gags shar bu la: shes rig drwa ba'i lha mo'i mchod sprin gtibs: lta ba mi shigs rin chen pha gu ste:

sna tshogs 'gyu ba rnam dag drwa phyed brgyan: rlung lnga 'gro 'ong bral ba'i shar bu bskyod: bde stong skye med mda' yab pu shu ldan: dga' bzhi lhun grub ngo bo rta babs spras: rnam thar brgyad ldan chos 'khor nyi shu la: ma skyes snying rje'i ri dwags chos sgra nyan: yul brgyad kun brtags bral ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes: phyi rol dug lnga rnam dag dur khrod brgyad: skyon bral rdo rwa pad phreng yon tan rdzogs: ye shes me dpung lnga ldan bag chags sreg: dkyil 'khor phyi nang ma bcos zang thal klong : lta ba ye grol tog dang snam bus brgyan: rnam thar bkod pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs: rang byung pho brang stong gsal 'dzin med bsgom: hūm̐: de dbus seng khri nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: gdod ma'i gshis lugs ji bzhin bstan pa'i phyir: rang rig ka dag ngo bo yongs gyur las: hūm̐ yig mthing kha dri med nam mkha'i mdog: 'od lnga'i mdangs ldan gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: ma bcos lhun grub chos sku kun tu bzang : zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: yum mchog bzang mo dkar gsal pang du 'khyud: bde stong snang la rang bzhin med pa yi: sgyu ma chu zla'i ngang tshul ci bzhin bsgom: om̐ sa man+ta bha dra sam+bha hūm̐: hūm̐: thugs dbus sna tshogs ye shes 'khor lo yi: tsit+ta longs spyod rdzogs pa'i pho brang dbus: rlung lnga rnam dag mi shigs bsnol ba'i steng : thog ma'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang : sku mdog mthing nag mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: dbyings phyug dkar mo bde stong sku la 'khril: ye shes lnga ldan zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: tsit+ta'i pho brang phyogs bzhi'i rtsa 'dab la: mi bskyod mthing nag rdo rje dril bu bsnams: rin 'byung ser po rin chen dril bu bsnams: mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: don grub ljang gu rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: mtshams bzhir spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgrol:

spos sgrom chu skyes zhun me dung chos 'dzin: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol rtsa 'dab brgyad rnams la: sa snying dkar po rin chen myu gu 'dzin: nam snying ser po ral gri ut+pal bsnams: spyan gzigs dmar po pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: phyag rdor ljang gu rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad: byams pa dkar ser klu shing dril bu 'dzin: sgrib sel dmar ljang po ti phreng ba bsnams: kun bzang dmar ser snye ma dril bu bsnams: 'jam dpal ljang gu ut+pal dril bu bsnams: mtshams brgyad yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gar ldan ma: lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti ma: me long phreng ba gling bu pi waṃ bsnams: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma: spos sgrom chu skyes zhun me dung chos bsnams: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim rtsa 'dab bcu drug la: bde ba chen po'i rig 'dzin sku mdog smug: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog dkar: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin sku mdog ser: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sku mdog dmar: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog ljang : gar stabs khro 'dzum rdo rje dril bu bsnams: bud+dha gar dbang 'khor lo bhan+dha bsnams: rdo rje gar dbang rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: rin chen gar dbang nor bu bhan+dha bsnams: pad+ma gar dbang pad+ma bhan+dha bsnams: las kyi gar dbang rgya gram bhan+dha bsnams: thams cad khro 'dzum brkyang bskum tshul gyis gsal: lha dbang brgya byin dkar po pi waṃ bsnams: thag bzang sngon po'i phyag na go mtshon bsnams: shāka thub ser po'i phyag na par bu bsnams: seng ge rab brtan mthing ga pu ti bsnams: thub pa kha 'bar dmar po sgrom bu bsnams: chos kyi rgyal po mthing nag me chu bsnams: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: tsit+ta'i pho brang sgo bzhi skyong mdzad pa: gshin rje mthing nag ral gri lcags kyu bsnams: stobs chen ser po rdo rje zhags pa bsnams: rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa lcags sgrog bsnams:

bdud rtsi ljang gu rgya gram dril bu bsnams: sgo ma rigs bzhi rang mdog yab la 'khril: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: de ltar phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: snang stong chu zla lta bur gsal ba yi: gnas kyi yig 'bru lnga yi 'od zer gyis: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥphaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub rang byung pho brang nas: chos sku ye shes lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: zang thal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i pho brang nas: longs sku rang byung lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ma skyes lhun grub dag pa'i pho brang nas: sprul sku zhi ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral sna tshogs khri'i steng du: kun bzang zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams: mi g.yo gsal stong gnyis med ngang nyid du: 'gro kun thugs rjes skyong phyir bzhugs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: kun bzang zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs la: mos gus 'dun pa'i yid kyi lcags kyu yis: mi phyed gdung shugs drag pos gus btud nas: sgo gsum rtsol bral ngang gis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mig gi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: puṣ+pe dkar mos me tog sna tshogs bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma puṣ+pe pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: sna yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: dhū pe ser mos spos sgrom sna tshogs bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra dhū pe pū dza hoḥ lus kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: ā lo dmar mos mar me sna tshogs bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: tshor ba'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: gan+dhe ljang mos dri chab sna tshogs bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: lce yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: ro yi lha mos zhal zas sna tshogs bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma nai wi d+ye pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: rna ba'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: shab+da sngon mos rol mo sna tshogs bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma shab+da pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: gzugs kyi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rū pa dkar mo'i phyag na me long bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra rū pa pū dza hoḥ

hūm̐: sgra yi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: shab+da ser mo'i phyag na ghaṇ+ḍe bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra shab+da pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: dri yi rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gan+dhe ljang mo'i phyag na dri chab bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: ro yi zhen pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rā sa dmar po phyag na zhal zas bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra rā sa pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: reg bya'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: spar+she sngon mo'i phyag na rgyan gos bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra spar+she pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: zhe sdang ngo bo ma spangs gnas su dag: lā s+ye dkar mo'i phyag na me tog bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra lā s+ye pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: 'dod chags rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gīrti dmar mo'i phyag na pi waṃ bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra gīrti pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: gti mug rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: bhi dhom̐ sngon mos shel gyi phreng ba bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra bhi dhom̐ pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: nga rgyal rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: nīrti ljang mo'i phyag na gling bu bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra waṃ se pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: phrag dog rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gu h+ya ljang mo'i phyag na pu ti bsnams:

bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra su khaṃ pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: 'gyu ba sna tshogs ma spangs gnas su dag: sna tshogs lha mos bkra shis rtags brgyad bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra bi shwa maṅga laṃ pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: rtsa mdud rgya mtsho ma spangs gnas su dag: grol lam mkha' 'gros rgyal srid sna bdun bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra puṇ+ye swa bhā wa pū dza hoḥ de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rkyang ma bde ba chen po'i bhan+dha ru: a haṃ byang chub sems kyi thig les bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra su khaṃ pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: ro ma stong pa chen po'i bhan+dha ru: shes rab chags pa med pa'i rak+tas bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra pañtsa rak+ta pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: dbu ma ye shes chen po'i bhan+dha ru: bla med dbyings rig sbyor ba'i rak+tas bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra dzñā na swa bhā pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: rtsa khams 'khor lo lnga yi bhan+dha ru: nyon mongs dug lnga bsgral ba'i bha ling btsugs: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra bha ling+ta pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: 'byung lnga phung khams dag pa'i bhan+dha ru: stong nyid bcu drug gsang ba'i mchod pas bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: sems nyid kun tu bzang po'i bhan+dha ru: rig pa kun bzang dgyes pa'i rdzas kyis bkang :

bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma su khaṃ swa bhā hūm̐: hūm̐: rang byung skye ba med pa'i bhan+dha ru: rig pa ye shes bla med rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra dzñā na pañtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: rnam dag ma bcos khyab brdal bhan+dha ru: gsal stong skye 'gag bral ba'i rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ dharma badz+ra swa bhā pū dza hoḥ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: ka dag skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas: gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don skur snang ba: kun bzang chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing : gsal stong gnyis med mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: dbyings phyug dkar mor zung 'jug pang du 'khril: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung lam me ba: kun bzang yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sna tshogs ma 'gags rang byung pho brang nas: sgyu ma chu zla bzhin du sprul pa'i lha: zhi ba ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams: zhi 'dzum mdzes pa'i gar ldan bzhad pa po: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem lang tsho mdangs ldan ma: yab yum dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi ldan rnam thar sgo bzhi srung : bzhad gshe khro la gar sgyur dgyes par byed: sgo ba yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan cod pan du ma 'phur: rin po che dang mu tig rgyan gyis spras: zhi ba'i tshul dgu rdzogs cing yon tan ldan: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod pa rgyas pa byed na 'di ltar mdzod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs las bskyed pa'i yab: chos sku kun tu bzang por phyag 'tshal bstod: bde stong ye shes dbyer med bskyed pa'i yum:

dbyings phyug kun tu bzang mor phyag 'tshal bstod: zhe sdang rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rdor sems mi bskyod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: nga rgyal rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rin 'byung ser po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dod chags rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: mtha' yas dmar po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrag dog rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: don grub ljang gu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sha yi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khrag gi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: mā ma kī yi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: drod kyi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: gos dkar mo yi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbugs kyi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mig gi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: sa yi snying po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: yid kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: kun tu bzang po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: kun tu rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sna yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: phyag na rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lce yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: spyan ras gzigs dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lus kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: byams pa mai tri'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ngag gi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sgrib pa rnam sel sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: yid kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: nam mkha'i snying po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: shes bya'i sgrib pa ma spangs gnas su dag: lā s+ye dkar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: nyon mongs sgrib pa ma spangs gnas su dag: mā l+ye ser mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bag chags sgrib pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gīrti dmar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lus kyi sgrib pa ma spangs gnas su dag:

nīrti ljang mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzugs kyi phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: puṣ+pe dkar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dri yi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: dhū pe ser mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgra yi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ā lo dmar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ro yi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gan+dhe ljang mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzugs kyi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: bde ba rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshor ba'i phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sku la bstod: 'du shes phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: phyag rgya rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'du byed phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: tshe dbang rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam shes phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: lhun grub rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: srid par 'jug pa ma spangs gnas su dag: bud+dha gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye ba len pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rdo rje gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rga ba'i 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rin chen gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: na ba'i rnam rtog ma spangs gnas su dag: pad+ma gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'chi ba'i kun rtog ma spangs gnas su dag: las kyi gar dbang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha yi sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: lha dbang brgya byin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha min sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: thag bzang ris kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mi yi sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: shākya thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: byol song sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: seṅge rab brtan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: yi dwags sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: thub pa kha 'bar sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: chos kyi rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

rtag par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: gshin rje gshed kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dngos por lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: stobs po che yi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: chad par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: rta mgrin rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: stong par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam thar sgo bzhi ma 'gags zang thal ngang : sgo ma rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bde stong ye shes ngang : zhi ba yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i klong yangs 'gags med shugs 'byung bas: ye shes sku lnga'i 'od zer lcags kyu 'gyed: ma rig rmongs pa'i sems can sdug bsngal can: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che la bying ba rnams: rang byung lha mchog bde chen lha ru drongs: bdag gis rtse gcig thugs dam rgyud bskul mthus: mngon rdzogs bla med byang chub reg gyur cig: de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni: om̐ dharma sa man+ta bha dra dzñā na hūm̐: rigs lnga yab yum la: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sems dpa' yab yum rnams la: om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: spyi'i bsnyen pa bya ba ni: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: gzungs sngags rnams ci 'grub bzla: sham bur sdig sbyong sngags ni: om̐ sarba pā paṃ badz+ra bi shwa dha ye swā hā: bum pa sgrub pa'i sngags ni: om̐ dharma badz+ra hri da ya ga lak+ṣa pa da ra da ra hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: zhes bum pa bsgrub: de nas dam tshig sku gsum gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba ni: dang po rang lus bsang sbyang : gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba: gsum pa dbang bskur ba: bzhi pa ngo bo skyong ba'o: dang po rang lus bsang sbyang ni : rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs:

om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ khyed rang rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las kun bzang yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur: om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas khrus bya ba ni: hūm̐: bum pa bzang po ye shes dbyings kyi mkha': bcud ni ka dag rang byung dri med chus: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la khrus 'bul bgyi: bdag gzhan sgo gsum bag chags sbyang du gsol: om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi? zhes khrus gsol bas kun rtog shes bya'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral te: ye shes lnga'i ngo bo mngon du gyur nas rig pa gsal stong skye ba med pa'i skal ldan du byas so: zhes khrus bya na: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: zab gsang zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi drung du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bgyi'o: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ t sogs: ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur ba ni: rang gi spyi gtsug tu kun bzang yab yum bde stong sbyor ba mdzad pas sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te: spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo ltem gyis gang bar
