bsams la: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bde stong ye shes dbyer med kyi: zung 'jug bla med bdud rtsi yi: rgyun mchog spyi bo'i gtsug nas babs: 'ja' lus bum dbang thob par shog: om̐ badz+ra dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des bskyed rim sgyu ma lta bur 'ja' lus snang stong sprul sgyur bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so: maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas gzungs ma'am: shel gyi phreng ba thogs la: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ltem gyis gang bar bsam: hūm̐: grags stong ye shes dbyer med kyi: shes rab gsang ba zung 'jug nyid: gnyis med zung 'jug dkyil 'khor mchog: gsang ba shes rab dbang thob shog: om̐ sam+bha pra dzñā wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des zung 'jug bla med rang byung gi ye shes lnga ro gcig tu rtogs pa'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang dang ldan par byas so: maṇ+ḍal phul la: de nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ltem gyis gang bar bsam: de nas shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: gsal stong ye shes dbyer med kyi: rgyu 'byung ka dag rang bzhin ngang : dbyings rig ma bcos bla med kyi: mngon sum rig pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ swa bhā bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'o des rdzogs rim 'od gsal chos sku rang byung gi rig pa ma 'gags zang thal rjen ne ba: mngon sum rig pa ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no: slar maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus kun ltem gyis gang bar bsam: lhun grub dbyer med kyi dbang ni: ho: snang zhing stong pa chos sku'i ngo bo: grags shing stong pa chos sku'i rang rtsal: gsal zhing stong pa chos sku'i nges tshig: dran cing ma 'gags stong pa chos sku'i ngang tshul: shes rig kun khyab chos sku'i gnas lugs: lhun grub kun khyab chos sku'i 'bras bu'o: de yang ngo bo stong pa chos sku:

rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku: thugs rje 'gags med sprul sku'o: 'od gsal dag pa chos sku: sgyu ma rmi lam longs sku: sna tshogs rang gsal sprul sku: de yang nges par gsal bzhag dran pa mngon sum gyi tshig dbang thob pa yin no: zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas chas kyis brgyan pa ni: cod pan thogs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: cod pan ye shes lnga ldan 'di: bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dbang rtags zungs: kun bzang mi bskyod spyi bor bsgom: rang byung rigs kyi bdag por shog: om̐ sa man+ta bha tra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga ye shes ngo bo nyid: longs sku'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i mchog: ye shes rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: dug lnga ma spangs dbang thob shog: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas stod g.yogs thogs la: hūm̐: stong nyid bla med snying po can: mtshan dpes rab brgyan mdzes pa'i mchog: lha rdzas na bza' stod la g.yogs: gsang mtshan brda yi dbang thob shog: om̐ dhe wa bhu dza ya arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ga shal gyis brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: gsang sngags bla med theg chen gyi: shes rab rang bzhin 'khril ba yi: ga sha'i phreng bas g.yon du brgyan: dpe byad 'khor lo'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ba me arba ma li arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rin po che phyag gdub zhabs gdub snyan rgyan rnams thogs la: hūm̐: rnam thar brgyad kyi sgo 'byed cing : shes brgyad ngo bo gnas su dag: rang byung rin chen bdun gyis brgyan: rgyud sde'i rtags rgyan dbang thob shog: om̐ rat+na bi shwa arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas smad dkris thogs la: hūm̐: rim dgu bla med theg pa'i mchog: dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ste: yang dag mngon gsal rdzas kyi mchog: rgyan klub brda yi dbang thob shog: om̐ kuṇ+ḍa li arba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'di la bstod pa bya zhing mchod pa 'bul:

rdo rje g.yas su gtad la: hūm̐: thabs mchog bde ba chen po'i rdzas: rang byung sna tshogs rdo rje 'di: phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor g.yas su zungs: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra bhi shwa badz+ra ka ra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dril bu g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: shes rab stong pa chen po'i rdzas: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i sgra che ba: phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor g.yon du zungs: zab gsang sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ shab+da ba me dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing dkyil 'khor lha la bstod pa ni: phyag rgya dang bcas te: hūm̐: rdo rje chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rdo rje'i thabs mchog bde stong pa: rdo rje'i skyil krung zung 'jug dang : rdo rje rgyal po thog ma'i mgon: phyag 'tshal kun bzang yab yum la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che: rdo rje mi bskyod gsum dang ldan: rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsnol thabs can: phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'chang chen la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: rdo rje'i kha dog rang bzhin can: rdo rje'i rang rtags rgyan ldan pa: phyag 'tshal rigs lnga yab yum la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje bya grub shes pa brgyad: rdo rje mi g.yo rnam pa can: rdo rje'i phyag mtshan 'khrul 'khor sgyur: phyag 'tshal sems dpa' yab yum brgyad la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje bde ba dgyes pa'i yab: rdo rje gsang ba las 'dzin ma: rdo rje brda sgyur brda 'chang ba: phyag 'tshal rigs lnga yab yum la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje theg pa bla na med: rdo rje ston pas phung po bcom: rdo rje phar phyin drug 'chang ba: phyag 'tshal thub pa rigs drug la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje zhi byed bzhad gshe khro: rdo rje'i gyad 'gros sa gsum gnon: rdo rje tshad med grub pa bzhi: phyag 'tshal sgo ba yab yum brgyad la'o: hūm̐: rdo rje'i drwa ba sgyu 'phrul can: rdo rje kun gzhi snying po 'chang : rdo rje las byung 'dod nas 'dul: phyag 'tshal zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la'o:

zhes bstod cing phyag 'tshal nas ye shes pa brtan phyir rab tu gnas par bya: 'di nyid dkyil 'khor gyi las sogs dang : dus kyi mchod pa yin na: thams cad rigs lnga'i rgyan bcas tshang bar bsags: tshogs la ma rol bar rgyan mi dkrol: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: bdag nyid kun bzang thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chus: dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bdud rtsir bsgyur: hūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten tshogs gzhong du: nang bcud sems can tshogs su gyur: 'khor 'das gnyis med mchod pa'i sprin: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza om̐ āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum la: zhi ba sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: rin chen snyan cha rgyan gdub khro lo lo: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan dga' bro ya la la: glu len gar byed bro rdung khrigs se khrig: brda 'gros mnyen lcug 'khril ldem khyugs se khyug: bde stong nyams dbyangs sna tshogs lhangs se lhang : bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od dpung kyi li li: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal sha ra ra: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen myur du phob: tshogs mchod rdzas la bcud chen sna tshogs phob: dkyil 'khor 'di la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs bskyed: gnas khang 'di la 'od phung 'ja' gur 'khyil: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo'i nyams rtogs spel: rten 'brel phun tshogs dga' ston bskyed du gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ de nas tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs la: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes tshogs kyis mchod:

sku lnga lhun grub bde chen ngang du bzhes: gnyis med ngo bo mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: oṃ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: de nas tshogs kyi skong ba ni: hūm̐: mchod sprin lha mo nam mkha'i gar sgyur la: sna tshogs dbang po tshim byed mchod sprin tshogs: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: byang sems bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsis bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: shes rab skye med gsang ba'i rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: gsal stong gnyis med sbyor ba'i mchod pas bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor mas bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: nyon mongs rtsa mdud grol ba'i rak+tas bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: phung po 'byung lnga dag pa'i bhan+dha ru: dbang po rnam lnga mchod rdzas bcud kyis bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i bhan+dha ru: ma 'gags lhun grub rang byung rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub bhan+dha ru: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang :

bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang du gsol: dam tshig sor chud nyams chag bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib bag chags thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib ma lus bral gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: thugs rje brtse ba'i lcags kyus dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig bag med dbang gyur nas: phyi nang 'khrul pa blo rtog ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ bud+dha satwa hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra satwa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na satwa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma satwa hūm̐: om̐ karma satwa hūm̐: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing lhag chad bkang : de nas tha ma bsgral ba ni: lan gsum gyis gnod byed 'gugs la: hūm̐: nga ni rig pa he ru ka: ro gcig lta ba khros pa'i sku: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje gsol: g.yon pas shes rab phur pa bsgril: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra bo rnams: snying rje'i phur bus 'debs shing bsgral: ka dag mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: om̐ badz+ra dharma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral lo: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams: chos nyid klong yangs dgyes pa'i zhal phyes shig: dug lnga ma rig bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rang grol bde ba chen por dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol: lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: laṅka ging dang gnas nyul dbang phyug 'bum: gos su mi sdug g.yang gzhi sna tshogs gyon: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la za: dur khrod gnas nyul rnal 'byor tshogs khang 'grims: phyag na bhan+dha lcang lo'i gtor gzhong thogs:

mi bzad rngam pa sha za pho mo'i gzugs: lhag gtor bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya rar ma g.yel bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ yo ga yo gi dharma pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas: kun tu bzang po zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: rang byung ye shes dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: nyon mongs dug lnga 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' yas sems can 'dren pa'i dus la bab: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: rigs drug sa bon stongs pa'i dus la bab: gzung 'dzin phra rags bcom pa'i dus la bab: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum gyis: ye shes klong dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: sna tshogs 'gyu bas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: ye grol shes pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og dbyings kyi tha tshig gnyis pa la: rigs 'dus drug pa rdor sems yab yum gyis: zhi ba lhun grub dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: shar grol lta ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba ru: dga' rab rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhi mtsho gnyis: yang gsang rgyud dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: las kyi dbang phyug khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dug lnga rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og brag dmar bsam yas mchims phu ru: pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gnyis: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: chos skyong dam can khas blangs dam bcas bzhin:

sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og sbas yul pad+ma bkod pa ru: rtsa gsum gling pa gdong can mkha' 'gro gnyis: rgya mtsho'i gling nas gter sgrom gdan drangs tshe: gter srung pho nyas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: gtor zor drag po'i dbal gyis sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ kro ta kro ti ḍāk+ka ḍāk+ki nī dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma ma bdun sman: skye mched bcu gnyis gnas bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' spungs se spung : glu len bro gar bshugs glu kyu ru ru: g.yer kha sgra snyan dril bu si li li: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma mo ting ting shag shag le le ma ma khā hi: de nas rta bro ni: hūm̐: nga ni rtog med he ru kaḥ dug lnga bsgral ba'i 'jig rten du: rig rtsal stobs kyis bro brdungs pas: nam yang nyon mongs ma ldang zhig: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan:

zhes gtor gzhong kha yar bslangs la mchod pa 'bul: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang : ka dag dbyings rig 'od gsal snying po can: nam yang bstan pa'i rgyal sa zin pa yi: 'dod rgu'i ye shes dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: om̐ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: kun bzang ma bcos dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams: ma skyes mi 'gags rang byung rang shar ngang : gsal stong dran rig gnyug ma a la bsdu: a don zang thal rgya yan e ma hoḥ zhes ma bcos lta ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar bsdu'o: de nas bsngo ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: bsngo bya bral ba kun gzhi ye nas gcig: bsngo byed bral ba kun tu 'gyu ba tsam: bsngo mkhan shes pa smra brjod kha las 'das: sangs rgyas sems can gzhi gcig 'bras bur bsngo: de nas smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ dmigs gtad blo smon bral ba kun tu bzang : snod bcud ye nas ma bcos sangs rgyas zhing : dgag sgrub 'khri ba gzhi thog gcer bzhag ngang : bag chags 'khrul gzugs 'dzin med smon lam shog: ces smon lam gyis rgyas gdab pa ni: don du dmigs bcas smon lam bgyis: de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: gzhi yi bkra shis zab mo lta ba'i dbyings: lam gyi bkra shis sna tshogs drwa ba'i gar: 'bras bu'i bkra shis don dam mngon gyur pa: dran rig thog ma'i mgon po'i bkra shis shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma bdag 'dra kho bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs mtha' yas 'gro 'dren phyir: yang zab gsang ba thig le'i chos: a ti kun bzang bla ma 'di: nges don gsang ba mkha' 'gror gcig brgyud ma: thugs rje mi zad 'byin pa'i gter chen po: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam zab 'di: ma 'ongs 'phrad pa'i skal ldan las can rnams: tshe 'dir 'ja' lus yi dam lha'i zhing du: mngon rdzogs thog ma'i mgon po de dang mnyam: 'di nyid nyams len sgrub brtson bgyis tsam gyis:

sdig can shan pa las ngan yin gyur kyang : mtho ris gnas su bgrod pa the tshom med: de phyir rgyu 'bras med pa'i yid ches rnams: las 'bras bslu med kho bo pad 'byung tshim: 'di nyid ma 'ongs yang mtha'i chos skal te: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yang gsang shog dril smug po'i logs su bris: rlung 'khor rak+ta can gyi mtsho la sbos: zang thal 'gyu lam can gyi klu la bcol: snyigs dus yang mtha' nyi shu mgo tshugs dus: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: spel rgya: rtsa gsum gling pas lcags bya'i lor pad+ma sbas tshal nas gangs ri lha btsan 'dra ba'i mdun pha bong rngam 'dra'i mgul mtsho 'khor rba rlabs drag tu 'phyo ba ru/ klu bdud nā ga rak+sha'i lag nas khrom gter du bgyis te gdan drangs shing kho bos gsang sngags chos gling du zhal bshus pa'o// // nga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ kun bzang zhi ba'i 'dzab bskul bzhugs so// bla ma kun bzang pad 'byung dbyer med la/ /blo bral chos nyid klong nas phyag bgyi'o/ /de nas 'dzab bskul gyi bzlas pa phrin las mchod bstod la lnga las/ dang po lha tshogs rnams thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni/ spos rol snyan dbyangs dang ldan pas 'di skad do/ / hūm̐/ ye rdzogs 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor nas/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas su/ /ma chags skyon bral bde stong pad zla'i steng*/ /ma bcos ka dag kun bzang yab yum dang*/ /ma skyes rang shar zhi ba dbyings kyi lha/ /sku ni mi g.yo zang thal phyi nang bral/ /gsung ni mi 'gags 'dzab dbyangs rgyun chad med/ /thugs rje'i klong yangs 'gags med shugs 'byung gis/ /ye shes sku lnga'i 'od zer lcags kyu 'gyed/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i sems can sdug bsngal can/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che la bying ba rnams/ /rang byung lha mchog bde chen lha ru drongs/

/bdag gis rtse gcig thugs dam bskul ba'i mthus/ /mngon rdzogs bla med byang chub reg gyur cig / gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ bdag mdun dam ye dbyer ma mchis pa'i chos nyid kyi klong gcig tu snang stong kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i pad 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ thig le 'od mi 'gyur ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng 'khor bas 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba thams cad la mnyes mchod 'bul/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub rnam gnyis bdag dang rdzas la thig le dang thig phran 'od zer gyi tshul du thim pas/ snang srid rab 'byams thams cad kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba'i skur gyur te bdag gzhan 'od gsal chos nyid bde chen 'pho 'gyur med pa mngon du gyur par bsam/ om̐ dharma sa man+ta bha dra dzñā na hūm̐: zhes brgya stong du bzla'o/ /gsum pa phrin las bcol ba ni: bdag sogs las nyon 'khrul 'byams rnams/ /thog ma'i mgon po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /ka dag chos nyid lhun grub dbyings/ /gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog / bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā ba ling+ta rak+ta sarba pū dza khā hi/ lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ka dag skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas/ /gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don skur snang ba/ /kun bzang chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing*/ /gsal stong gnyis med mnyam bzhag skyil krung can/ /dbyings phyug dkar mo zung 'jug pang du 'khril/ /'gro ba'i don du ngang gyur lam me ba/ /kun bzang yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bzlas pa gnyis pa rigs lnga yab yum la/ dang po ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba'i rigs lnga yab yum gyi thugs kar rang rang thugs srog gi mthar sngags phreng 'khor bas ye shes lnga po lhun grub mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnams bdag la thob par

bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa/ bdag sogs dug lnga'i dbang gyur kun/ /rigs lnga yab yum dkyil 'khor du/ /ye shes lnga po lhun grub nas/ /sku lnga mngon gyur sangs rgyas shog / bzhi pa ni/ om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da pū dza khā hi/ lnga pa/ ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku yab/ /'byung lnga rnam dag rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum/ /ma 'gags rgyan rdzogs sna tshogs sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /rigs lnga yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bzlas pa gsum pa sems dpa' la sogs rol pa ni/ dang po ni/ phyi rol rtsa 'dab kyi sems dpa' sems ma thub pa drug sogs kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng spro bsdu'i tshul gyis 'khor bas mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag sogs phung khams skye mched rnams/ /yongs grol sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rang snang spros bral chos kyi dbyings/ /rgyal ba'i sras su sangs rgyas shog / bzhi pa ni/ om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs?nas shab+da pū dza khā hi/ lnga pa ni/ hūm̐/ sna tshogs ma 'gags rang byung pho brang nas/ /sgyu ma chu zla bzhin du sprul pa'i lha/ /zhi ba ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan gar sgyur bzhad pa'o/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem lang tsho'i mdangs dang ldan/ /yab yum dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ tshad med bzhi ldan rnam thar sgo bzhi skyong*/ /bzhad gshe khro la gar sgyur dgyes par byed/ /sgo ba yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bsdus pa ltar spyi dril gyi bzlas pa ni/ dang po ni/ bdag mdun gtso bo'i thugs srog dang sngags phreng las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pas 'khor tshogs zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du rang srog sngags kyi 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis snod bcud sbyang*/ /bdag gzhan gyi 'khrul rtog bag sgrib nyams chag thams cad sbyangs/ snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rol pa zag med bde chen kun tu bzang po'i gsang gsum mi zad ba brgyan gyi 'khor lor 'byams su klas par gyur par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa/ om̐ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes bzlas sngags ci 'grub bzla/ sham bu sdig sbyong ni/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ bdag sogs kyis bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyong dka' ba om̐ sarba pā paṃ badz+ra bi shwa dha ye swā hā/ gzhan yang las bzhi'i 'dod gsol bya/ gsum pa ni/ bdag sogs dug gsum sbyong dka'i dri ma kun/ /zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dmigs med rim gnyis sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis/ /yang dag sku gsum zhing du ye rdzogs shog / bzhi pa ni/ om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā bha ling+ta rak+ta sarba pū dza ho/ lnga pa ni/ hūm̐/ zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan dang cod pan du ma 'phur: rin po che dang mu tig rgyan gyis spras: zhi ba'i tshul dgu rdzogs shing yon tan ldan: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod: de nas bum pa bdud rtsi sgrub pa bskyed pa bzlas pa khrus gsol ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ om̐ swa bhā w sogs kyis sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rgya mtsho dwangs ba'i dbus su rgyu skar lhags pa'i rang bzhin ltar bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ rten bcud dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i thugs kar so so'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag med bcud kyis gang bar

mos/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā? sogs nas dharmā badz+ra hri da ya ga lak+ṣa pa da ra da ra hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: zhes pas bsgrub cing las bum bdud rtsi dang khrus chab sogs kha bsgyur bya'o/ /mchod pa ni/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs nas shab+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta māṃ sa rak+ta ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: gsum pa las bum thogs te/ hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag khyab brdal dkyil 'khor lha: sbyang dang dag par ye nas mi dmigs kyang : 'gro kun sgo gsum sgrib gnyis 'dag bya'i phyir: lha la khrus gsol spyan 'dren mchod par bgyi: om̐ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe? sogs nas/ hūm̐/ bum pa bzang po? sogs kyis lha la khrus gsol/ de nas bdag 'jug la khrus dang maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang sogs rim 'jug ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i mtshams sbyor 'di gter chen gyi dgongs pa ltar singhas sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ca) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dkar gtor 'dod yon char 'bebs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon la lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: dkar gtor bya ba'i rim pa ni: bse phor zangs snod rin chen snod: 'bru bcud gser skyems dkar gtor bcas: chu gtsang bran la 'di skad do: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma nāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na na twata om̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: om̐ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐: om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gser skyems mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las om̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: om̐ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ t sogs: om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: om̐ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐:

om̐ na maḥ sa man+ta bud+dha nam gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza te ma hā sa ma ya swā hā': om̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ om̐ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang : trām̐ las sna tshogs rat+na'i snod: hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs drug cur ldan: āḥlas ci 'dod phun sum tshogs: so so'i dga' mgu tshim byed pa: 'dod pa'i yo byad chen por gyur: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyi: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan la gnas pa yi: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad rgyu skar brgyad: sde brgyad sde dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis dang : phyogs skyong bcu dang sa bdag dmu sman dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs pa sde bcu gnyis: dpal gyi mgon po chen po bdun cu lnga: rgyal chen bzhi dang dus kyi skyong ma 'bum: mkha' la rgyu ba'i yid gzugs gzhi bdag dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba'i lha: skyes lha yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha: khyad par rin chen gter gyi srung ma dang : pha ri tshur kha g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ri: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gnas pa'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma bzhes: bdag gi legs nyes bya ba ci la yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di myur du stsol: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: las bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol myur du sgrubs: lo legs nad zhi sa phyogs bkra shis nas: dkar po dge bcu sgrub pa'i rogs dan sgrubs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pa la sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hiḥ zhes dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar 'bul zhing : bkra shis pa'i phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya:

gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: pad+ma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // cha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi cho ga bla med snying po bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma rgya gar mkhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: yang zab bcud mchog snying gi thig le las: na raka dong sprugs zhi khro'i gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed brda yis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang smon lam thob: khyad par lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mtha' med 'khor ba'i sems can las ngan rigs: mi dge'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zad mtha' med: rigs drug gang yang duḥkha'i rang bzhin nyid: mi bzod srid pa'i me 'obs dong chen du: lhung ste yun ring mnar med myong ba rnams: mthong thos dran rig thugs rje lcags kyu yis: bzod glags med par snying rje'i rtsal phyung bas: brtse chen rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'dren pa'i thabs: na raka dong sprugs cho ga 'di kho na: cho ga'i gsal 'debs tshig tsam thos pas grol: dkyil 'khor ngo sprod rgyud tsam mthong bas grol: bskyed rdzogs gnas lugs don tsam bsgoms pas grol: gzungs sngags snying po lus la btags na grol: byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i ro bcud myong tsam grol: theg chen lta ba'i dgongs pa gtad tsam grol: 'khor 'das chos sku'i rang bzhin ye nas grol: 'di ni thog ma'i kun bzang dgongs bzhed de: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas lam nyid rten 'brel gnad: sdig can btsan thabs mngon sangs rgyas pa'i chos: zhi khro 'dus pa'i cho ga 'di yin pas: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs: khyad par sdig can rnams la 'di nyid zab: yang mtha' long med skye 'chi dbang gyur tshe: nges don gshis lugs rtogs pa'i slob dpon gyis: 'di yi cho ga'i dkyil 'khor cha tshang rnams:

tshar gcig bsags pa'i bsod nams dge tshogs ni: rgya che nam mkha'i gting dpag gzhal dang mtshungs: rgya che'i theg pa gaṅgā'i bye ma yang : smod pa'i grangs ni brtsi bar tshad kyis rigs: 'di yi phan yon brjod par mi nus te: 'di ni lnga brgya tha mar dmigs gtad nas: bcud kyi yang snying gdams pa sbas pa yin: 'di dang 'brel tshad sangs rgyas thob pa ni: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pas lung yang bstan: de bas yang mtha' nyi shu'i bskal pa ru: lo tsā'i mchog gyur sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: skye ba rigs ldan o rgyan rtsa gsum gling : rig 'dzin thugs sras de la 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang las rim gyi sgrig chag 'god pa ni: dkyil 'khor sogs ni spyi dang mthun par bya: bskang rdzas mchod pa cha tshang gzhung bzhin bsham: dang po sngon 'gro dag gi rim pa ni: rdo rje slob dpon zhal kha shar du gyu: dkyil 'khor zhal yang gyu lugs gnyis 'dod de: rgyud sde'i lugs su zhal kha bdag la gyu: kun grol lugs su zhal kha ci bder bstan: bdag mdun la yang dbye ba gnyis yin te: bla med lugs la dus gcig bdag mdun tshang : gsar ma bya rgyud bdag mdun tshar gnyis te: 'di ni snga 'gyur theg chen gsha' mi lugs: bdag mdun cho ga dus gcig bskyed pas chog: sa ma ya: dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa ni: skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: gdod nas rang byung ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings: bya rtsol bral ba zang thal shar ba'i lha: kun tu rol pa cho 'phrul zhi khro'i dbyings: ma 'gags klong yangs shugs kyis bdag skyabs mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: na mo: bsam brjod bral ba blo bral ngang nyid las: 'khor 'das chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma nyid: bdag med gzugs brnyan chu zla'i snang tshul bzhin: ye nas gshis lugs de bzhin sems bskyed do: gsum pa bgegs gtor ni: hūm̐: nga nyid ye shes rol pa'i sku: ma bcos dpal chen he ru ka'i: thugs las snying rje'i sa bon 'phros: bar med 'od zer lcags kyus gang : mtshan mar blta ba'i bag chags bgegs: nga bdag ru tra'i tshogs rnams kun: ye grol mchod sbyin len pa'i slad: brdal khyab dbang gis 'dir 'dus shig: om̐ badz+ra dzñā na ro ṣa na hūm̐: mtshan 'dzin bgegs tshogs a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ thun brdeg cing : hūm̐: nyon cig ma rig nyon mongs bdud: snang ba bdag bzung bgegs kyi tshogs: gang shar 'dzin med gtor ma longs: bdag med chos sku'i klong du dengs: ci ste dgag sgrub 'gog srid na: bdag nyid 'od gsal snying po yis: ye shes lnga yi rtsal chen 'gyed:

kun brtags phung por thug phrad gtor: gnyug ma ro gcig gdams ngag 'debs: tha mal shes pa'i zhen pa bcom: de bas a 'thas phyir dengs shig: om̐ sarba e haṃ swa bhā dharma dhā tu ar+bhe badz+ra dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ nyon mongs shes sgrib u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: bzang ngan lta ba ma rig tshogs: ye nas gnyis med gshis lugs gcig: nga bdag re dogs las rlung kun: dbyings rig lta bas mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag gzhal yas khang : gzugs snang bud+dha zhi khro'i lha: phyi nang bar med mu mtha' khyab: gdod nas rang byung klong dgur gsal: om̐ badz+ra shān+tiṃ tsakra dhe wa ma hā dharma rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ drug pa phyi mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: sna tshogs dbang po'i yul la legs shar ba'i: gzung 'dzin tshogs drug sgyu ma sbyang ba'i phyir: bde chen rig ma bcu drug mchod sprin gtibs: snang stong zag med dga' bzhi'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: sogs shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti pū dza āḥhūm̐: bdun pa nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: blo 'das yangs pa kun gzhi bhan+dha ru: sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes bla med rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub rang byung don ston phyir: nang gi mchod pa ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ brgyad pa gsang ba'i mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: a haṃ 'khor lo lnga yi bhan+dha ru: bde stong sbyor bas zung 'jug rlung gis bsrubs: bskul bas chags med thabs shes dkar dmar babs: byang sems rdzas mchog ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: a haṃ pañtsa rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dgu pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: 'dus byas phung po dag pa'i gtor gzhong du: tshogs brgyad don snod lnga yi gtor ma bsham:

sgo dgu dbang po'i gtor kyus rgyan gyis spras: bha ling rmad byung ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ bcu pa sgrol mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: dran rig lta ba gnyug ma'i bhan+dha ru: nga bdag mtshan ma'i ru tra bsgral ba yi: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes rdzas kyis bkang : sgrol mchod bcud ldan ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta keṃ ni ri ti om̐ āḥhūm̐: bcu gcig pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong nas sgyu mar bzhengs pa'i thugs: kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur bas byin phob cig: longs sku'i mkha' las chu zla'i drwa ba can: rdor sems ye shes lnga ldan byin phob cig: sprul sku'i zer las 'gro ba'i dpal du shar: rig 'dzin pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig: sna tshogs cho 'phrul srid pa'i drwa ba bcom: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs byin phob cig: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs brda dkyil 'khor rgyas: drin can rtsa ba'i bla mas byin phob cig: om̐ sarba dharma kā ya badz+ra sa twa gu ru pad+ma kā ra dzi wan dza ya a be sha ya a dhiṣ+ṭha na phaiṃ phaiṃ: bcu gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: rig pa kun bzang klong las ma g.yos kyang : de don ma rtogs sems can ma rig tshogs: rmongs pa'i nyon mongs shes sgrib sgo bcad nas: dran rig gnyug ma yid kyi 'char sgo phyes: om̐ badz+ra bhi dho pra we sha ya phaṭḥ bcu gsum pa brda phyag bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon chad ma rig gnyis 'dzin dbang gis bsgribs: da ni rang byung lta ba'i lha zhal mjal: brda mchod bstod de sgyu mar rtogs pa'i phyir: phyin chad mi bgyid brda yis bshags par bgyi: om̐ badz+ra dharma ho shud+dhe āḥ bcu bzhi pa dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: kun snang thams cad rang rig zhi khro'i lha: 'byung 'jug 'phro 'du bskyed rdzogs sgyu ma'i ngang :

de don rtogs pas sgo gsum rtsol med kyis: dam tshig snying po mi g.yel srog ltar bsgrub: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hūm̐: de ni ting 'dzin rnam gsum la: kun rgyu rol pa'i rten 'brel nyid: skye med ngang nas gsal yang btab: sa ma ya: dang po kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: blo 'das chen po chos kyi dbyings: rang bzhin mtha' dbus med par khyab: gshis lugs snying po kun la gnas: thog ma'i mgon pos de ltar smras: om̐ dharma dzñā na badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: gnyis pa snang zhing bdag med pa'i ting 'dzin ni: āḥ zang thal rlung gis shugs 'byung ba: dngos dang dngos med de bzhin nyid: 'od gsal snying po 'dus ma byas: longs sku sems dpas de ltar smras: om̐ badz+ra sa twa dzñā na tsit+ta hūm̐: gsum pa shes rig rgyu'i ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: rgyu las bskyed pa'i 'od zer shar: lnga ldan lam la so sor grub: stong pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs gsal: dga' rab dgongs pas de ltar smras: om̐ badz+ra su khaṃ dzñā na shrī tsit+ta hūm̐: bzhi pa 'byung ba rim par brtsegs pa ni: hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten snod bcud kyi: bsdus byar snang ba 'byung ba'i tshogs: rang byung rlung gi sa bon las: stong pa'i mkha' nas rim par shar: om̐ badz+ra e khaṃ ga gā swa bhā hūm̐: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: pad+ma ti ra baṃ dzñā na hūm̐ hoḥ lnga pa rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: e las chos dbyings stong pa'i mkha': yam̐ las ye shes rlung chen g.yos: ram̐ las gtum mo'i me chen 'bar: kham̐ las byang sems bde ba rgyas: sum̐ las brdal khyab māṃ sa gzhi: keṃ las rus pa'i khrol bu ldem: bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang : paṃ las pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: ti las bdag med bam ro smug: hūm̐ las kun bzang yab yum sbyor: ho las sras 'khor la sogs bskyed: om̐ e s+pha ra ṇa mūm̐: yam̐ ha ra na tām̐: ram̐ dzñā na ya pām̐: kham̐ sa ra ṇa mām̐:

keṃ ka ra ṇa lām̐: bh+rūm̐ āt+ma ṇa phaṭaḥ paṃ pad+ma ṇa ti: hūm̐ rā ga ya dzaḥ baṃ sa ma ya hoḥ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ hrī hrī hrī hri'aḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: baṃ baṃ baṃ baṃḥ om̐ dharma dzñā na badz+ra sa ma ya a ho bh+rūm̐: drug pa gzhal yas bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag ye nas gzhal yas khang : mi shigs rdo rje'i rmang gzhi rgya gram bsnol: tshad med bzhi ldan gru bzhi sgo bzhir ldan: ye shes lnga ldan rtsig pa rim pa bzhin: tshogs drug rnam dag 'dod snam lha mo 'phro: nyon mongs tshogs 'joms pha gu drwa bas mdzes: shes byas ma gos mda' yab shar bu bskyod: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i g.yer kha'i 'phan dar 'phyangs: rnam thar brgyad ldan ka ba thabs shes gzhu: stong nyid bcu drug gshis lugs gdung ma bres: bslab pa bcu gnyis rnam dag dral lcam gtibs: rim dgu theg pa'i brdal khyab thog steng phub: lam bzhi mthar phyin rta babs rim par brtsegs: dbang po sgo dgu'-i mthongs skar nyi zlas brgyan: sa mchog bcu gsum chos 'khor gdugs dang tog: g.yul las rnam rgyal thog steng 'phan gdugs mdzes: tshogs drug sgyu mar rtogs pa'i cod pan 'phur: dug lnga rnam dag dur khrod rdo rwas bskor: ma rig tshogs 'joms me dpung 'khor yug mched: 'byung lnga rnam dag gter bum rin chen bzhi: mtshan nyid kun tshang pho brang gdod ma'i dbyings: longs sku'i mkha' la sgyu ma'i zhing khams ltar: 'ja' tshon chu zla'i snang tshul ji bzhin gsal: om̐ dharma dzñā na e khaṃ ga gā swa bhā tsit+ta hūm̐: bdun pa lha tshogs gsal gdab pa ni: hūm̐: de dbus seng khri nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: gdod ma'i gshis lugs ji bzhin bstan pa'i phyir: rang rig ka dag ngo bo yongs gyur las: hūm̐ yig mthing kha dri med nam mkha'i mdog: 'od lnga'i mdangs ldan gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: ma bcos lhun grub chos sku kun tu bzang : zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag skyil krung can:

yum mchog bzang mo dkar gsal pang du 'khyud: bde stong snang la rang bzhin med pa yi: sgyu ma chu zla'i ngang tshul ci bzhin bsgom: om̐ sa man+ta bha dra sam+bha hūm̐: hūm̐: rang nyid kun bzang yab yum gsal ba yi: tsit+ta drwa ba smug po'i 'od klong dbus: ye shes lnga yi zer thag dang bcas pa: tshom bu nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa yi: dbus su dran rig srog rlung ljang gu ru: gti mug rnam dag rin chen seng khri'i steng : rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin: dbyings phyug dmar mo bde stong yum dang sbyor: gshis lugs ngo bo ma bcos so mar bsgom: hūm̐: tsit+ta gsal ba'i sgron me 'od lnga'i klong : shar phyogs rtsa 'dab 'khor lo'i lte ba ru: zhe sdang rnam dag glang chen khri steng du: me long ye shes bcom ldan rdo rje sems: dung mdog phyag na rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: sangs rgyas spyan ma mthing skya sku la 'khril: g.yas su sa snying myu gu dril bu 'dzin: g.yon du byams pas klu shing dril bu 'dzin: mdun du lā s+ye dkar mos me long 'dzin: rgyab tu puṣ+pe dkar mos me tog 'dzin: thams cad dkar gsal snang stong ye shes ngang : ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: lho phyogs rtsa 'dab 'khor lo'i lte ba ru: nga rgyal rnam dag rta mchog khri steng du: mnyam nyid ye shes bcom ldan rin chen 'byung : gser mdog phyag na rin chen dril bu 'dzin: yum chen mā kī ser skya sku la 'khril: g.yas su kun bzang snyems mas dril bu 'dzin: g.yon du nam snying ral gri dril bu 'dzin: mdun du mā l+ye ser mos phreng ba 'dzin: rgyab tu dhū pe ser mos spos phor 'dzin: thams cad ser gsal bde stong ye shes ngang : ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: nub phyogs rtsa 'dab 'khor lo'i lte ba ru: 'dod chags rnam dag rma bya'i khri steng du: sor rtogs ye shes bcom ldan snang mtha' yas:

zangs mdog phyag na pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: yum chen gos dkar dmar skya sku la 'khril: g.yas su spyan gzigs pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: g.yon du 'jam dpal ral gri dril bu 'dzin: mdun du gīrti dmar mos pi waṃ 'dzin: rgyab tu ā lo dmar mos mar me 'dzin: thams cad dmar gsal grags stong ye shes ngang : ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: byang phyogs rtsa 'dab 'khor lo'i lte ba ru: phrag dog rnam dag shang shang khri steng du: bya grub ye shes bcom ldan don yod grub: mar gad mdog can rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: yum chen sgrol ma ljang skya sku la 'khril: g.yas su sgrib sel po ti dril bu 'dzin: g.yon du phyag rdor rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: mdun du gan+dhe ljang mos dung phor 'dzin: rgyab tu nīrti ljang mos zhal zas 'dzin: thams cad ljang gsal tshor stong ye shes ngang : ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: tsit+ta phyi yi rtsa 'dab rim pa bzhin: lha yi thub pa brgya byin pi waṃ dkar: lha min thub pa thag bzang go mtshon ljang : mi yi thub pa shāka thub gseg shang ser: byol song thub pa seṅge po ti mthing : yi dwags thub pa kha 'bar sgrom bu dmar: dmyal ba'i thub pa chos rgyal me chu nag: thams cad phar phyin drug ldan bzhengs pa'i stabs: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: tsit+ta phyi yi phyogs bzhir sgo skyong ba: rnam rgyal dkar mo lcags kyu dril bu 'dzin: gshin rje ser po dbyug to dril bu 'dzin: rta mgrin dmar po lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: bdud rtsi ljang gu rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: thams cad rang rang rigs mthun yum dang sbyor: tshad med rnam bzhi sgo skyong khro bo rngam: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: rang rig kun bzang yab yum gsal ba yi: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo lnga yi klong : 'ja' 'od thig le lu gu rgyud kyi dbus:

zag med dga' bzhi'i ye shes ngo bo'i steng : rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin 'od lnga'i mdangs: shar du sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin dkar: lho ru tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin ser: nub tu phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin dmar: byang du lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin ljang : thams cad khro 'dzum mdzes ldan gri thod 'dzin: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud brkyang bskum ling nge ba: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: longs spyod 'khor lo phyogs bzhi'i sgo skyong ma: rdo rje gar mos lcags kyu bhan+dha 'dzin: rin chen gar mos zhags pa bhan+dha 'dzin: pad+ma gar mos lcags sgrog bhan+dha 'dzin: las kyi gar mos dril bu bhan+dha 'dzin: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan sgo skyong chen mo bzhi: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: rang nyid kun bzang yab yum gsal ba yi: spyi bo bde chen pho brang 'khor lo yi: klad pa dung khang 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong steng : dpal chen che mchog mthing nag dkar dmar zhal: phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags bsnams: kro ti shwa ri khro mos sku la 'khril: dpal chen yab yum gsal ba'i thugs ka ru: hūm̐: bud+dha khrag 'thung smug nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri dgra satwa bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol bsnams: bud+dha kro ti shwa ris sku la 'khril: klad pa dung khang shar lho nub byang bzhir: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: hūm̐: badz+ra khrag 'thung mthing nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje bhan+dha dgra satwa dang : g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol bsnams: badz+ra kro ti shwa ris sku la 'khril: hūm̐: rat+na khrag 'thung ser nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ be con dang : g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar tri shul bsnams:

rat+na kro ti shwa ris sku la 'khril: hūm̐: pad+ma khrag 'thung dmar nag dkar sngon zhal: g.yas gsum pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to dang : g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung dang : pad+ma kro ti shwa ris sku la 'khril: hūm̐: karma khrag 'thung ljang nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to dang : g.yon gsum rnge'u chung bhan dmar thong gshol bsnams: karma kro ti shwa ris yum dang sbyor: khrag 'thung dpa' bo gar dgu'i cha byad can: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: klad pa dung khang 'bar ba'i rtsa 'dabs su: yul brgyad rtog pa rnam dag ngang nyid las: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rang rang gdan gyi steng : kau rī dmar mos zhing dbyug bhan+dha 'dzin: tsau ri ser mos mda' gzhu 'gengs shing 'phen: pra mo dmar mos chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar: bai ta ljang mos rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: puk+ka dmar ser rgyu ma 'dren zhing gsol: ghasma ljang nag rdo rjes bhan+dha dkrugs: tsaṇ+ḍa ser skyas tsit+ta baṃ chen za: sme sha mthing skyas bam ro mgo lus phral: kau rī gnas kyi ma mo chen mo brgyad: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: klad pa dung khang phyi yi rtsa 'dabs su: shes pa brgyad kyi ngo bo rnam par dag: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rang rang gdan gyi steng : siṃ ha smug nag seng gdong kha ro thogs: byā gṛ dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis bsnol: sri la nag mo wa gdong rgyu ma za: shwa na mthing nag spyang gdong bam ro 'drad: kri ta dkar ser rgod mgos zhing phrag gzer: kaṅka dmar nag kang mgos zhing chen khur: khā kha nag mo bya rog bhan gri gdengs: hu lu mthing skya 'ug gdong rdo rje 'dzin: siṃ ha ma brgyad rngam pa'i skur ston pa: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: klad pa dung khang phyi yi sgo skyong ma: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhir rim pa bzhin: stag gdong dkar mos lcags kyu bhan+dha bsnams:

phag gdong ser mos zhags pa bhan+dha 'dzin: seng gdong dmar mos lcags sgrog bhan+dha 'dzin: sbrul gdong ljang gus dril bu bhan+dha 'dzin: sgo ma rigs bzhi gar sgeg gshe ba'i tshul: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: rang nyid kun bzang yab yum gsal ba yi: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs su: gsang ba ye shes dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki ma: dmar gsal mdangs ldan dri med rā ga'i mdog: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas bhan+dha 'dzin: khro gtum mdzes ldan kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi'i rtsa 'dabs su: rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang : pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: thams cad rang mdog gtso mo'i cha lugs can: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan brkyang bskum gar stabs bsgyur: drug cu rtsa bzhi gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ma: seng gdong dkar mo'i phyag na lcags kyu bsnams: dom gdong ser mo'i phyag na zhags pa bsnams: dred gdong dmar mo'i phyag na lcags sgrog bsnams: spyang gdong ljang gu'i phyag na dril bu bsnams: thams cad phra men shugs 'gro ma mo'i tshul: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i mkha' klong du: stong gsal rtsa khams rnam dag lte ba'i dbus: rnal 'byor chen po gar gyi dbang phyug sku: mthing nag phyag na rdo rje dril bu bsnams: gar stabs brkyang bskum rnal 'byor dmar mo 'khril: phrin las dpa' bo rdo rje he ru kaḥ ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: bde skyong 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsa 'dabs su: zhi ba'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: srin mo dkar mo g.yag gdong rdo rje bsnams: tshangs pa dkar ser sbrul gdong pad+ma bsnams: lha chen dkar ljang gzig mgo tri shul bsnams: rtog 'dod dkar sngon sre gdong 'khor lo bsnams:

gzhon nu dkar dmar dred gdong mdung thung bsnams: brgya byin dkar mo dom mgo rgyu zhags bsnams: zhi ba'i ma bdun yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i lho yi rtsa 'dabs su: rgyas pa'i las byed rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: rdo rje ser mo pha waṃ spu gri bsnams: zhi ba dmar ser chu srin bum pa bsnams: bdud rtsi dmar ser sdig gdong pad+ma bsnams: zla ba dkar ser khra mgo rdo rje bsnams: be con ljang nag wa gdong dbyug tho bsnams: srin mo ser nag stag gdong thod khrag bsnams: rgyas pa'i ma bdun yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i nub kyi rtsa 'dabs su: dbang gi las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: za ba dmar mo rgod mgo be con bsnams: dga' ba dmar mo rta gdong khog chen thogs: stobs chen dmar skya khyung gdong dbyug tho bsnams: srin mo dmar mo khyi gdong rdo rje bsnams: 'dod pa dmar mo pu shud mda' gzhu 'gengs: nor srung dmar mo shwa mgo bum pa 'dzin: dbang gi ma bdun yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i byang gi rtsa 'dabs su: drag po'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: rlung lha ljang sngon spyang gdong ba dan 'phyar: mi mo dmar mo skyin mgo gsal shing 'dzin: phag mo ljang nag phag gdong mche zhags bsnams: dga' byed ljang nag khwa gdong baṃ ro bsnams: sna chen glang gdong ljang nag bam chen bsnams: chu lha ljang sngon sbrul gdong zhags pa bsnams: drag po'i ma bdun yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs sgo skyong ma: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhir rim pa bzhin: khu byug mgo can dkar mos lcags kyu 'dzin: ra yi mgo can ser mos zhags pa 'dzin: seṅge'i mgo can dmar mos lcags sgrog 'dzin: sbrul gyi mgo can ljang gus dril bu 'dzin: sgo skyong rim bzhin yid yul gsal bar bsgom:

hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs gsal 'tsher mdzes shing 'dzum: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem lang 'tsho rab tu rgyas: rigs lnga'i cod pan stod g.yogs dpung rgyan dang : snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub se mo do: dar dpyangs sku reg lha rdzas smad g.yogs dkris: zhi ba'i lha tshogs mdzes pa'i tshul dgu ldan: hūm̐: khro bo'i lha tshogs khrag 'thung mi bzad pa: rngam gshe gtum la 'jigs pa'i gad mo sgrog: stobs dang rtsal chen shugs 'chang dpa' bar 'gro: dur khrod chas brgyad 'bar ba'i gar dgu ldan: me 'od 'khrug cing dgyes pa'i chas rnams rdzogs: hūm̐: gzhan yang bar khyams 'khor yug rtsa gnas su: 'khod pa'i zhing skyong phra men sprul 'khor tshogs: 'bum phrag zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams: stong pa'i dbyings la 'ja' shar ci bzhin du: gnas lugs lta bas mi dmigs klong du gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gtso 'khor lha tshogs kyi: sku gsung thugs yon gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: ka dag dbyings nas gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ

dang po spyan 'dren pa ni: tshangs pa'i gdung dbyangs dag las 'di skad do: hūm̐: bsam brjod bral ba'i gshis lugs lta ba'i klong : phyogs lhung ris med brdal khyab pho brang nas: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: zang thal klong las 'gyu ba'i drwa ba ris: shes rig gar gyi nyams 'gyur pho brang nas: che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags zer las cho rol stobs bcu'i rtsal: dpa' 'bar brgyan cing shar ba'i pho brang nas: bka' gter skyong ba yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra dhe wa shān+tiṃ dhe wa kro ta dharma pā la ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: lta ba'i rgya mtsho mkha' dbyings gdod ma'i klong : sgom pa'i mtshan ma ris su ma chad pa'i: spyod pa 'khor gsum yongs dag bag yod can: 'bras bu gdeng ldan dran rig zhi khro'i lha: nam yang rnam rtog rlung gis mi bskyod par: ro gcig ting 'dzin de bzhin bzhugs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra rā sa e ka dharma tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos 'gags med klong yangs nas: sna tshogs dbang po'i lam la shar ba yi: bde chen rgyal po lhan skyes 'dus ma byas: stong gsal 'dzin med nam mkha'i 'khor lo can: mi rtog ye shes kun bzang zhi khro'i lha: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gcig 'dus phyir: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra bhi dho dharma swa bhā e haṃ na mo pū ru sha ya ho: bzhi pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: sna tshogs dbang po yid 'dzin gar mo'i gzugs: lang ling gang ba mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan ma: mnyes pa'i spyan gzigs mchod sprin thogs pa'i tshogs: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: lnga pa nang mchod las bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: rtog med bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i nang : sha chen rdzas chen sna tshogs legs sbyar nas: sbyangs shing spel ba'i bla med bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sman mchod sbyar mchan/ drug pa rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: nyon mongs rtsa mdud gsum gyi 'khor lo ru: mai tri bha wa'i rlung gis rab bskul ba'i: 'khor 'das gnyis med zung 'jug rak+ta 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la kha raṃ khā hi: bdun pa gtor mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phung khams 'dus byas dag pa'i gtor gzhong du: zhen med 'khor 'das ro gcig gtor ma bsham: tshogs brgyad dbang po rnam dag bkod pa 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ badz+ra bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: brgyad pa gsang mchod 'bul pa ni: hūm̐: cha shas shes rab lang tsho rgyas pa yi: chos 'byung kha la thabs kyis bsrubs bskyed nas: dkar dmar babs pa'i byang sems gsang mchod 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ badz+ra a haṃ pañtsa āḥhūm̐: dgu pa sgrol ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rig pa shes rab rdo rje phur pa yis: nga bdag mtshan ma'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: dug lnga'i sha khrag ye shes bsgyur ba'i tshogs: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bcu pa ye sbyor chen po'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: ye nas dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa yi: 'khor 'das nyag gcig mchod yul skong byed bral: gdod nas 'khor gsum yongs dag mchod pa 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul:

bzhes nas khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: om̐ swa bhā dharma e haṃ bhi dho pū dza hūm̐: bcu gcig pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos kyi sku la mtshan ma mi mnga' yang : āḥ 'gro ba'i don la so so'i skur ston pa: om̐: chu zla bzhin du mi dmigs dbyings la shar: hrīḥ bla ma chos sku bde chen 'dus ma byas: swāḥ skyon gyis ma gos yon tan kun rdzogs pa: hāḥ kun bzang chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: snang srid klong kun chos 'byung mkha' la shar: dbyings kyi bdag mo dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mdzod: nam mkha'i gos can gang la mi dmigs pa'i: chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas 'phrul mo che: yon tan mi zad gter chen rgya mtsho'i dpal: dbyings phyug kun tu bzang mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes rnam par snang mdzad sku: me long ye shes rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen 'byung ldan sku: sor rtogs ye shes snang ba mtha' yas sku: bya grub ye shes don yod grub pa'i sku: thog ma'i sangs rgyas lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bde chen dbyings phyug nam mkha' rnam par dag: sangs rgyas spyan ma sa khams rnam par dag: mā ma kī ni chu khams rnam par dag: gos dkar mo ni me khams rnam par dag: dam tshig sgrol ma rlung khams rnam par dag: rigs kyi yum gyur lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sa yi snying po gti mug rnam par dag: shes rab byams pa zhe sdang rnam par dag: kun tu bzang po nga rgyal rnam par dag: nam mkha'i snying po 'dod chags rnam par dag: spyan ras gzigs dbang phrag dog rnam par dag: 'jam dpal dbyangs ni nyon mongs rnam par dag: sgrib pa rnam sel sdug bsngal rnam par dag: phyag na rdo rje 'khor ba rnam par dag: byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: lā s+ye puṣ+pe mā l+ye dhū pe ma: gīrti ā lo gan+dhe nīrti ma: tshogs brgyad rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag:

sems ma brgyad kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thub pa brgya byin thag bzang shākya thub: seṅge rab brtan kha 'bar chos kyi rgyal: rigs drug gnas dag thub pa chen po drug: pha rol phyin pa drug la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'khrol: rtag chad mu bzhi rnam dag ngo bo nyid: sgo ba chen po bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rnam par smin dang sa gnas tshe la dbang : phyag rgya che dang lhun grub rig 'dzin lnga: phung po lnga nyid rnam dag ngo bo ste: rig 'dzin chen po lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rdo rje skyod byed bskul byed bde byed ma: rdo rje brda 'byin rdo rje 'bebs byed ma: khams lnga rnam dag gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro lnga: dpa' mo chen mo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rdo rje gar mo rin chen gar mo dang : pad+ma gar mo las kyi gar mo dang : lam bzhi grol mdzad dgyes pa'i dpa' mo bzhi: sgo ma mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: skye med ngang las shar ba'i he ru kaḥ 'gags med rtsal gyi cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skus: nyon mongs bsgral nas rak+ta zhal du gsol: che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bha ga'i klong nas snang srid cho 'phrul shar: 'khor 'das kun gyi rgyas 'debs bzhad pa mos: 'khor ba bsgral nas rak+ta zhal du gsol: gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gti mug khrag 'thung bud+dha he ru kaḥ zhe sdang khrag 'thung badz+ra he ru kaḥ nga rgyal khrag 'thung rat+na he ru kaḥ 'dod chags khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru kaḥ phrag dog khrag 'thung karma he ru kaḥ khrag 'thung khro bo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bud+dha kro tis ma rig khrag la 'thung : badz+ra kro tis bag chags khrag la 'thung : rat+na kro tis phung po'i khrag la 'thung : pad+ma kro tis rgyud drug khrag la 'thung : karma kro tis 'khor ba'i khrag la 'thung :

khrag 'thung khro mo rigs bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: kau rī tsau ri pra mo bai ta lī: puk+ka ghasma tsaṇ+ḍa sme sha lī: yul brgyad 'dzin pa 'joms pa'i khrag 'thung ma: kau rī ma mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: siṃ ha byā gṛ sri la shwa na ma: kri ta kaṅka khā kha hu lu ma: shes brgyad 'dzin pa 'joms pa'i khrag 'thung ma: siṃ ha ma mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: stag gdong phag gdong seng gdong sbrul gdong ma: snying rje byams pa dga' ba btang snyoms tshul: tshad med bzhi ldan 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sgo ma chen mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dga' ba mthar ru phyin: rdo rje mkha' 'gro mchog dga' mtha' ru phyin: rin chen mkha' 'gro dga' bral mtha' ru phyin: pad+ma mkha' 'gro dga' chen mtha' ru phyin: las kyi mkha' 'gro dga' bral mtha' ru phyin: drug cu rtsa bzhi gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: gtso mo lnga yi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: seng gdong spyang gdong dom gdong dred gdong ma: rnam thar lam bzhi'i sgo dbye pho nya mo: sgo skyong chen mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal: nam mkha'i mdog can dpa' bo he ru kaḥ phrin las rdo rje gzhon nur phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: shes rab kun gyi las bdag bskyed pa yi: mas brtan 'khor lo gsum gyi gtso mo ste: rgyas 'debs yum chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: g.yag gdong sbrul gdong gzig gdong sre mong gdong : dred gdong dom gdong la sogs ma mo bdun: zhi ba'i rnal 'byor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: pha waṃ chu srin sdig gdong khra yi gdong : wa gdong stag gdong la sogs ma mo bdun: rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rgod gdong rta gdong khyung gdong khyi yi gdong : pu shud gdong dang shwa gdong ma mo bdun: dbang gi rnal 'byor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: spyang gdong skyin gdong phag gdong khwa gdong dang : glang chen gdong dang sbrul gdong ma mo bdun: drag po'i rnal 'byor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khu byug ra gdong seng gdong sbrul gdong ma: skye gnas rnam bzhi'i sgo gcod las byed ma: las kyi sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul las: sna tshogs ma nges snang tshul cir yang ston: dam tshig las kyi mtha' sdud srung ma'i tshogs: yongs rdzogs bka' skyong bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: de ltar bstod cing thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: yang gsang bla med zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: thugs rje mi zad shugs kyi rtsal phyungs la: 'khor ba na raka dong nas sprugs pa yi: snying rje smon lam lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: dzap bskul dang bsnyen dmigs zur gsal ltar bya/ kun bzang yab yum gyi bsnyen pa ni: om̐ sa man+ta bha dra muṃ hri swā hā: rigs lnga la: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sems dpa' yab yum dang thub pa la: om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa aṣ+ṭa kro ta muṃ mu ne ye swā hā: che mchog khro bo rnams la: om̐ badz+ra shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri tāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ༈ skabs su 'dzab dbyangs bya te rol mo 'khrol: hūm̐: rang rig kun tu bzang po'i sku: kha dog bral ba'i sems la ltos: sna tshogs 'gyu ba stong pa nyid: āḥ rang rig longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: zang thal 'gags med sems la ltos: cir snang gzugs tshogs sgyu ma'i ngang : om̐: rang rig che mchog he ru kaḥ bdag med cho 'phrul sems la ltos: rtog med zhi khro dngos 'dzin bral: rang byung 'dzab kyi sngags sgra sgrog: ka dag ye shes dbyings nas bskul: spro bsdu'i 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: bla med byang chub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐:

zhes dzapa ྄dbyangs bya: spyi'i bsnyen pa ni: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: las kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sngags ni: om̐ sarba durga ti pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya sarba duḥkha tshin+dha tshin+dha shud+dhe shud+dhe bi shud+dhe ye swā hā: nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sngags ni: om̐ sarba pā paṃ shwa dha ya ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ye swā hā: shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sngags ni: om̐ sarba ma ma hri ṭhā bi shud+dhe mo ha mo ha a wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe ye swā hā: zhes las sngags dang sgrib sbyong rnams ci 'grub tu bzla bar bya'o: de nas bka' gter srung gang dgos 'don srol yod mthar hūm̐ bh+yo bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho sogs/ de nas phyag rabs dug lnga rang grol/ zhi khro'i thun mong spyi'i bshags pa/ lta ba'i klong bshags/ ru tra'i smre bshags bcas 'don/ de nas tshogs gtong ba ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gyis lan gsum sbyang : om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis rgyas par spel: 'di nyid ting 'dzin bla med lugs ltar na: phyi nang dgos pa don bzhi shes so: hūm̐: stong nyid ye shes snying po las: tshogs gnyis rgyu 'bras mtha' las 'das: bzang ngan lha 'dre mi dmigs shing : chos rnams sgyu mar ston par nges: mchod yul sbyin mkhan stong pa nyid: blo 'das tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor: om̐ dharma dhā tu ga ṇa tsakra om̐ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥbadz+ra gu h+ya dzñā na pañtsa hūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs sbyang ba ni: hūm̐: stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: snod bcud srid pa'i gzugs snang tshogs su bshams: 'khor 'das mi dmigs yig 'brus byin gyis rlobs: bde stong bla med ye shes chen por gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: gsum pa tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong chen rab 'byams pho brang nas: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams:

zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags stobs bcu'i rtsal 'gyed pho brang nas: che mchog khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gzi byin me ltar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: bka' sdod gter srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs gzi brjid spungs se spung : khro bo'i lha tshogs gad mo ya la la: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i glu gar khyugs se khyug: chos skyong dam can las byed sha ra ra: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob: dam rdzas tshogs la ting 'dzin bcud mchog spel: 'dir 'dus dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' 'gengs pa'i tshogs: gar mo brda sgyur lang ling mdzes ma 'phro: la la'i phyag na nyi zla'i snod mchog thogs: la la'i phyag na gser dngul snod mchog thogs: la la'i phyag na zangs lcags bhan+dha thogs: thams cad 'dod yon tshogs kyi dbang pos bkang : dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir phyag rgya gar gyis mchod: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas zhi khro'i bskang mchod byin rlabs kyi pra khrid dang*/ rgyud bskang ka dag rang grol/ brda bskang chen mo bcas 'don mchan/ drug pa bskang ba ni: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: dngos 'byor yid sprul las byung bas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin tshogs: dpag med blo yis blangs pa yis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bdun pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: lta ba klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bshags: sgom pa 'khor 'das ris med klong du bshags: spyod pa rgya yan shar grol klong du bshags: rnam rtog thams cad chos sku'i klong du bshags: 'khor ba thams cad mya ngan 'das par bshags: sdug bsngal thams cad bde ba chen por bshags: dug lnga thams cad ye shes rol par bshags: ma rig nyon mongs ka dag ngang du bshags: re dogs spang blang ye grol ngang du bshags: bzang ngan bag chags du ma ro gcig bshags: bshags dang bshags yul gnyis med klong du hoḥ om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ bud+dha sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dharma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ saṃ gha sa twa hūm̐: om̐ bo dhi sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ma hā sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dzñā na sa twa hūm̐: brgyad pa tha ma liṅga bsgral ba ni: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi:

lha tshogs dam can chos skyong srung ma yi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus rtsal gyis: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: ma nyes bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs dang : khyad par ngan song g.yang du 'khrid pa yi: tshe rabs snga phyi'i lan chags nyon mongs bdud: thar lam dkar po'i chos la bar gcod pa'i: smon lam ngan pas 'brel ba'i bdud rigs rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab steng 'og bcu: gru chad bar khyams 'khor yug gar gnas kyang : snying nas zungs shig stag gdong lcags kyu ma: ske nas chings shig phag gdong zhags pa ma: yan lag sdoms shig seng gdong lcags sgrog ma: myos par gyis shig sbrul gdong dril bu ma: dbang po bcom zhig ma mo kau rī ma: gzugs phung stor cig ma mo tsau ri ma: snying khrag drongs shig ma mo pra mo haḥ bla tshe phrol cig ma mo bai ta lī: 'dus byas gtor cig ma mo puk+ka si: phye mar rlog cig ma mo ghasma ri: lhag med gzhoms shig ma mo sme sha lī: om̐ ma mo ya ma tri shag dza dzaḥ nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dgu pa dgra bo lha dang phye zhing rol stobs rngam stabs ni: hūm̐: sdig can bdud dgra dam nyams las ngan 'di: lha dang phyes shig ma mo siṃ ha ma: bdud dang sprod cig ma mo byā gṛ ma: byad du chugs shig ma mo sri la ma: rmug par gyis shig ma mo shwa na ma: rengs par gyis shig ma mo kri ta ma: bsgral bar gyis shig ma mo kaṅka ma: skem par gyis shig ma mo khā kha ma: rgyal bar gyis shig ma mo hu lu ma: dus la bab bo gnas kyi ma sring tshogs: da lta nyid du phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma tri ya mu kha li aṣ+ṭa ya dgra bo phyes rbad nan nan: bcu pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra kī la ya: rab 'jigs phyag na rdo rje phur pa 'dril: nyon mongs dgra bgegs dug lnga ru tra yi: dkar nag snying gi mtshams su kī la ya:

bsgral zhing gtubs nas ming yang med par mdzod: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed ru tra ya ma du na myog thum rbad rbad: ces gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal phyes shig: nyon mongs dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: bzhes nas rigs drug sa bon stongs par mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: zhes dkyil 'khor la 'bul zhing bdud rtsis bran: mar me'i smon lam bar do'i rtsa tho thos grol chos spyod na raka mtsho skem sogs 'don/ bcu gcig pa dngos grub rol pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: dam tshig 'dod rgu 'byung ba yi: zab mo ting 'dzin dngos grub 'di: rtsa ba don chen gnang bar stsol: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni ya mtshan rmad byung rdzas: gnas lugs bdag 'dzin bral ba'i phyir: bram ze khyi phag gdol pa bzhin: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: a la la hoḥ pū dza hoḥ bla ma thugs drin che: tshogs 'khor ya mtshan che: 'dir tshogs smon lam ldan: sbyin bdag skal ba bzang : zhes pas dga' ston dang bcas nas rol: bcu gcig pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: bla ma rig 'dzin phud la mnyes: bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyu: yi dam che mchog tshogs la dgyes: mtha' ma lhag mas mi brngan rgyu: dbang phyug laṅka lhag ma nyul: bzang ngan gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: chos nyid don la rgyu 'bras gcig: byin rlabs kha phrus mi bran rgyu: sngon nas 'da' ka'i dam tshig gcig: dkyil 'khor mtha' la mi bzhag rgyu: las byed pho nya'i tshul du gnas: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: ye shes ḍāk+ki chos kyi dbyings su bzhugs:

ma mo drug ni thabs kyi sku ru shar: dkar mo dung gi thor tshugs ldems se ldem: so so'i g.yog 'khor ma mo bye ba 'bum: phyag na bhan+dha'i gzhong thogs gtor len mas: lhag gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: ye shes ḍāk+ki chos kyi dbyings su bzhugs: ma mo drug ni thabs kyi sku ru shar: ser mo gser gyi thor tshugs ldems se ldem: so so'i g.yog 'khor ma mo bye ba 'bum: phyag na bhan+dha'i gzhong thogs gtor len mas: lhag gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: ye shes ḍāk+ki chos kyi dbyings su bzhugs: ma mo drug ni thabs kyi sku ru shar: dmar mo byi ru'i thor tshugs ldems se ldem: so so'i g.yog 'khor ma mo bye ba 'bum: phyag na bhan+dha'i gzhong thogs gtor len mas: lhag gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: ye shes ḍāk+ki chos kyi dbyings su bzhugs: ma mo drug ni thabs kyi sku ru shar: ljang mo g.yu yi thor tshugs ldems se ldem: so so'i g.yog 'khor ma mo bye ba 'bum: phyag na bhan+dha'i gzhong thogs gtor len mas: lhag gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang gnas nyul laṅka phra men ma: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim zhing tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing ro la za: skyogs bzang bhan+dha thogs shing rak+ta 'thung : zas bzang sha chen za zhing srod la nyul: dam tshig bka' bzhin bsgrub phyir mkha' la 'gro: don la chos dbyings ḍāk+ki'i sprul pa yang : thabs kyis cho 'phrul gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba ma tri ma tri ya tri ya tri i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin dbyings nas cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i sku:

bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i klong nas brtse bas skur bzhengs shig: snying rje drag po'i rtsal chen thogs med kyis: gzi byin 'gro ba'i don du dpal 'gyed la: mtha' yas sems can 'dren pa'i dus la bab: hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nas: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: 'bar ba khrag 'thung lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs nas: ye shes lnga yi nus rtsal deng 'dir phyungs: rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i shugs 'chang stobs bcu bskyed: ting 'dzin gar dgu rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston: mi bzod snying rje lcags kyus 'gro ba drongs: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: gnas ngan rigs drug stong pa'i dus la bab: nyon mongs tshad gdung sel ba'i dus la bab: srid pa'i sa bon gzhom pa'i dus la bab: las ngan duḥkha sbyong ba'i dus la bab: bag chags 'khri ba gcod pa'i dus la bab: ma dag skye sgo khegs pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: byams mgon khyed kyis thugs rje ma 'byin na: mtha' yas sems can blo gtad gang zhig bgyi: de bas byin rlabs dus las ma 'da' bar: da lta nyid du snying rje'i shugs phyungs la: rigs drug las ngan dbang du shor ra re: gnas ngan duḥkha'i yul du gtong ra re: ye grol gshis lugs gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma dhā tu ghar+bhe hūm̐ āḥ.i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: chos skyong gtor 'bul mthar dbyung*/ gnyis pa chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min mkha' spyod mngon dga' ru: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum gyis: 'khor 'das ris med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rtog pa snga ma'i rang gzugs 'gyu nas su: rtog pa phyi mas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin:

ro gcig lta ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gshis lugs gang shar bzo med ma chad dam: cir snang chos skur blta bar ma chad dam: rig pa rang tsho zin par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og longs sku'i tha tshig gnyis pa ru: rnam par snang mdzad rdor sems yab yum gyis: rtsal snang 'gyu ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ye shes rigs lnga'i rang rtsal shar ba las: zhi ba'i tshogs gyur khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: gnyis bsdus sgyu ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: tshogs drug gang shar 'dzin med ma chad dam: spyod pa rgya yan lhug bzhag ma chad dam: 'bras bu 'khor gsum yongs dag ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og gsang chen me ri 'bar ba ru: yang dag che mchog khro bo yab yum gyis: khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: khro bo'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar shar nas kyang : rol pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams kyis khas blangs bzhin: zung 'jug bden gnyis gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bskyed rdzogs sgyu mar sbyong bar ma chad dam: rang lus dkyil 'khor ngo sprod ma chad dam: snang srid zhing khams shes par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og brag dmar bsam yas mchims phu ru: slob dpon chen po pad 'byung yab yum dang : sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs grogs gsum gyis: kun bzang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: chos skyong gnyer gtad rang gzugs bstan nas su: bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bka' yi bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: gnyer gtad tha tshig skyong bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: pad+ma bkod kyi ya 'brog mtsho gling du: rig 'dzin pad+ma gter bdag gling pa dang : gsang ba'i rig ma seng gdong mkha' 'gro gnyis: rgya mtsho'i klong nas gter sgrom bton pa'i tshe: gter srung pho nyas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab gter gnyan gyi bya rar ma chad dam: ma rungs bdud rigs bsgral bar ma chad dam: las kyi bka' skyong mel tsher ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: ma mo chen mo mi bzad 'jigs pa bzhi: gnod sbyin chen mo ma mo dgyes pa bzhi: sman mo chen mo na chung mdzes ma bzhi: lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' sku la gsol: g.yer kha sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: sna tshogs dar dpyangs cod pan pu ru ru: phyag mtshan rgyan ldan mang po khro lo lo: glu len gar mo'i bshugs sgra tse re re: yang 'khor sprul pa ma sring bye ba 'bum: so so'i gzugs dang cha lugs ma nges 'khor: rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'gyed pa'i las byed tshogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags zab chos gnyan gyi mel tshe gyis: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma mo ting ting shag duṃ pa le sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bla med gdod ma'i rig pas bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i bag chags rang sar grol: phyogs med khri rkang zlum pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rang snang dran rig 'gyu bas bro brdungs pas: rnam rtog phra rags sbom gsum rang sar grol: zhi khro 'dus pa'i pho brang dkyil 'khor du: gsang ba kun 'dus lha tshogs bro brdungs pas:

nyon mongs rigs drug duḥkha ka nas dag: rdo rje mched lcam 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rig 'dzin rnams kyis glu blangs bro brdungs pas: ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas ngan rang sar grol: bro ni bde stong ye shes chen po'i bro: glu ni ma 'gags gsungs dbyangs drug cu'i glu: ka dag rang byung glu blang bro brdungs pas: mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs sangs rgyas myur thob shog: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: sa ma ya nan: zhes gtor gzhong gyen du phyogs la me tog 'thor: lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: bde chen mkha' dbyings klong yangs dkyil 'khor nas: zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po'i rgyud bskul la: dbang dang dngos grub mchog gnyis stsal du gsol: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: om̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang bzhi blang : mchod bstod dang brtan bzhugs bya/ drug pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ zhi khro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: snang stong grags stong bde stong ngang nyid las: dgongs pa zang thal ye shes dbyings su hoḥ ma skyes mi 'gags gdod ma'i klong du āḥ a a āḥ

zhes pas ka dag rang byung gi dbyings su bsdu: bdun pa bsngo ba ni: hoḥ snod bcud thams cad rang rig dkyil 'khor lha: 'khor 'das sems can mtha' yas sangs rgyas shing : gang shar ngo bo dran rig chos sku'i ngang : ma bcos so ma shes pa bun ne ba: ji bzhin lta ba rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis: sgyu ma lta bu'i bya rtsol rab rdzogs nas: brtson 'grus rlung gis le lo mi 'byung zhing : kun brtags ma rig srid pa'i mtsho sgrol te: tha snyad bsdu bya'i bag chags g.ya' bral te: mtha' yas 'gro kun dran shes bag yod bsten: kun tu 'od kyi sa mchog 'thob bya'i phyir: bgrang yas bsags pa'i dge tshogs nam mkha'i khyon: rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed rgya mtsho 'di: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen po'i ngang du bsngo: brgyad pa smon lam ni: hoḥ klong yangs rig pa nam mkha'i mdzod chen gyi: dgongs pa zab mos gdul bya'i sems can rnams: nam yang mi 'khrul ting 'dzin gzungs thob nas: 'od gsal chen po'i ye shes rtsal rdzogs nas: nyon mongs rlung gis rtag tu mi bskyod par: theg chen zab mo'i nyams len mthar phyin zhing : kun rtog ma rig bud shing ka dag pas: thog ma'i mgon po'i dgongs pa der rdzogs shog: ces smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyar bya: dgu pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur: gnas lugs ye grol mthar phyin bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rigs lnga bde bar gshegs: gang shar bde stong rol pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : brgyud 'dzin smin cing grol ba'i bkra shis shog: brda brgyud bkra shis dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mas: gsang mdzod snying po mngon pa'i bkra shis shog: bla ma'i bkra shis rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsal: snyan brgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis che mchog he ru kas: mngon gyur ting 'dzin 'char ba'i bkra shis shog:

mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis gnam zhal dbyings phyug mas: dkyil 'khor 'khor los dbang bsgyur bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis legs ldan phyag bzhi pas: bstan pa'i bya ra 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis ma gza' rdo rje legs: zab chos bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis sbas yul yar 'brog mtshos: yul gru bkra shis dge legs 'grub par shog: ces bkra shis kyis mtshams sbyar ba gang yang bya chog: sa ma ya: e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang snying kun gyi gdams pa gcig dril las: zhi khro'i cho ga na raka dong sprugs bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal yi ge'i brda ru gzugs: sangs rgyas ye shes mi brjed yid la zungs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' snyigs ma lnga yi dus: mi rnams blo sems bdud dang rkyen gyis g.yeng : de yi shugs las rnam smin rang sar 'khor: sdig spyod rnams la bstod pa'i rgyan bzang 'dogs: chos bzhin spyod par dma' 'bab zhan por mthong : dam tshig can la 'dun pa'i sems ldan dman: mos gus sa bon zhe sdang me yis bsreg: thar pa'i 'ju thag chags sdang spu gris gcod: tshe rabs rten mkhar nyon mongs thog gis bshig: dge med sdig can las kyi sems can rnams: rigs drug mnar med na raka 'dam du tshud: de phyir dong nas sprugs pa'i gdams ngag mchog: skong bshags cho ga zab mo 'di nyid gces: 'di nyid mthong thos dran pa'i sems can rnams: sdig can ma bsgoms sangs rgyas gdams pa ste: kun gyi nang nas zhi khro 'di nyid gtso: 'brel tshad sangs rgyas thob par lung yang bstan: 'di nyid ye nas rang la gnas pa'i phyir: ngo sprod tsam gyis rang rig ngo shes nas: snang srid thams cad bud+dha'i zhing du 'char: nam yang dran pa mi brjed gzungs thob ste: sangs rgyas zhing du phyir mi ldog par 'gyur: de bas zab pa'i mthar thug man ngag 'di: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la:

skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: bdud rigs dam nyams lag tu ma shor rgya: srog bdag ki kang gza' bdud rā hu las: zab chos 'di yi bya ra lhang lhang gyis: sbas yul ya 'brog g.yu mtshoṛ atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas/ lcags byi lor sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi byang sgo sbas yul ya 'brog mtsho nas khrom gter ya mtshan can du bgyis te/ chu pho stag gi lor zla ba dang po'i tshes la shog ser nas dag par rten 'brel dang bcas nas grub pa'o// //nang gi mchan bu rnams gter slob kun dga' blo gros kyi 'don zin ltar bkod la go rim gcus dkrug 'ga' zhig bsrangs te/ legs par bsdebs nas 'don bde bar byed po gu h+ya'o// // ja) bdud rtsi lag mchod ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po de mchod do om̐ ā hūm̐: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkhas pa shrī singha de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: bka' bab rig 'dzin rnam brgyad de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku o rgyan rig 'dzin de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: dag pa rig 'dzin lha tshogs de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐:
