'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos skyong mgon po phyag bzhi de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: las mgon bya rog gdong can de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma mo sngags kyi bdag mo de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: bstan srung gza' bdud 'bar ba de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: skyes bu dam can rdor legs de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan de mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub de: skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: rgyas pa bla ma rig 'dzin nang du shes so// // nya) zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi cho ga bla med snying po'i dzap la/ thog mar dzap khang dbye ba ni/ brgyud 'debs nas bstod pa'i bar gtong*/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed la/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /zhes se gol gtog /de nas dzap bskul ba ni/ spos rol snyan dbyangs dang ldan pas 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ ye rdzogs 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor nas/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas su/ /ma chags skyon bral bde stong pad zla'i steng*/ /ma bcos ka dag kun bzang yab yum dang*/ /ma skyes rang shar zhi ba dbyings kyi lha/ /rol rtsal 'bar ba khrag 'thung sprul 'khor bcas/ /sku ni mi g.yo zang thal phyi nang bral/ /gsung ni mi 'gags 'dzab dbyangs rgyun chad med/ /thugs rje'i klong yangs 'gags med shugs 'byung gis/ /ye shes sku lnga'i 'od zer lcags kyu 'gyed/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i sems can sdug bsngal can/

/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che la bying ba rnams/ /rang byung chos dbyings bde chen zhing du drongs/ /bdag gis rtse gcig thugs dam bskul ba'i mthus/ /mngon rdzogs bla med byang chub reg gyur cig / bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag nyid kun tu bzang po'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' rnam snang gi thugs kar hūm̐ mthing kha dang*/ dung khang du che mchog he ru ka'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ zhi khro so so'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros/ bdag dang mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ gnyis ka'i thugs srog dang sngags phreng las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros/ rgyal ba mchod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par char babs pa ltar byung*/ bdag mdun rten rdzas la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud sbyangs/ thams cad dam pa rigs brgya'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gyur nas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bsams la/ dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang sbyar te bzla/ kun bzang yab yum gyi bsnyen pa ni: om̐ sa man+ta bha dra muṃ hri swā hā: rigs lnga la: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sems dpa' yab yum dang thub pa la: om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa aṣ+ṭa kro ta muṃ mu ne ye swā hā: che mchog khro bo rnams la: om̐ badz+ra shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri tāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sogs ci nus dang gtso bo spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes pa'i rtsa bsnyen 'di gtso bor bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas las sbyor sham bu rnams 'dogs mos na zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sham bu kha bsgyur ba ni: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ

om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang de bzhin du 'og ma la'ang 'gre sbyar/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor drug thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: khams gsum srid gsum gyi yon tan thams cad dbang du 'dus par gyur cig pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs dang gnod byed dug lnga thams cad mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces bzla/ dmigs bsal gzhan don gnas lung sogs las la sbyor tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ bdag gzhan gyi dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar gyur/ las kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sngags ni/ yi ge brgya pa'i sham/ om̐ sarba durga ti pa ri shwa dha rā dza ya sarba duḥkha tshin+dha tshin+dha shud+dhe shud+dhe bi shud+dhe ye swā hā: nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sngags ni: om̐ sarba pā paṃ shwa dha ya ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ye swā hā: shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sngags ni: om̐ sarba ma ma hri ṭhā bi shud+dhe mo ha mo ha a wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe ye swā hā: zhes las sngags dang sgrib sbyong rnams ci 'grub bzla zhing bye yung la phus gdab/ de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ om̐ bh+rūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐: ho paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa: de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las bum pa gzhal yas khang phyi nang zang thal mtha' dbus tshad dang bral bar: lto ba che zhing zlum pa: mchu 'phyang la g.yel ba: zhabs zhum la mdzes pa: kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing dang sgro mdangs me long rdo rje gzung gi thag pa dung dmar bdud rtsi dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la: chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing ka: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i pang du yum kun tu bzang mos gnyis med 'khril ba:

rgyal ba zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa: phyi'i sgo srung bdud rtsi 'khyil ba hūm̐ mdzad dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang ldan pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes dbang bskur zhing lus gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur: om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rang gi thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la 'khril te bum nang gi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab pas bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces bum pa bskyed cing spyi dril gyi sngags bzla/ de nas las bum sgrub pa ni/ las bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ la yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ yig brgya nyer gcig tsam bzla/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod bcas grub rjes/ mchod yon gyi chu phul bas bum lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ de nas thun mtshams su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa lhun grub dbyings klong nas: zhi ba yab yum lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang rten 'brel dam tshig nyams pa bshags: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang : sna tshogs phrin las lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig:

om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul zhing las bzhi'i phrin las bcol/ bdag nyid 'jug pa'i ched du rigs pa'i me tog dor zhing gnang ba zhu ba sogs cho ga spyi ltar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar cho ga'i yan lag la med du mi rung bas dgos mkhor dmigs te gzhung dang rigs mthun gzhan las cung zad btus nas/ kha bsgyur sogs byed po gnam lcags gsang sngags kyis bgyis pas yi ge'i 'du byed 'phan sprul pas bgyis pa'o// // ta) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i phyag rabs dug lnga rang grol ye shes snying po bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: shes bya'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du: rtsa mdud brkyang bskum gar gyi 'khrul 'khor la: legs brten sgo gsum bag chags sbyong byed bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yig ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs sras de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: brgya phyag 'bul ba'i rim pa ni: rdo rje mched lcam la sogs rnams: dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir rim pa bzhin: langs te thal mo sbyar byas nas: gdung bas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab:

hoḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rnams: brtse bas dgongs shig thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: ma dag g.yang sa che las bsgral du gsol: bdag cag tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig sgrib tshogs: da lta nyid du sbyang bar byin gyis rlobs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: de nas thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: bdag lus phung po 'dus byas sgyu ma 'di: shes sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyang slad du: rtsa khams zhing khams lha ru mos byas nas: rtse gcig gdung ba drag pos phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dang po phyag rgyas spyi bor brgyan pa yis: 'og min mkha' spyod zhing khams mthong bar shog: gnyis pa phyag rgyas mgrin par brgyan pa yis: bkod pa rab rdzogs zhing khams mthong bar shog: gsum pa phyag rgyas snying gar brgyan pa yis: rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: bzhi pa phyag ni so sor bral ba yis: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: lnga pa sor bcu sa la sbyar ba yis: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: drug pa mgo bos sa la reg pa yis: bde ba can gyi zhing khams mthong bar shog: bdun pa pus mgo sa la reg pa yis: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: brgyad pa rkang mthil sa la gtad pa yis: ngan song rigs drug skye sgo chod par shog: dgu pa rtsa mdud dgye sgu byas pa yis: sa lam rim dgu yongs su rdzogs par shog: bcu pa yan lag brkyang bskum byas pa yis: sa bcu theg chen yongs su rdzogs par shog: bcu gcig gcer bur 'phar zhing brdebs pa yis: zhing khams lha yi rang ngo 'phrod par shog: bcu gnyis sgrib sbyong mtha' ru phyin pa yis: gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtsal chen mthong bar shog: rlung sems dbyer med bsres pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: thog ma'i sangs rgyas dgongs pa yongs rdzogs shog:

de nas kun bzang zhi ba'i phyag rabs ni: hūm̐: seṅge'i khri steng gti mug rnam par dag: sku mdog mthing nag mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: thog ma'i sangs rgyas sku la phyag 'tshal lo: pad+ma'i khri steng ma rig rnam par dag: sku mdog mthing skya thabs shes phyag rgya 'chang : dbyings phyug bzang mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nyi zla'i khri steng ma rig rnam par dag: sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin: rnam par snang mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal lo: glang chen khri steng zhe sdang rnam par dag: dung mdog phyag na rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mchog khri steng nga rgyal rnam par dag: gser mdog phyag na rin chen dril bu 'dzin: rin chen 'byung ldan sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rma bya'i khri steng 'dod chags rnam par dag: zangs mdog phyag na pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: 'od dpag med mgon sku la phyag 'tshal lo: shang shang khri steng phrag dog rnam par dag: mar gad mdog can rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: don yod grub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: nam mkha'i khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: rā ga'i mdog can 'khor lo bhan+dha bsnams: yum chen dbyings phyug sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sa yi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: baiḍūr mdog can rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: chu yi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: swa na'i mdog can rin chen bhan+dha bsnams: mā ma kī yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: me yi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: gru ma'i mdog can pad+ma bhan+dha bsnams: gos dkar mo yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rlung gi khams rnams ma spangs gnas su dag: yaṃ ti'i mdog can pad+ma bhan+dha bsnams: dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: gzugs kyi phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpas myu gu dril bu 'dzin: sa yi snying po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: tshor ba'i phung po ma spangs gnas su dag:

byang chub sems dpas klu shing dril bu 'dzin: byams pa mai tri'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'du shes phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpas snye ma dril bu 'dzin: kun tu bzang po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'du byed phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpas ral gri dril bu 'dzin: nam mkha'i snying po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: gzugs kyi phung po ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpas pad+ma dril bu 'dzin: spyan ras gzigs dbang sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra yi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpas ral gri dril bu 'dzin: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dri yi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpas po ti dril bu 'dzin: sgrib pa rnam sel sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ro yi 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: phyag na rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: mig gi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dkar gsal phyag na me long bsnams: lha mo lā s+ye ma la phyag 'tshal lo: gzugs su chags pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dkar mdzes phyag na me tog bsnams: lha mo puṣ+pe ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sna yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: ser mo 'dzum ldan phyag na phreng ba 'dzin: lha mo mā l+ye ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dri ru chags pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ser mo sgeg bzhad phyag na spos phor 'dzin: lha mo dhū pe ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rna ba'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: dmar mo chags mdangs phyag na pi waṃ 'dzin: lha mo gīrti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: yid kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: dmar gsal phyag na gsal ba'i mar me thogs: lha mo ā lo ke la phyag 'tshal lo: lce yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: ljang mo'i phyag na dri yi dung chos 'dzin: lha mo gan+dhe ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ro la chags pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sngo ljang phyag na longs spyod zhal zas 'dzin:

lha mo nīrti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ham̐'u: pham ltung sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: thub chen dkar po phyag na pi waṃ 'dzin: lha dbang brgya byin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: thub chen ljang gu phyag na go mtshon 'dzin: thag bzang ris kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: skye rga na 'chi ma spangs gnas su dag: thub chen ser pos gseg shang par bu 'dzin: shākya thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: glen lkugs sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: thub chen mthing ka phyag na po ti 'dzin: seṅge rab brtan sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bkres skom sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: thub chen dmar po phyag na sgrom bu 'dzin: thub pa kha 'bar sku la phyag 'tshal lo: btso bsreg sdug bsngal ma spangs gnas su dag: thub chen nag po phyag na me chu 'dzin: chos kyi rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rtag par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dkar po lcags kyu dril bu 'dzin: rnam par rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: chad par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ser pau dbyug to dril bu 'dzin: gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag tu lta ba spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dmar po lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: rta mgrin rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mtshan mar 'dzin pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ljang gu rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: lugs 'byung dga' ba ma spangs gnas su dag: 'od lnga'i mdangs ldan gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: mchog gi dga' ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dkar po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: dga' bral chen po ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ser po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: lhan skyes dga' ba ma spangs gnas su dag:

sku mdog dmar po pad+ma thod khrag 'dzin: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: chad par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ljang gu gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: phan tshun gzugs su chags pa rnam par dag: sku mdog 'od lnga 'khor lo dung dmar 'dzin: rdo rje skyod byed yum la phyag 'tshal lo: lag par 'dzin dang 'chang ba rnam par dag: sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dung mar 'dzin: rdo rje bskul byed yum la phyag 'tshal lo: dzi hwa ro 'dzin bcud 'dzin rnam par dag: sku mdog ser mo rin chen dung dmar 'dzin: rdo rje bde byed yum la phyag 'tshal lo: arga sarba sbyor ba rnam par dag: sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma dung dmar 'dzin: rdo rje brda 'byin yum la phyag 'tshal lo: nor bu pad+ma rlabs bskyod rnam par dag: sku mdog ljang gu rgya gram dung dmar 'dzin: rdo rje 'bebs byed yum la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: byams pa tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sku mdog dkar mo lcags kyu bhan+dha 'dzin: rdo rje gar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: snying rje tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sku mdog ser mo zhags pa bhan+dha 'dzin: rin chen gar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dga' ba tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sku mdog dmar mo lcags sgrog bhan+dha 'dzin: pad+ma gar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: btang snyoms tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sku mdog ljang mo dril bu bhan+dha 'dzin: las kyi gar mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: 'khor ba bsgral nas rak+ta zhal du gsol: mthing nag dkar dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa: che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: gti mug bsgral nas rak+ta zhal du gsol: smug nag dkar dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa: bud+dha he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: zhe sdang bsgral nas rak+ta zhal du gsol: dkar sngon dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: badz+ra he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo:

nga rgyal bsgral nas rak+ta zhal du gsol: dmar nag dkar mthing zhal gsum phyag drug pa: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: phrag dog bsgral nas rak+ta zhal du gsol: ljang nag dkar dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa: karma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: gzugs kyi zhen pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: khro mo mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: kro ti shwa ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra yi zhen pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: khro mo smug nag 'khor lo dung khrag 'dzin: bud+dha shwa ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dri yi zhen pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: khro mo dkar gsal rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin: badz+ra shwa ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ro yi zhen pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: khro mo dmar ser rat+na dung dmar 'dzin: rat+na shwa ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: reg bya'i zhen pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: khro mo dmar nag pad+ma dung khrag 'dzin: pad+ma shwa ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnam shes zhen pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: khro mo laṅkas rgya gram dung khrag 'dzin: karma shwa ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ma rig rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo dkar mos zhing dbyug bhan+dha 'dzin: kau rī ma yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'du shes rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo ser mos mda' gzhu 'gengs shing 'phen: tsau ri ma yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'du byed rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo dmar mos chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar: pra mo ha yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rnam shes rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo nag mos rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin: bai ta lī yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: srid pa'i rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo dmar mos rgyu ma 'dren zhing za: puk+ka si yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: skye ba'i rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo ljang nag rdo rje bhan+dha dkrugs: ghasma ri yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: len pa'i rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo ser skya tsit+ta bam chen za: tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo:

rga shi'i rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo mthing nag bam ro mgo lus phral: sme sha lī yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: bde spyod rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo smug nag seng gdong kha ro thogs: siṃ ha mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mthong snang rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis bsnol: byā gṛ mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: gzugs khams rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo nag mo wa gdong rgyu ma za: sri la mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: gzugs med rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo mthing nag spyang gdong bam ro 'drad: shwa na mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dod khams rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo dkar ser rgod mgos zhing phrag bzar: kri ta mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: phyi snod rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo dmar nag kang mgos zhing chen khur: kaṅka mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sems can rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo bya rog gdong can bhan gri gdeng : khā kha mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: 'khor ba'i rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ma mo mthing skya 'ug gdong rdo rje 'dzin: hu lu mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: brdzus skyes rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: dkar mo'i phyag na lcags kyu bhan+dha bsnams: sgo ma stag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mngal skyes rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ser mo'i phyag na zhags pa bhan+dha bsnams: sgo ma phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sgong skyes rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: dmar mo'i phyag na lcags sgrog bhan+dha 'dzin: sgo ma seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: drod skyes rtog pa bcom nas rak+ta gsol: ljang mo'i phyag na dril bu bhan+dha 'dzin: sgo ma sbrul gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: snang ba'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rā ga'i mdangs ldan gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: stong pa'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: si ta'i mdog can gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin:

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: gsal ba'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ut+pal mdog can gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bde ba'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: sūr+ya'i mdog can gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: kun rtog rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: mar gad mdog can gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: nyin mo'i snang ba ma spangs gnas su dag: las ngan sbyang phyir dkar mos lcags kyu 'dzin: rngam pa seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mtshan mo'i rmi lam ma spangs gnas su dag: 'khor ba rtsad gcod ser mos zhags pa 'dzin: gtum pa dom gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: gnas skabs 'gyu ba ma spangs gnas su dag: nyon mongs tshogs 'joms dmar mos lcags sgrog 'dzin: gshe ba dred gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dus drug g.yeng ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sdug bsngal gcod phyir phyag na dril bu 'dzin: khro mo spyang gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: 'khor 'das gnyis med bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: mthing nag phyag na rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: phrin las rdo rje gzhon nur phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid yongs sgrol rak+ta zhal du gsol: sku mdog dmar mo rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rnal 'byor dkar dmar khrag 'thung rdo rje 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: srin mo g.yag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar ser khrag 'thung pad+ma bsnams: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: tshangs pa sbrul gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar ljang khrag 'thung tri shul 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: lha chen gzig mgo ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar sngon khrag 'thung 'khor lo 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: rtog 'dod sre mong mgo la phyag 'tshal lo:

rnal 'byor dkar dmar khrag 'thung mdung thung bsnams: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: gzhon nu dred gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar mo khrag 'thung rgyu zhags bsnams: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: brgya byin dom gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rnal 'byor ser mo khrag 'thung spu gri bsnams: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: rdo rje pha waṃ gdong la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar ser khrag 'thung bum pa 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: zhi ba chu srin gdong la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar nag khrag 'thung pad+ma bsnams: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: bdud rtsi sdig gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar ser khrag 'thung rdo rje 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: zla ba khra mgo ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ser nag khrag 'thung dbyug to 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: be con wa gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ser nag khrag 'thung thod khrag bsnams: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: srin mo stag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rnal 'byor dmar ljang khrag 'thung be con 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: za ba bya rgod mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar mo khrag 'thung khog chen 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: dga' ba rta gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar skya khrag 'thung dbyug to 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: stobs chen khyung gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar mo khrag 'thung rdo rje 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: srin mo khyi gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar skya khrag 'thung mda' gzhu 'gengs: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: 'dod pa pu shud gdong la phyag 'tshal lo:

rnal 'byor dmar nag khrag 'thung bum pa 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: nor srung shwa ba'i mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rnal 'byor ljang sngon khrag 'thung bam chen 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: rlung lha spyang gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang mo khrag 'thung gsal shing 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: mi mo skyin gyi mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang nag khrag 'thung mche zhags bsnams: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: phag mo phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang nag khrag 'thung bam ro 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: dga' byed khwa gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang smug khrag 'thung bam chen 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sna chen glang chen gdong la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang sngon khrag 'thung zhags pa 'dzin: phra men 'jigs tshul 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: chu lha sbrul gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: lha bu'i bdud bcom tshogs lam sgo 'byed ma: khrag 'thung dkar mo'i phyag na lcags kyu 'dzin: sgo ma khu byug mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: phung po'i bdud bcom sbyor lam sgo 'byed ma: khrag 'thung ser mo'i phyag na zhags pa 'dzin: sgo ma ra gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: nyon mongs bdud bcom mthong lam sgo 'byed ma: khrag 'thung dmar nag phyag na lcags sgrog 'dzin: sgo ma seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: 'chi bdag bdud bcom sgom lam sgo 'byed ma: khrag 'thung ljang mo'i phyag na dril bu bsnams: sgo ma sbrul gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos nag po che: sgeg pa'i gar gyis sa bcu rab gnon pa: dpal ldan phyag bzhi pa la phyag 'tshal lo: las la chas pa'i gzugs can mi bsrun pa: khā kha'i gdong can legs ldan khrag 'thung che: dpal 'bar bya rog gdong la phyag 'tshal lo:

ha ha rgod pa'i 'jigs byed dus kyi bdag: 'bar ba'i me 'dra dgyes pa'i gar dang ldan: zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong la phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid dbang mo 'jigs pa'i mche ba gtsigs: dgra bo'i srog bdag las kyi gtso mo'i tshul: ma mo sngags kyi srung mar phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes 'jig rten las kun khyab pa'i bdag: sgra gcan 'khor lo srog bdag drang srong tshul: gza' mchog rā hu la la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dzam gling stong gi mnga' bsgyur myur mgyogs can: dmar nag btsan gzugs bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan: skyes bu dam can btsan rgod phyag 'tshal lo: rdzu 'phrul gar gyi 'od zer phrin las kyis: myur mgyogs dpal la rab tu shar ba'i sku: gter srung yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: ka dag dbyings rig sku la phyag 'tshal lo: zang thal khyab brdal sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'od gsal bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo: cir yangs sa le'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rang rig rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: 'khor 'das ye shes chen por phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid sangs rgyas zhing la phyag 'tshal lo: snod bcud gdod ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra grags gsung dbyangs drug cur phyag 'tshal lo: gang shar gnas lugs de la phyag 'tshal lo: nyag gcig thig le chen por phyag 'tshal lo:

zhes phyag 'tshal zhing 'gyod tshangs kyi bshags pa dag kyang bya'o: sa ma ya: de nas smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la: rtse gcig gdung ba'i dad pas phyag 'tshal bas: mos gus byang chub 'bras bu thob par shog: ma bcos tshul khrims ldan pas phyag 'tshal bas: rnam dag sku lnga'i sa bon smin par shog: thos bsam sgom sgrub bag yod phyag 'tshal bas: rgyun mi 'chad pa'i ting 'dzin rtogs par shog: tshogs gnyis sbyin sogs ldan pas phyag 'tshal bas: tshe rabs 'dod pa'i gter la spyod par shog: rgyu 'bras ngo tsha 'dzems pas phyag 'tshal bas: dkar po'i dge bcus rang rgyud smin par shog: khrel yod tshul bzhin spyod pas phyag 'tshal bas: smon lam phyin ci ma log don ldan shog: shes rab 'khor gsum yongs dag phyag 'tshal bas: phyir mi ldog nas sa bcu rab gnas shog: bslu med 'phags pa'i nor bdun bden tshig gis: kun bzang he ru ka dang mnyam par shog: tshe rabs bdag gi tshe rgyud thams cad du: gdod nas mi 'bral ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: nyams len brtson 'grus zab mo lhur blangs mthus: mtha' yas sems can 'khor ba dong sprugs nas: srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab tu skem par shog: kun tu bzang po'i thugs mchog ci 'dra ba: de 'drar kho nar bdag rgyud rab gnas te: bdag sogs skye dang gnas pa'i yul dag tu: mi mthun bdud rigs rgol ba rab bcom nas: don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis mdzad du gsol: ces pas smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar: sa ma ya: e ma bla med 'bras bu'i yang snying theg pa las: bcud kyi gdams ngag na raka dong sprugs kyi: brgya phyag sdig sgrib rang grol zab mo bzhag: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas yul yar 'brog mtsho nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ro/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // tha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i thun mong spyi'i bshags pa bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: thun mong gnad kyi bshags pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po ngag gi sgrib sbyong du: rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid spyi gtsug dung khang 'khor lo'i steng : 'ja' 'od lug rgyud thig le'i 'od klong du: seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng : hūm̐ yig dkar gsal dri med shel gyi mdog: 'od zhu de nyid gnas gyur dran rdzogs su: rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: dung mdog phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams: rin chen rgyan dang mdzes pa'i na bza' spras: rnal 'byor snyems ma zung 'jug bde stong sbyor: rdo rje skyil krung zung 'jug dril bu bsnams: thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgya'i sngags phreng 'khor: de las bdud rtsi lnga ldan rgyun babs pas: spyi bo nas thon lus kun ltem gyis gang : nad gdon dag nas shel sgong mdangs ldan ltar: bag chags sgyu ma'i g.ya' bral 'ja' lus bsgom: om̐ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: om̐ bud+dha sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya bzlas shing ngag sgrib byang bar bsam: de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dbus su badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: me long lta bu'i ye shes la: zhe sdang dam tshig nyams mchis na: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: shar du bai ro tsa na om̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la: gti mug dam tshig nyams mchis na: 'khor lo dril bu'i phyag rgya yis:

yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: lho ru rat+na sa twa trām̐: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la: nga rgyal dam tshig nyams mchis na: rin chen dril bu'i phyag rgya yis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: nub nas pad+ma dha ra hrīḥ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes la: 'dod chags dam tshig nyams mchis na: pad+ma dril bu'i phyag rgya yis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: byang du karma dhe wa āḥ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la: phrag dog dam tshig nyams mchis na: rgya gram dril bu'i phyag rgya yis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: zung 'jug dharma shwa ri satwaṃ: gsal stong ye shes ngang nyid la: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams mchis na: lugs 'byung dga' ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: shar lho dhe wa dha ri mūm̐: snang stong ye shes ngang nyid la: sku yi dam tshig nyams mchis na: mchog tu dga' ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: lho nub mo ha rā ti lām̐: bde ba chen po'i ye shes la: chu khams dam tshig nyams mchis na: dga' bral chen po'i phyag rgya yis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: nub byang rā ga ra ti pām̐: grags stong chen po'i ye shes la: me khams dam tshig nyams mchis na: lhan skyes dga' ba'i phyag rgya yis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: hūm̐: byang shar badz+ra rā ti tām̐: dran stong chen po'i ye shes la: rlung khams dam tshig nyams mchis na: rjes shes dga' ba'i phyag rgya yis: yang dag slob dpon spyan snga ru: de yang rang byung lta bas bshags: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐:

de nas sems dpa' brgyad kyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: sems dpa' brgyad rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: sems ma brgyad kyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: sems ma brgyad rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rtsa khams brgyad po ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: byang chub sems ma'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: thub pa drug gi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: thub pa drug rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: tshogs drug snang ba ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: thub chen drug gi thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: sgo ba bzhi'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: sgo ba bzhi rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rtag chad mu bzhi ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: dag pa rig 'dzin lnga'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dpa' bo lnga rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: phung po lnga nyid ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: dag pa rig 'dzin thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: dpa' mo lnga'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dpa' mo lnga rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: 'khor lo lnga nyid ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: dpa' mo lnga yi thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: sgo ma bzhi'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: gar mo sgo skyong gsan cing dgongs su gsol: tshad med rnam bzhi ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: sgo ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba:

zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: he ru ka lnga'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung rigs lnga gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dug lnga rnam dag ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: yum lnga'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: khro mo rigs lnga gsan cing dgongs su gsol: gnas lnga rnam dag ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: khro mo lnga yi thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: kau rī ma brgyad kyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: kau rī ma brgyad gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rang lus gnas brgyad ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: kau rī ma brgyad thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: siṃ ha ma brgyad kyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: siṃ ha ma brgyad gsan cing dgongs su gsol: yul chen brgyad rnams ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: siṃ ha ma brgyad thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: sgo ma bzhi'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: lam bzhi'i ngo bo ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro sde lnga gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dga' ba bzhi rnams ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: sgo ma bzhi'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: sgo skyong rigs bzhi gsan cing dgongs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: sgo ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba:

zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: rdo rje phur pa yab yum gyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dgongs su gsol: thams cad don gnyis ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: dpal chen yab yum thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dbang phyug nyer brgyad gsan cing dgongs su gsol: gzugs phung gnas brgyad ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: dbang phyug nyer brgyad thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: de nas pho brang spyi bshags ni: hūm̐: pho brang yongs rdzogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol: phyi nang snod bcud ye sangs rgyas pa la: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dang ci 'gal ba: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: rdo rje slob dpon gyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso bo bla ma la: ma rig dbang gis gdos gzugs mi ru 'dzin: dag snang gus 'dud tha mal tshul 'dzin pa: tshod yod bag med ma dag dbang btsan gyis: bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: gsang ba'i rig ma'i bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gsang ba'i rig ma dgongs su gsol: mkha' 'gro kun gyi mi mo sha gzugs ma: tha mar dus kyi 'jig rten mi ru 'dzin: phyag rgya drug gi 'khrul 'khor g.yel ba dang : dga' bzhi'i mkha' la bde stong mchod pa chag: dkyil 'khor sngags kyi rtsa ba shes rab la: che bkur ma byas gnas skabs skyon du bltas: gsang ba rig ma'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: dkyil 'khor sngags kyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rgyud sde'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol:

dbang bskur bka' gtad dam tshig yin pa la: bsgrub par khas blangs lo zla dus las g.yel: nor 'dod phyir du sdig can rnams la sbyin: rang mtho 'dod phyir gsang sngags khrom du gyer: tshogs gtor skong bshags dus mchod rgyun gtor chag: dkyil 'khor khas blangs nyams pa ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: de nas rdo rje mched lcam gyi bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje mched lcam gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dam tshig 'brel ba'i mched dang spun zla rnams: smon lam 'tshogs pa'i khas len yin pa la: khong khro'i dbang gis gshe skur kha smras sgrog: dam tshig gcig pa'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: de nas ltung ba mtshams med bshags pa ni: hūm̐: zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor dgongs su gsol: smon lam ngan pa'i rkyen dbang bzlog med kyis: sangs rgyas kun la ngan sems khrag phyungs pas: mnar med na raka rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: zhe sdang drag pos bsad bcad rdung rdeg gis: btso bsreg dmyal ba'i rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: nga rgyal dbang gis ngan sems dug sbyor bas: pham ltung las ngan rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: 'dod chags dbang gis mi gtsang rdzas la spyad: las ngan skye ba'i rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: phrag dog dbang gis rku 'phrog bcom pa yis: lha min skye ba'i rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: ser sna'i dbang gis sbyin tshogs bcad pa yis: yi dwags skye ba'i rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: gti mug dbang gis rdzun dang phra ma rtsub: dud 'gror skye ba'i rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags:

gzhan yang rtsa ltung so thar la sogs pa: nyams pa'i dbang gyur mi dge ci mchis pa: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i spyan snga ru: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: sdom pa spyi dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: bka' lung dbang dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags: dam tshig lung dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags: bskyed rim so sor ma gsal mthol lo bshags: rdzogs rim dgongs pa ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: bzlas brjod gzungs dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags: dam tshig snod dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags: mthol lo bshags so rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: gnong ngo 'gyod do mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs: mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos sgrub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pa bgrang zhing bsngo smon bya: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: thun mong las kyi bshags pa ni: na raka dong sprugs gdams pa bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas khrom gter du gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /maṅga laṃ// // da) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i lta ba'i klong bshags ye shes zang thal bzhugs so: gu ru sa man+ta bha dra ma hā pra dzñā mu tra kro ta he ru ka na mo: sa ma ya: e maḥ sgyu ma'i gar gyi rnam rol chen po nyid: ston mdzad rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra ngas: ye shes chen po zab yangs klong chen spros: dgongs pa mi zad rgya mtsho'i mthar thug la: bcud kyi yang tig lta ba ye grol gyis: dbyings rig nam mkha' 'phrul chen bshags pa bstan: dbyangs can bzhad pa'i dpa' mos legs par zungs: lbu ba 'khrigs pa'i klung chen mtsho la sbos: ma 'ongs snga phyi'i rtogs pa mngon gyur tshe: dran rig thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di kun bdag ma mos srungs: rnam rtog ngan lam lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bshags pa bya ba'i rim pa ni: dmigs med dgongs pa'i dbyings nas 'di ltar bshags: hoḥ rang byung dbyings kyi zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs: sprul sku snang stong sgyu ma'i ngang nyid las: chu zla lta bur rnyog med shar ba'i lha: thugs rje che khyed bdag la dgongs su gsol: dbang po sgo dgu ye nas shar grol yang : bag chags 'thug pos lam dgu'i theg pa bsgribs: rim dgu'i sa mchog mthol bshags bzhes su gsol: hoḥ dang po bslab pa sde gsum sgor zhugs tshe: thos bsam snying rje chos kyi gzhi ma la: sgom sgrub 'bad pa brtson 'grus ma bgyis nas: nyan thos gol sar lhung ba mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par sbyang ba'i theg pa la: rang rgyal lung rigs sbyang ba'i sgor zhugs nas: 'chad pa'i chos kyis gzhan rgyud ma grol zhing : rtsod pas mu stegs rgol ba tshar ma chod: brtsams pas sgra sdeb mkhas zhib ma shes nas:

tha mal rang 'dod rmongs gzugs mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par 'jug pa'i theg pa la: byang sems phar phyin drug gi sgor zhugs nas: zol zog med pa'i tshul khrims ma ldan zhing : khengs sems che bas bzod sems chung ba dang : rnam g.yeng dbang gyur brtson 'grus yal bar dor: zab mo'i gnas lugs bsam gtan ma bsgom zhing : mkhyen gnyis lta ba'i kun byed shes rab bral: tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs sbyin 'phro mtha' ma bcad: smon lam bzang po'i dge stobs chung ba sogs: byang sems theg pa nyams pa mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par 'jug pa'i theg pa la: kṛ ya rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sgor zhugs nas: bskyed pa'i sprul bsgyur sgyu mar ma shes shing : snang stong lha skur gdos gzugs 'dzin pa la: grags stong rang sgra'i bzang ngan tshig la chags: srog yig la sogs 'phro 'du mi shes pas: bskyed rim mtshan mar bsgoms pa mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par 'jug pa'i theg pa la: u pa man ngag theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: rang lus gzhal yas khang du ma rtogs shing : rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gror tha mal 'dzin: srog 'dzin rlung la mngon zhen sgro yang btags: 'byung 'jug sngags bzlas sgrub par ma shes pas: rdo rje lus kyi ngo sprod don ma go: rang byung lhan skyes ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par 'jug pa'i theg pa la: yo ga rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sgor zhugs nas: lus gnad tshogs drug lhug bzhag mi shes shing : ngag gnad gzung 'dzin stong pa'i tshig la chags: sems gnad 'du shes rang sar ma bzhag pas: sgo gsum spyod pa'i mtshan 'dzin sgrog gis bcings: lam rim dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par 'jug pa'i theg pa la: ma hā bde ba chen po'i sgor zhugs nas: snang stong yab yum zung 'jug mi shes shing : dbyings rig yab yum phyi nang ris su phyes: gsal stong yab yum ngang rgyun ma bsrings nas: bde stong ro la chags pas ting 'dzin bsgribs:

mnyam sbyor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par 'jug pa'i theg pa la: a nu yo ga mtha' bral don bzung nas: lta ba gtad med rgya yan mi shes shing : sgom pa brdal khyab 'od gsal ma rtogs nas: spyod pa mtshan ma'i bag chags snang ba bsgrubs: 'bras bu gsum gyis so sor ris su phyes: dbyings rig dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: de nas rim par 'jug pa'i theg pa la: a ti bla med chen po'i sgor zhugs nas: ka dag klong las gzhal med ma rtogs shing : zang thal rig pa tshogs drug 'gyu ba dgag: sems kyi rang bzhin stong nyid ma rtogs nas: rnam shes rlung la mtshan ma'i lta bas 'dzin: khregs chod dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: de ltar bla med theg pa chen po yis: rim dgu'i bshags pa zab mo 'di phul bas: sa lam thams cad cig car yongs rdzogs shog: hoḥ ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur nas: dran rig 'di ni chos nyid mngon sum la: chos can mtshan mar 'dzin pa thang re chad: spang blang dgag sgrub bgyis pa nyon re mongs: bya rtsol rdzogs pa thig le'i ngang du bshags: chos kyi sku la dngos mtshan med pa la: rnam rtog lta bas bsgrubs pa thang re chad: spang blang re dogs bgyis pa nyon re mongs: ye nas 'dzin med zang thal klong du bshags: longs sku'i zhing khams mtha' dbus med pa la: dmigs gtad tshigs su 'debs pa thang re chad: zhing khams phyi nas bsgrubs pa nyon re mongs: rang byung rang shar de yi klong du bshags: sgyu ma'i sprul skur nges pa med pa la: dbyibs dang kha dog lta ba thang re chad: zhal phyag gcig tu 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: ma nges so sor ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs don la 'khor 'das med pa la: myang 'das rtogs pa bsgrubs pa thang re chad: mtshan ma'i dge bar brtson pa nyon re mongs: re dog spang blang bral ba'i ngang du bshags: dbu ma'i rtsa la phyi nang bral ba la:

srog rtsol mdud pa 'dzin pa thang re chad: dngos po gcig tu 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: ye shes rlung lnga ro gcig ngang gis bshags: dug lnga ma spangs ye shes yin pa la: bdag tu lta ba'i srung sdom thang re chad: blang dor 'gog pa'i 'dun pa nyon re mongs: sku lnga lhun grub de bzhin ngang du bshags: thig le chen por rgya khyon ris med la: grwa zur tshig gis mtshon pa thang re chad: yin min gcig tu brjod pa nyon re mongs: lhun grub chen po'i ngang du bshags par bgyi: me long ye shes gsal sgrib med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad: gsal dang bsgrib par zhen pa nyon re mongs: snang stong 'gro 'ong bral ba'i ngang du bshags: mnyam nyid ye shes che chung med pa la: tshad dang dpangs su lta ba thang re chad: rgya dang khyon du gzhal ba nyon re mongs: brdal khyab lhun grub de bzhin ngang du bshags: sor rtogs ye shes 'phel 'grib med pa la: gang shar so sor lta ba thang re chad: rnam shes du mar lta ba nyon re mongs: ro gcig bya bral de bzhin ngang du bshags: bya grub ye shes klong du khyab pa la: steng 'og gnyis su bsgrubs pa thang re chad: phyi nang gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: bkod pa rab rdzogs de bzhin ngang du bshags: kun bzang lha la dngos po med pa la: zhal phyag gzugs su lta ba thang re chad: kha dog dbyibs su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: 'bad rtsol bral bar de bzhin ngang la bshags: kun tu bzang mo mkha' ltar yangs pa la: yang dog tshad du 'byin pa thang re chad: mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: bha ga yangs dog med pa'i ngang la bshags: chos 'byung lam la ring thung med pa la: nye ring gnyis su 'dzin pa thang re chad: bgrod 'gyu du mar lta ba nyon re mongs: gsang lam legs nyes bral ba'i klong du bshags: gzhal yas khang la phyi nang med pa la: gsal dang stong par 'dzin pa thang re chad: rgyu dang mtshan mar lta ba nyon re mongs: rang gsal rig par de bzhin mthol lo bshags:

hoḥ bskyed pa'i tshe na zhal phyag ma gsal zhing : rdzogs pa'i tshe na ting 'dzin ngo ma 'phrod: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don dang mi ldan pa: ro gcig sgyu ma de bzhin ngang gis bshags: tshogs mchod dus su ser sna'i zhen pas bcings: bskang bshags dus su bzlas brjod grangs nyung sogs: tshod yod chog shes le los dbang gyur rnams: bla med 'od gsal de bzhin ngang gis bshags: sbyor ba'i tshe na bde stong dbye gsal dka': sgrol ba'i tshe na snying rje'i bag chags zhan: 'khrul gzugs rmongs pas gti mug spyod pa sogs: sbyor sgrol dam nyams ye shes ngang gis bshags: hoḥ lta ba ye sangs rgyas pa'i klong du bshags: sgom pa dmigs med rgya yan klong du bshags: spyod pa gang shar ro snyom klong du bshags: gzhi ni 'od gsal ma bcos klong du bshags: lam ni zang thal 'gag med klong du bshags: 'bras bu 'khor gsum yongs dag klong du bshags: bshags dang bshags bya stong nyid klong du bshags: a ti klong chen lta ba'i bshags pa yis: ye grol gdod ma'i dgongs pa la gnas shog: ces mi dmigs pa brda'i klong nas bshags shing 'khor gsum yongs dag la gnas par bya'o: sa ma ya: e ma yang snying ti ka las: klong bshags dgongs pa rab yangs bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bshus so// // na) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i smre bshags bag chags dbyings grol bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bdag rgyud bag chags las sgrol phyir: ru tra'i smre sngags bshags pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: ru tra'i smre ngag bshags pa bya ba ni:

ngu ma dbyangs kyi tshul du brjod dgos zer bar thos: spyir chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong la gcig rang zer ba'i nges pa med skad 'dug: thal sbyar pus btsugs gdung bas 'di skad do: hoḥ phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing na bzhugs pa yi: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: kye ma kyi hud mi bzod duḥkha myong : bdag 'dzin dbang gis stong khams ru trar skyes: bzod glags med pa'i rnam smin 'di 'dra bar: phung po 'dus byas yin yang lhag med yal: yid lus bag chags sgyu mas 'di myong tshe: 'jig rten mig gis bzod par ga la rigs: smre sngags mi thon sgra tshig ngag kyang 'dar: 'jigs gzugs gshin rje'i pho nya rngam tshul gyis: bskal pa stong gi 'dzin khyon yin kyang 'gas: mnar med lus la btab pa'i sdug bsngal 'di: srid pa'i ri rab yin kyang rab tu 'thor: las ngan rnam smin 'di 'dra 'khor ba'i tshe: dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rje mi phyung na: snying rje che zhes su la ci zhig bya: bdag rgyud rnam smin 'di nyid sbyongs par mdzod: 'gro mgon rnams kyis thugs rje der ma chung : zhes pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo thog ma'i mgon po'i zhal mthong ba'i tshe: tshig 'dis rab tu bshags pa'o: kye ma kyi hud rgyal ba thugs rje can: mgon po mthing mdog chos sku kun tu bzang : brtse chen nus pas bdag la dgongs su gsol: las ngan bag chags ru tra bdag 'dra ba: gti mug 'thib pa'i ma rig sgrib pa yis: srid pa'i rgya mtsho mnar med dong du lhung : rnam smin sgrib pas ngam grog 'di ru tshud: nyon mongs ches gdung gcong rong zab mor skye: mi bzod sdug bsngal khur gyis non gyur pas: kun bzang rgyal bas deng 'dir mi drangs na: thugs rje che zhes su la ci zhig bya: da lta nyid du na raka dong sprugs mdzod: ces pas thog ma'i mgon po la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang zhi khro dam pa rigs brgyas bskor nas 'ja' lhags pa ltar gyur te gdangs gcig tu bka' stsal to:

kye ho kye ho rnam smin a tsa ma: bsags pa'i las 'di chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra: sdug bsngal chu klung 'phral du ga la bzlog: las ngan rgyu 'di srid pa'i 'jig tshogs 'dra: rnam smin rdzogs 'di 'phral du ga la stong : mtshams med las 'di gaṅgā'i bye ma 'dra: bskal pa'i sdug bsngal 'phral du ga la bzlog: ci phyir nam mkha'i ri mo yal ba dang : khyod nyid ru tra'i duḥkha byang ste mchis: sngon tshe dag snang gus 'dud log spyod pas: sangs rgyas sku la ngan sems khrag phyungs nas: mnar med smin po ru tra a tsa ma: zhe sdang dbang gis srog bcad mtshon btab pas: btso bsreg myong po ru tra a tsa ma: phrag dog dbang gis ma byin blangs pa yis: bkres skom myong po ru tra a tsa ma: 'dod chags dbang gis mi tshangs spyad pa yis: ha li'i dbus skyes ru tra a tsa ma: nga rgyal rang 'dod rdzun du smras pa yis: glen lkugs myong po ru tra a tsa ma: dam tshig sdom gsum khyad du bsad pa yis: thar pa chad pa'i ru tra a tsa ma: dkon mchog gsum la log pa'i rgyab gtad pas: skyabs mgon chad pa'i ru tra a tsa ma: gsang sngags zab mor log lta'i tshig bsgrags pas: mnar med gtan myong ru tra a tsa ma: khyod nyid dag snang mos gus chung ba yis: sangs rgyas thugs rje log lta can la rdugs: bskal pa'i rgya mtsho ba spus gtor ba yis: zad pa'i dus su ru tra'i rnam smin zad: sdig to can khyod snying rje ma skyes pas: thugs rje lcags kyus reg par mi 'gyur bas: dag snang sbyongs shig ru tra a tsa ma: mos gus skyed cig ru tra a tsa ma: smon lam gyis shig ru tra a tsa ma: zhes dang : 'di nyid ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs pa'i tshe bka' bstsal pa'o: kye ma kye ma kye hud a tsa ma: sngon tshe las ngan rlung gis rgyud sbyangs pas: mi bzod dmyal ba'i duḥkha 'di lta bu: myong yun ring na khyod la snying re rje: mos gus dag snang sbyong ba'i dus gcig yin:

kye ma las ngan sngon dbang mtha' btsan pa'i: ma dag gzugs khyod khro gtum khengs pas len: zhe sdang mi bzod dmyal ba'i me 'di ltar: rnam smin myong ba sngar byas las kyi 'bras: mos gus blo sna bskyed pa'i dus gcig yin: hoḥ bdag 'dzin ma rig 'gong pos sgrib pa'i lus: zhe sdang dbang gis stong khams ru tra khyod: bdag gis sngon tshe snying rje'i mtshon btab pas: dam tshig srog snying phul zhing las kyi 'brel: las ngan khyod la snying rje nga las med: dug lnga'i phung po zhig snga sangs rgyas snga: sdug bsngal yun ring myong tshe sgrib pa dag: gdung shugs gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus gcig yin: zhes pa de rnams zhi khro'i lha rim bzhin nas gsungs so: de'i tshe ru tras bshags pa 'bul ba ni: kye ma kye hud bdag 'dra a tsa ma: las ngan dbang gis stong khams ru trar skyes: las kyi rgyu 'bras chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra: las ngan 'di dag 'phral du bzlog par mdzod: bcom ldan dung mdog ston pa rdo rje sems: sngon chad ma mthong khyed nyid gang du bzhugs: zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams: thugs rje'i lcags kyu bskyed pa'i dus shig lags: las ngan bdag 'dra da lta mi 'dren na: thugs rje che zhes su la ci zhig bya: bcom ldan mthing mdog bla ma rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje mnga' ba'i bdag nyid rtsal 'byin pa: las ngan bdag ni yun ring 'khor bar 'khyams: ma rig las kyi rlung chen g.yo lags pas: thugs rje mnga' khyed bdag nyid dus 'di ru: las rlung ma bzlog thugs rjes ci zhig bya: bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: dpa' bo khyed la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' bas: las 'bras bslu med sdug bsngal dus 'dir myong : thugs rjes shugs phyungs deng 'dir 'dren par mdzod: sngon chad byas pa'i rnam smin 'gyod cing bshags: phyin chad mi bgyid zhi khro'i lha la sdom: ma dag sdug bsngal las 'di bzlog tu gsol:

kye ma kye hud bdag 'dra'i bag chags lus: rnam smin nyon mongs duḥkha 'khor ba 'di: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: lus kyi dam nyams srog bcad mthol lo bshags: ngag gi dam nyams phra tshig mthol lo bshags: yid kyi dam nyams ngan sems mthol lo bshags: sgo gsum dam nyams 'phrog bcom mthol lo bshags: spyod 'gros dam nyams mi gtsang mthol lo bshags: mtshams med lnga yi sdig ltung mthol lo bshags: mi dge bcu yi rnam smin mthol lo bshags: rtsa ltung brgyad las nyams pa mthol lo bshags: ma rig so bdun dbang gyur mthol lo bshags: rnam rtog kun slong bzhi bcu mthol lo bshags: las kyi pham ltung nyis brgya lnga bcu bshags: brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs mthol lo bshags: zhi khro'i lha tshogs mthol bshags yar bzhes la: thugs rje'i lcags kyus deng 'dir drang du gsol: snying nas bshags so 'gyod tshang drag po 'bul: brtse bas dgongs shig rgyal ba mthu ma chung : dkyil 'khor mdun nyid bshags pa'i smon lam gyis: sa mchog bde chen zhing du skye bar shog:

ces pas bshags: rgyal ba rnams kyi bden tshig las smon lam 'di mdzad pa'o: hoḥ bla med rdo rje gsum gyi bden tshig gis: rnam smin 'khor ba'i ru tra las sgrol nas: na raka mnar med g.yang sa stongs gyur te: zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas rab thob par shog: stong gsum mun gling 'dag ma'i tshal chen dag: 'od gsal sgron mes skad cig rab gsal nas: nam yang ngan 'gro'i gnas ngan kun spangs te: tshe rabs bde dga' rgya mtsho mchog rnyed nas: kun mkhyen thar pa'i gling du bgrod par shog: gang phyir 'gro ba'i sa bon rab stongs nas: srid pa'i gnas ngan rgya mtsho cher skem ste: sa bcu'i rtse mo mngon par reg gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab: ru tra sdug bsngal las grol te: phyir mi ldog pa'i zhing khams rnyed pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ ya mtshan mngon gyur las: smre bshags na raka dong sprugs bzhag: skal ldan zhig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // pa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i bskang mchod byin rlabs kyi pra khrid bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: dang po las kyi rim pa bstan pa ni: dkyil 'khor cha tshang gzhung thig lta bur bri: stegs bu rim pa lnga yi kha ru 'ding : de dbus mañdzi'i kha ru gtso gtor bzhag: phyogs bzhir rigs lnga mtshams bzhir yum lnga dang : bum pa rigs lnga gzung thag kha rgyan bcas: me long shel rdo sman raka phyi mchod bsham: de nas bang rim dag ni rim pa bzhin: dang por bdud rtsi brgya dang rak+ta brgya: gnyis par zhal zas brgya dang dri spos brgya: gsum par gtor ma brgya dang sha dum brgya: bzhi par me tog brgya dang tshogs gtor brgya:

lnga par mar me brgya dang tshom bu brgya: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun bzang che ba brgyad: mdun du sman gtor rak+ta phyi mchod dang : g.yas su tshogs mchod g.yon du gtor 'bul bsham: phyogs bzhir gdugs dang 'phan dar drwa ba bri: steng na rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor legs par bsham: gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal mchod sprin gang mos sogs: phyi nang spyan gzigs shin tu tshang bar dgod: skong bshags zab mo'i rim par 'jug mchis so: sa ma ya: dang po mchod pa rim bzhin byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rtsa brgyud 'dus pa'i dbang po thog ma'i mgon po'i brdar gnas pa'i ming yig thig les brgyan pa 'od tu zhu ba las byung ba'i: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa mchod pa'i rdzas: bskang ba'i rdzas bsgrub pa'i rdzas rten pa'i rdzas mnyes pa'i rdzas mthun pa'i rdzas la sogs pas sa dang bar snang dmigs pa'i yul thams cad gang ba'i rang bzhin du gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang : om̐ sarba a mṛ ta pañtsa gu h+ya dzñā na āḥhūm̐: nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ swa bhā w sogs: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las e nam mkha' mthing nag 'bar ba zur gsum pas khyab cing mu med pa: de'i klong gi dbus su yam̐ ljang nag rlung las gzhu'i dbyibs can mchog la ba dan g.yo bar tām̐ gyis mtshan pa: de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po tsha zhing rtsub la zur gsum pa 'bar bar pam̐ gyis mtshan pa: de'i steng du kham̐ gyi dwangs ma keṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu ri rab dang mnyam pa: ltag pa nang du phyogs pa gsum gyi steng du: āḥlas bhan+dha lcang lo mtshan nyid dang ldan pa om̐ gyi rang bzhin khyon yangs pa:

hūm̐ gi rang bzhin ye nas 'du 'bral med pa'i mkha' ste: 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su na las mi'i sha: maṃ las rang byung gi chang : shar du gho las ba glang gi sha: shar lhor bhi las dri chen: lhor dha las rta'i sha: lho nub tu ra las rak+ta: nub tu ku las khyi'i sha: nub byang du shu las byang sems: byang du ha las glang chen gyi sha: byang shar du ma las rkang mar: rdzas bcur yi ge bcu yis mtshan pa: de'i steng du nyi zla'i kha chod la rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa: yar gyi rwa lnga la om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mar gyi rwa lnga la mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: de yi ge bcu'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'o: thabs shes nyi zla ā li kā lis rang sgra sgrog pa'i yi ge can: rdo rje'i lte ba'i phyogs bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes dang : nyi zla'i steng 'og tu rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: bar mtshams su sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o: slar yang sna bug g.yon nas ye shes kyi rlung g.yos pas yaṃ gyi dal la phog ste ba dan cher bskyod pas me 'bar nas bdud rtsi khol: snyigs ma lbu ba'i rnam par phyir don: de'i tshe dam tshig phyag rgya bzhis rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes brjod pas rigs lnga yab yum gyi dga' bzhi'i mdangs rab tu rgyas: dam tshig gi lha mo bzhis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zung du 'jug: mkha' lam nas bdud rtsi babs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres: dbyer med gcig tu ston pa de'i rlangs pa las spros pa'i lha mo grangs med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas: sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa phul: sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyangs: chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod: tshur 'dus sku gsung thugs yon gcig tu ston pa'i bdud rtsi la om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge 'phros pa rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas: dbang bzhi bskur nas mchog gi dngos grub thob cing bdud rtsi'i dwangs mas lus khengs shing ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin bzod glags med par 'bar bar byas so:

om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas sbyangs shing spel: de nas bdud rtsi nang mchod yin na srin mdzub kyis gtor zhing byin rlabs dus su lan gsum dkrugs nas bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // pha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i rgyud bskang ka dag rang grol bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: ka dag rang byung don rtogs phyir: rgyud bskang byin rlabs gter mdzod bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de nas bskang ba'i rim pa ni: gzhung gi dkyil 'khor spyi mthun la: legs par mdzes pa'i rgyan mtha' nas: lha yi khye'u mtshan ldan gyis: bcu drug gsang ba'i rig ma la: phyag rgya drug gi chas spras te: dal gyi mtha' kun bskor nas su: sna tshogs gar gyis mchod pa 'bul: de yang sngon 'gro rjes gsum ste: dang po spyan drangs gnas la 'khod: gnyis pa bskang zhing bar du mchod: gsum pa bshags shing rjes la bsngo: sa ma ya: dang po bskang rdzas bran cing byin rlabs bya: om̐ āḥham̐'u: lan gsum brjod: hūm̐: stong khams khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: dngos 'byor phyi yi mchod pa sprin ltar gtibs: bla med dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa ni: chos dbyings klong chen mi dmigs pho brang nas: kun bzang che mchog rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams: sgyu ma chu zla'i snang ngor skur bzhengs la: rang snang gnas yul dag pa'i dbus 'dir gshegs: nyag gcig ting 'dzin mi g.yo dgyes shing bzhugs: sku lnga rang shar lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gyu 'ong sgyu ma'i dbang po'i gar gyis mchod: tshogs drug spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: dran rig tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: kun nas brdal khyab chen por gnas par stsol: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: dang po phyi'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang ba ni: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas me tog ci mchis pa: bsdus pa puṣ+pe'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas bdug spos ci mchis pa: bsdus pa dhū pe'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu:

lha rdzas snang gsal ci mchis pa: bsdus pa ā lo'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas dri chab ci mchis pa: bsdus pa gan+dhe'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas zhal zas ci mchis pa: bsdus pa nai wi'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ya pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas rol mo ci mchis pa: bsdus pa shab+da'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra shab+da pū dza āḥhūm̐:

hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa: bsdus pa rū pa'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra rū pa pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas rol mo ci mchis pa: bsdus pa shab+da'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra shab+da pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas dri mchog ci mchis pa: bsdus pa gan+dhe'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas ro mchog ci mchis pa: bsdus pa rā sa'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

om̐ badz+ra rā sa pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: lha rdzas reg mchog ci mchis pa: bsdus pa spar+she'-i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra spar+she pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: bla med nang mchod ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra a mri ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: bla med sman mchod ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i ye shes mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra o ṇ+ya pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag tu: bla med gsang mchod ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i bde stong mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig:

bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ sarba a haṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: phyag rgya gar mchod ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i gar mo lang ling 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra mu tra pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: glu dbyangs snyan mchod ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i brda 'byin sgeg mo 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra swa ra swa tī hūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: bla med sbyor mchod ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i thabs shes mnyam sbyor 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ rat+na pad+ma pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: bla med gtor mchod ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i rmad byung bha ling 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig:

'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: mkha' dbyings byang sems ci mchis pa: bsdus pa pad+ma'i rak+ta 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra gu h+ya rak+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: mā ra rak+ta ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i nyon mongs snying khrag 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra du na rak+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: bsgral ba'i mchod pa ci mchis pa: bsdus pa māṃ sa'i phung po 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra māṃ sa pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: ye grol mchod pa ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i lhan skyes mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig:

khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra dharma pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: spyan gzigs mchod pa ci mchis pa: bsdus pa'i bkram pa sna tshogs 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ sarba me gha pū dza om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag tu: dpag med blo yis blangs pa yi: mchod pa ji snyed ci mchis pas: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: (༈) hūm̐: gti mug ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: thog ma'i sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : shes bya'i ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: dbyings phyug bzang mo'i thugs dam bskang : ma rig ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: rnam par snang mdzad thugs dam bskang : zhe sdang ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: rin chen 'byung ldan thugs dam bskang : 'dod chags ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: 'od dpag med kyi thugs dam bskang : phrag dog ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: don yod grub pa'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: nam mkha'i ngo bo gnas dag pa'i: dbyings phyug ma yi thugs dam bskang : sa yi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i thugs dam bskang : chu yi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: mā ma kī yi thugs dam bskang :

me yi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: gos dkar mo yi thugs dam bskang : rlung gi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzugs kyi phung po gnas dag pa'i: sa yi snying po'i thugs dam bskang : tshor ba'i phung po gnas dag pa'i: byams pa mai tri'i thugs dam bskang : 'du shes phung po gnas dag pa'i: kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskang : 'du byed phung po gnas dag pa'i: nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskang : gzugs kyi 'dzin pa gnas dag pa'i: spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : sgra yi 'dzin pa gnas dag pa'i: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs dam bskang : dri yi 'dzin pa gnas dag pa'i: sgrib pa rnam sel thugs dam bskang : ro yi 'dzin pa gnas dag pa'i: phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: mig gi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i: lā s+ye ma yi thugs dam bskang : gzugs su chags pa gnas dag pa'i: puṣ+pe ma yi thugs dam bskang : sna yi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i: mā l+ye ma yi thugs dam bskang : dri yi chags pa gnas dag pa'i: dhū pe ma yi thugs dam bskang : rna ba'i rnam shes gnas dag pa'i: gīrti ma yi thugs dam bskang : yid kyi chags pa gnas dag pa'i: ā lo ke yi thugs dam bskang : lce yi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i: gan+dhe ma yi thugs dam bskang : ro la chags pa gnas dag pa'i: nīrti ma yi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: lha yi sdug bsngal gnas su dag: lha dbang brgya byin thugs dam bskang : lha min sdug bsngal gnas su dag: thag bzang ris kyi thugs dam bskang : mi yi sdug bsngal gnas su dag: shākya thub pa'i thugs dam bskang : byol song sdug bsngal gnas su dag: seṅge rab brtan thugs dam bskang : yi dwags sdug bsngal gnas su dag: thub pa kha 'bar thugs dam bskang : dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gnas su dag: chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rtag par lta ba gnas su dag: rnam par rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang :

chad par lta ba gnas su dag: gshin rje gshed kyi thugs dam bskang : bdag tu lta ba gnas su dag: rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : mtshan mar lta ba gnas su dag: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: lugs 'byung dga' ba gnas dag pa'i: smin pa'i rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : mchog dga'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: sar gnas rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : dga' bral rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : lhan skyes rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : khyad dga'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: lhun grub rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : gzugs su chags pa gnas dag pa'i: rdo rje skyod byed thugs dam bskang : ka ra 'dzin pa gnas dag pa'i: rdo rje bskul byed thugs dam bskang : dzi na bcud len gnas dag pa'i: rdo rje bde byed thugs dam bskang : ar+ghaṃ sbyor ba gnas dag pa'i: rdo rje brda 'byin thugs dam bskang : bde stong rlabs bskyod gnas dag pa'i: rdo rje 'bebs byed thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: byams pa tshad med 'gro don phyir: rdo rje gar mo'i thugs dam bskang : snying rje tshad med 'gro don phyir: rin chen gar mo'i thugs dam bskang : dga' ba tshad med 'gro don phyir: pad+ma gar mo'i thugs dam bskang : btang snyoms tshad med 'gro don phyir: las kyi gar mo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: 'khor ba bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: che mchog khro rgyal thugs dam bskang : gti mug bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: bud+dha khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : zhe sdang bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: badz+ra khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: rat+na khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : 'dod chags bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: pad+ma khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : phrag dog bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: karma khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzugs kyi zhen pa bcom mdzad ma: kro ti shwa ri'i thugs dam bskang : sgra yi zhen pa bcom mdzad ma:
