bud+dha kro ti'i thugs dam bskang : dri yi zhen pa bcom mdzad ma: badz+ra shwa ri'i thugs dam bskang : ro yi zhen pa bcom mdzad ma: rat+na shwa ri'i thugs dam bskang : reg bya'i zhen pa bcom mdzad ma: pad+ma shwa ri'i thugs dam bskang : rnam shes zhen pa bcom mdzad ma: karma shwa ri'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ma rig rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: kau rī ma yi thugs dam bskang : 'du shes rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: tsau ri ma yi thugs dam bskang : 'du byed rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: pra mo ha yi thugs dam bskang : rnam shes rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: bai ta lī yi thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: puk+ka si yi thugs dam bskang : skye ba'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: ghasma ri yi thugs dam bskang : len pa'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi thugs dam bskang : dga' ba'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: sme sha lī yi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bde spyod rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: siṃ ha mu kha'i thugs dam bskang : mthong snang rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: byā gṛ ma yi thugs dam bskang : gzugs khams rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: sri la mu kha'i thugs dam bskang : gzugs med rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: shwa na mu kha'i thugs dam bskang : 'dod khams rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: kri ta ma yi thugs dam bskang : phyi snod rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: kaṅka ma yi thugs dam bskang : sems can rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: khā kha mu kha'i thugs dam bskang : 'khor ba'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: hu lu mu kha'i thugs dam bskang : rdzus skyes rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: stag gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : mngal skyes rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: phag gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : sgong skyes rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: seng gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : drod skyes rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: sbrul gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: snang ba'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : stong pa'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i:

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : gsal ba'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : bde ba'i rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'-i thugs dam bskang : kun tu rtog pa gnas dag pa'i: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: nyin mo'i snang ba gnas dag pa'i: seng gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : mtshan mo'i rmi lam gnas dag pa'i: dom gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : gnas skabs 'gyu ba gnas dag pa'i: dred gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : dus drug g.yeng ba gnas dag pa'i: spyang gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gnyis med bsgral nas rak+ta gsol: rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang : snang srid yongs sgrol rak+ta gsol: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rnal 'byor dkar mo rdo rje 'dzin: srin mo g.yag mgo'i thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dkar ser pad+ma 'dzin: tshangs pa sbrul gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dkar ljang tri shul 'dzin: lha chen gzig gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dkar sngon 'khor lo 'dzin: rtog 'dod sre gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dkar dmar mdung thung 'dzin: gzhon nu dred gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dkar sngon rgyu zhags 'dzin: brgya byin dom gdong thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rnal 'byor ser mo spu gri 'dzin: rdo rje pha waṃ thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar ser bum pa 'dzin: chu srin gdong gi thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar nag pad+ma 'dzin: bdud rtsi sdig gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dkar ser rdo rje 'dzin: zla ba khra mgo'i thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor ser nag dbyug to 'dzin: be con wa gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor ser nag thod khrag 'dzin: srin mo stag gdong thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rnal 'byor dmar ljang be con 'dzin: za ba rgod mgo'i thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar mo khog chen 'dzin:

dga' ba rta gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar skya dbyug to 'dzin: stobs chen khyung gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar mo rdo rje 'dzin: srin mo khyi gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar skya mda' gzhu 'gengs: 'dod pa pu shud thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar ljang bum pa 'dzin: nor bsrung shwa mgo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rnal 'byor ljang sngon ba dan phyar: rlung lha spyang gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dmar ljang gsal shing 'dzin: mi mo skyin mgo'i thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor ljang nag mche zhags 'dzin: phag mo phag gdong thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor ljang smug bam ro za: dga' byed khwa mgo'i thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor ljang sngon bam chen 'dzin: sna chen glang chen thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor ljang skya zhags pa 'dzin: chu lha sbrul gdong thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ma rig lha bu bdud bcom ma: khu byug gdong gi thugs dam bskang : shes bya phung po'i bdud bcom ma: ra gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs las kyi bdud bcom ma: seṅge'i gdong gi thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag 'tshe ba'i bdud bcom ma: sbrul gdong ma yi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug ngang la sbyor: sgrol du med de ye shes chen por sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med le los dbang gyur nas: bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags cho ga g.yel ba dang : tshul bzhin ma ldan shes bya'i dbang gyur tshogs: yi dam lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya:

sogs nas sa twa āḥ zhes yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing lhag chad kha bkang : sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: nyams chag bskang ba'i rim pa bzhag: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // sarba maṅga laṃ// ba) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i brda bskang chen mo bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra kho bo pad 'byung gis: rdzogs pa chen po ma bsgoms sangs rgyas kyi: cha lag thos grol ka dag brda bskang bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po ting 'dzin ngang gis mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i mi g.yo ting 'dzin gyi: rang bzhin klong las tshogs drug mchod sprin shar: 'dus byas rnam par dag pa'i rdzas chen po: gdod nas rang byung nam mkha'i khyon ltar 'gengs: bla med bskang rdzas ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ sarba gu h+ya dharma maṇ+ḍa la swa bhā hoḥ gnyis pa brdas spyan 'dren pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bsam brjod bral ba'i rang bzhin klong yangs nas: rig pa zang thal ngang la shar ba yi: sgyu ma'i sprul sku cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: 'gro 'ong bral ba'i kun rgyu dbyings nas gshegs: nyon mongs rlung gis mi bskyod brtan par bzhugs: gnas lugs gnyug mas de bzhin phyag 'tshal lo: gang shar chos sku'i rol rtsal mchod pa 'bul: gdod nas rnam dag ma bcos lha la bstod: nyag gcig sku lnga yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : tshe rabs 'gog ba'i spang blang mthol lo bshags: gdod nas ye grol chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: dmigs med khyab brdal ngang gis yongs rdzogs gsal:

de nas bskang bar 'jug pa ni: hūm̐: chos kyi sku la mtshan ma mi mnga' yang : 'gro ba'i don du sgyu mar shar ba'i lha: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : zangs thal shar yang bden 'dzin ma grub pa'i: gang 'dul der ston cho 'phrul rol pa'i rtsal: che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgyu ma chu zla bzhin du lham me ba: gnyis snang zung 'jug 'dus ma byas pa'i klong : dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: tshogs drug rnam dag bhan+dha ru: dbang po lnga yi me tog spungs: gang shar 'dzin med mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: phung po rnam dag bhan+dha ru: khams lnga dbang po'i me tog spungs: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: shes bya rnam dag bhan+dha ru: rtog med sgyu ma'i me tog spungs: blo bral don dam mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: zhen med sgyu ma'i bhan+dha ru: rtog bral chen po'i bdug spos gtams: zol zog med pa'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bag yod gsum gyi bhan+dha ru: tshul khrims rnam dag bdug spos gtams: bslab pa rang byung mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang :

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bsam gtan rnam dag bhan+dha ru: mi g.yo ting 'dzin bdug spos gtams: kun shes nyag gcig mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: phung po rnam dag kong bu ru: rnam shes gsal ba'i mar me sbar: dran rig rang gsal sgron me 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: lhan skyes gnyug ma'i kong bu ru: kun gsal snying gi sgron me sbar: ye nas rang byung mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: rtsa srog tsit+ta'i kong bu ru: shes rab gsal ba'i sgron me sbar: ye shes lam me'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: khā kha mu kha'i dung zhal du: mkha' dbyings byang sems dri chab gtams: nyon mongs skyon bral mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: 'khor lo tha ma'i dung zhal du: chu ser zhun ma'i dri chab gtams: gtsang dme bral ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang :

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: skye mched gnas dag dung zhal du: srid pa rang byung dri chab gtams: 'dus byas rnam dag mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: 'dus byas bem shun bhan+dha ru: 'byung lnga rnam dag zhal zas gtams: ma skyes snang stong mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sdong po rtsa yi bhan+dha ru: dri chen rang byung zhal zas gtams: ro snyom me long mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: gnas pa sems kyi gtor gzhong du: g.yo ba rlung gi zhal zas gtams: 'dzin med rang grol mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: mkhal ma chu khams 'bras bu'i steng : rang shar sgra 'dzin rol mos gtams: grags stong ye shes mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: glo ba rlung gi 'khor lo'i steng : gyen rgyu dbugs kyis rol mos gtams: sna tshogs sgra bsgyur mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang :

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings chos 'byung rgya gram steng : srog rtsol lnga yi rol mos gtams: 'byung 'jug rang sgra sgrog pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: de nas bla med sman raka gtor gsum gyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: spyi bo bde chen bhan+dha ru: klad chen sman mchod bdud rtsis gtams: haṃ yig zhu ba'i mchod pa 'di: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: longs spyod 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: 'du ba sna tshogs bdud rtsis gtams: ngar 'dzin zhu ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chos kyi 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: dwangs ma bcud kyi bdud rtsis gtams: khrag 'jib zhu ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: dri 'dzin rlung lnga'i bdud rtsis gtams: bha su zhu ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: mas brtan dga' ba'i bdud rtsis gtams: sa bon brgyad pa'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

hūm̐: 'byung lnga rnam dag bhan+dha ru: bskyed pa'i khams lnga'i bdud rtsis gtams: lnga ldan ye shes mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba las byung ba'i: bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: gsal ba yab la rig pa yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba las byung ba'i: bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dran pa yab la shes pa yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba las byung ba'i: bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: thabs chen yab la shes rab yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba las byung ba'i: bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ka dag yab la zang thal yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba las byung ba'i: bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: khregs chod yab la dbyings rig yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba las byung ba'i: bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: gti mug rnam dag mkha' lam nas: chos dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag rgya glu gar 'bul ba 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: zhe sdang rnam dag mkha' lam nas: me long ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag rgya glu gar 'bul ba 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: nga rgyal rnam dag mkha' lam nas: mnyam nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag rgya glu gar 'bul ba 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: 'dod chags rnam dag mkha' lam nas: sor rtogs pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag rgya glu gar 'bul ba 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag mkha' lam nas: las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag rgya glu gar 'bul ba 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: nyon mongs rnam dag mkha' lam nas: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag rgya glu gar 'bul ba 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig:

hūm̐: dran pa rnam dag gtor gzhong du: dbu ma gsal ba'i dpal bshos btsugs: ro rkyang bdud rtsis bran pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: mchin pa rang gsal gtor gzhong du: srog rtsa sdong po'i dpal bshos btsugs: snying khrag rak+tas bran pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: mkhal ma rnam dag gtor gzhong du: rtsa dkar 'bras bu'i dpal bshos btsugs: khams g.yo rak+tas bran pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: mtsher pa rnam dag gtor gzhong du: bshang gci dri yi dpal bshos btsugs: mkhris pa rak+tas bran pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: rgyu ma rnam dag gtor gzhong du: myid pa gyen skyes dpal bshos btsugs: chu ser rak+tas bran pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: phung po bem shun bhan+dha ru: sha dang rus pa'i dpal bshos btsugs: dri chu rak+tas bran pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ye shes chen po'i bhan+dha ru: dug lnga bsgral ba'i rak+tas bkang : lta ba klong yangs mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: gang shar chos nyid bhan+dha ru: tshogs drug rnam dag rak+tas bkang : sgom pa mi dmigs mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bkang :

bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ka dag rang byung bhan+dha ru: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+tas bkang : spyod pa bzo med mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dran rig so ma'i bhan+dha ru: mu bzhi bsgral ba'i rak+tas bkang : kun gzhi zag med mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dbyings rig zang thal bhan+dha ru: 'khor 'das mnyam sbyor rak+tas bkang : lam kun 'gog med mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: khyab brdal ye grol bhan+dha ru: du ma ro gcig rak+tas bkang : 'khor gsum yongs dag mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig:

de nas brda yis bshags pa ni: hūm̐: kun bzang che mchog rgyal ba zhi khro yi: dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: ye shes brtse bas dbyings nas dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bag med ma rig dbang gyur te: 'khor 'das thams cad sangs rgyas yin pa la: snang ba ris su phyes pa mthol lo bshags: snod bcud thams cad zhing khams yin pa la: 'dus byas mtshan mar 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: sgra grags thams cad drug cu'i gsung dbyangs la: bzang ngan tshig tu lta ba mthol lo bshags: gzugs snang thams cad sprul sku yin pa la: gdos gzugs mi ru 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: gang shar thams cad gnas lugs yin pa la: ngo bo ris su phyes pa mthol lo bshags: ye nas chos rnams 'du 'bral med pa la: mtshan bcas dge ba bsgrubs pa mthol lo bshags: mthol lo bshags so mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yi ge brgya pa bzla: dran rig ma bcos gnyug ma'i lta bas bshags: mtha' bral gsum gyi ngang la ci gnas bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: lta ba'i klong du skong bshags bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing*/ gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ma) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil non las: zhi khro'i mar me'i smon lam ye shes rab 'bar bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra rgya gar pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: thugs rje'i nyi 'od ma rig mun pa sel: sa mkhan tsan dan 'bar ba'i sgron me nyid: mngon sum dug lnga ye shes sgyur ba yi: snang ba'i sgo 'byed 'od gsal gdams pa bstan: smon lam 'di nyid lan gcig thebs gyur na: las ngan shan pa yin kyang lam sna zin: 'brel tshad don ldan yang snying bla na med: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yig ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos:

las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po mar me rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang : om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐: kong bu rin chen snod mchog 'dzam gling khyon: āḥ mar khu zad med bcud mchog mtsho ltar bskyil: hūm̐: sdong bu ri rab dbang po'i lhun ltar brjid: trām̐ḥ gsal ba'i gzi brjid nyi ma'i mdangs ltar 'bar: hrīḥ zer 'phros mchod sprin lha mo gtibs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: snang gsal thogs pa'i mchod sprin lha mo ni: mdzes ldan zhing rdul grangs dang mnyam pa yis: dug lnga ye shes sbar ba'i zhun me 'bul: bzhes nas stong khams ma rig mun gsal shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas thams cad kyi phyag tu mar me thogs la: hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'di: rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyis dbu bzung nas: bdag sogs rdo rje'i mched lcam thams cad kyis: kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me 'di phul bas: 'gro ba'i ma rig nyon mongs gsal bar shog: bslab gsum rnam dag snying rje'i gzhi bzung nas: tshul khrims rnam dag zhun me 'di phul bas: shes bya'i bag chags rab rib gsal bar shog: kṛ yog sde gsum theg pa'i lam sbyangs nas: brtson 'grus zab mo'i zhun me 'di phul bas: kun slong rtog pa'i mun pa gsal bar shog: ma hā a ti theg pa'i gzhung lam nas: shes rab ting 'dzin zhun me 'di phul bas: sgo lngar zhen pa'i mun pa gsal bar shog: tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i bcud kyi don rtogs nas:

smon lam dge bcu'i zhun me 'di phul bas: kun rtog blo yi mun pa gsal bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag sogs rigs drug sems can thams cad kun: gti mug drag pos 'khor ba bying ba yis: glen lkug dud 'gro'i gnas su ltung lags na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : chos dbyings ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig: zhe sdang drag pos bsad bcad rnam smin gyis: dmyal ba'i zangs dmar nang du ltung srid na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : me long ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig: ser sna zhen pa'i 'khri bas bcings pa yis: bkres skom yi dwags gnas su ltung srid na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : 'da' ka ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig: nga rgyal drag pos khengs sems bskyed pa yis: 'thab rtsod lha min gnas su ltung srid na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : mnyam nyid ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig: 'dod sred drag pos chags sdang bsags pa yis: skye 'chi ma dag mngal du ltung srid na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : sor rtogs ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig: phrag dog drag pos rdung rdeg 'phrog bcom gyis: pham ltung lha yi gnas su ltung srid na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : bya grub ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig: tshe rabs bsags pa'i bag chags rnam smin gyis: nyon mongs gcong rong sbubs su ltung srid na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : ka dag ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig:

gnas skabs rkyen gyur 'byung ba a 'thas kyis: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che la ltung srid na: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : gsal ba'i mar me'i thugs rje der ma chung : bkod pa rab rdzogs zhing la bdag drongs shig: hūm̐: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams: bdag sogs 'gro la thugs rjes rab brtse nas: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i g.yang sar mi gtong zhing : 'od gsal ting nge 'dzin gyis shugs mtshon nas: lhan skyes ye shes lam la bdag drongs shig: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa mchog thob par shog: ces pas bsngo smon rgyas par bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o// // tsa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i bar do drug gi rtsa tho bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: e maḥ bdag 'dra mkhas pa rgya gar pad 'byung ngas: yang zab man ngag bcud kyi thig le las: nyams len bar do drug gi rtsa tho bstan: gces par dgos pa'i gdams ngag mthar thug 'di: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yig ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po bar do drug gi rim pa ni: bsam gtan bar do rmi lam bar do dang : 'chi kha'i bar do chos nyid bar do dang : srid pa bar do skye gnas bar do ste: dang po 'chi kha'i bar do'i gdams pa ni: kye maḥ tshe la long med dal 'byor mi lus 'di: rab rib ngang las snang ba yud kyis zad: shin tu rnyed dka' thob pa'i dus 'di ru: rin chen gling nas stong log ma 'khyams par: brtson 'grus zab mo'i rgyud bskul snying po longs: thos bsam sgom gsum lung rigs zab mo'i chos: bskyed rdzogs gnyis te 'dus pa'i gnad 'di la:

long yod dud 'gro lta bur ma nyal bar: da lta nyid du 'bad pa drag po yis: mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom pa'i lcag gis bskul: long med blo sna stung ba'i dus gcig pu: kye maḥ bdag la bsam gtan bar do shar ba'i tshe: sgo gsum mtha' bral lta ba brtan pa'i ngang : tshogs drug lam du shar ba'i 'gyu ba kun: bdag 'dzin gzhi la ma bcos so mar bzhag: dgag sgrub spang blang bral dgos dus gcig pu: ting 'dzin ma yengs bsam gtan sgom pa'i tshe: nyon mongs 'khrul bas nam yang mi bslu zhing : dran rig gnyug ma'i gshis lugs rtogs par shog: kye maḥ bdag la rmi lam bar do shar ba'i tshe: nyin snang thams cad bden med stong pa nyid: mtshan mo bag chags yid lus phya phyo la: bdag 'dzin bral ba'i shes pa so mar lhod: 'khrul snang bag med sbyang ba'i dus gcig pu: rtsa khams bar do rmi lam longs sku'i zhing : yid lus stong gzugs sgyu mar don rtogs nas: rjes shes bag yod ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: kye maḥ bdag la 'chi kha'i bar do 'char dus der: 'byung 'khrug rlung gis sgyu lus gnad gcod cing : chags sdang zhen pas tshor ba hrag pa'i tshe: sgyu ma'i grogs dang zang zing 'khrul pa'i nor: thams cad 'dus byas yin pa shes par bya: gang la chags med blo sbyong dus gcig pu: 'chi khar gnad gcod sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe: gang la 'dzin chags zhen pa grol nas su: kun gsal rig pa'i ting 'dzin rtogs par shog: kye maḥ bdag la 'od gsal bar do 'char dus der: 'byung ba thim pa'i rang snang yid kyis bzung : snang mched thob gsum bag yod lhod kyis skyongs: gzhi yi 'od gsal ma dang rig pa bu: dal gcig gnas tshe de thog lhod kyis zhog: 'phro tshe bag yod dgos pa'i dus gcig pu: thim rim rdzogs nas 'od gsal shar ba'i tshe: srid pa'i nyon mongs rlung gis mi bskyod cing : ye shes gsal ba'i ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: kye maḥ bdag la srid pa bar do 'char dus der:

sgra 'od zer gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: rang rtsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul shes par bya: 'jigs skrag spangs nas sku gsum ngang la bsre: tha mal shes pa sbyong ba'i dus gcig pu: srid pa bar do'i 'khrul snang shar ba'i tshe: bden med sgyu ma'i ngo bo grol nas su: rtse gcig gnas lugs ting 'dzin 'bar bar shog: kye maḥ bdag la skye gnas bar do 'char dus der: rigs mthun nang tshan srid pa'i pho mo rnams: dag snang dpa' bo mkha' 'gror zhing sbyangs nas: yi dam lha yi bskyed rdzogs dran pas bzung : sngon gyi nyams len ma yengs rtse gcig ngang : mig ser chags sdang bral dgos dus gcig pu: srid pa'i mngal 'tshol skye gnas bar do ru: yab yum lha yi rnal 'byor sor rtogs nas: mi brjed gzungs kyis ting 'dzin rtogs par shog: kye maḥ 'dus byas phung por bar chod btab pa'i tshe: 'chi khar gnad gcod drag po mi myong shog: mi rtag tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa'i tshe: 'byung ba'i thim rim rang ngo shes par shog: snang mched thob gsum dbang po 'gags pa'i tshe: 'od gsal ma bur rang ngo 'phrod par shog: ro rkyang rlung g.yos bar do shar ba'i tshe: chos nyid sgra zer rang ngo 'phrod par shog: srid pa bar do'i yid lus thob pa'i tshe: chags sdang zhen pa'i 'khri ba chod par shog: mgo brnyan la sogs 'jigs skrag shar ba'i tshe: 'khrul gzugs sgyu ma'i rang ngo 'phrod par shog: g.yang sa gsum dang rngam sgra mthong ba'i tshe: mi 'jigs gdeng ldan rang ngo 'phrod par shog: las ngan dri za'i mngal sgo 'tshol ba'i tshe: sdug bsngal ma dag sa bon 'gag par shog: dag snang lha yi zhing khams mos pa'i tshe: bdud kyi lung bstan bar chad mi 'byung shog: skyon bral mkha' la rdzus te skye ba'i tshe: bkod pa rab rdzogs ya mtshan ldan par shog: gal te las dbang mi ru skye srid na: rtags mtshan ngo mtshar bcu drug ldan par shog: pha ma byang sems ldan der skye ba'i tshe:

yul gru bkra shis chos dang 'phrad par shog: chos dang 'phrad de mi brjed gzungs thob nas: 'gro la phan brtses chos 'khor bskor bar shog: rtag tu rab 'byams dge tshogs rgya mtsho yis: go 'phang bsgrub ste kun bzang la gnas shog: om̐ ma hā sa man+ta bha dra ṛ dhi ye swā hā: zhes bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas btab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma nyams len zab mo ma bsgoms sangs rgyas kyi: las rim cha lag ngo sprod rtsa tshig bzhag: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /bkra shis// // tsha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i bar do'i thos grol bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: bar do thos grol gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po thos grol gtong ba la: lus ngag yid gsum ma yengs ngang : rtse gcig gdung bas gsol 'debs bya: hūm̐: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes lcags kyus lam sna drang du gsol: kye ma tshe 'di'i 'dus byas 'jigs pa'i tshe: dang po 'chi ltas lus la rab phog nas: 'byung bzhi rgud cing lus la na tsha myong : gnad gcod rlung dang khams lnga 'khrugs pa yis: shes pa yad yud 'gyu dang phya phyo la: drin can bla mas thugs rje'i mdangs phyungs la: dran pas zin cing 'od gsal 'char bar shog: sa yi khams rnams chu la thim pa dang : sgyu lus ljid cing mnar gyis non pa'i tshe: sa khams mtsher rtsa chad nas sa rlung 'khrugs: ri rab 'ur chom snang ba shar ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: dran rig lhan skyes gnyug ma'i mdangs 'phros te:

bar do rang ngo rang gi shes par shog: chu yi khams rnams me la thim pa'i tshe: shes pa za zi kha sna 'tshub cing skem: chu khams mkhal rtsa chad nas chu rlung 'khrugs: rgya mtsho'i rlabs chol snang ba shar ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: ting 'dzin lta ba'i dgongs pa ngo 'phrod de: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: me yi khams rnams rlung la thim pa'i tshe: dbugs sna thung zhing tshig rnams rab tu ldog: me khams mchin rtsa chad nas me rlung 'khrugs: tshig sgra la sogs snang ba shar ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: bsam gtan mi g.yo'i gnas lugs don rtogs te: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: rlung khams rnam shes dag la thim pa'i tshe: drod rnams sdud de phyi yi snang ba nub: rlung khams glo rtsa chad nas las rlung 'khrugs: 'brug sgra sgrog ltar snang ba shar ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: shes rab zab mo'i rtogs pa rab mngon te: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: de nas phra ba'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: zhe sdang las gyur rtog pa so gsum 'gags: thig le mas babs dkar lam snang ba 'char: rkyang ma rlung ldog shes pa 'gags pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: gsal ba 'od kyi rang bzhin rtsal shar nas: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: de nas mched pa'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: 'dod chags las gyur rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags: rak+ta gyen ldog dmar lam snang ba 'char: ro ma'i rlung ldog shes pa 'gags pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: snang stong 'od kyi ting 'dzin rtsal shar nas: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: de nas nyer thob snang ba shar ba'i tshe: gti mug las gyur rtog pa rab bdun 'gags: srog rtsar rlung ldog nag lam snang ba 'char: rnam par shes pa dbu ma'i sbubs su brgyal: nag lam sgra chad rtog pa shar ba'i tshe:

rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: ka dag 'od kyi ting 'dzin rtsal shar nas: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: de nas zhi ba'i 'od gsal shar ba'i tshe: gsal snang g.ya' bral nam mkha' lta bu la: thob pa phyi ma'i rtog pa skye ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: dbyings rig 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa'i tshe: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: de nas rnam shes 'phrod de yid lus thob: sngar gyi bag chags stong gzugs lta bur 'char: gnyen 'brel la sogs yi mug sdug bsngal mthong : 'jig rten nor rdzas rnams la chags pa byed: sngar gyi ngan goms srid pa shar ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: snang srid sgyu ma lta bu'-i don rtogs nas: bar do rang ngo rang gi shes par shog: de la sogs te 'khrul snang bag chags kyis: sgra 'od zer gsum mi bzod lus la shar: zhi khro rab 'byams 'jigs gzugs sna tshogs ston: gcan gzan khro bo rnams kyis ngar skad 'byin: 'jigs shing skyo ba'i snying rlung lang ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: rang snang zhi khro tshogs su ngo shes shing : bar do'i 'khrul gzugs snang ba grol bar shog: de nas rang nyid shi ba thag chod nas: gang du skye ba'i gzugs dang mtshan nyid mthong : dbang med bya sgro rlung khyer ji bzhin du: mngal sgo 'tshol zhing dri za phya ma phyo: las kyi rlung dmar drag pos ded pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: rjes shes bag yod blo dang rab ldan nas: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs snying gi nang nas thon: sgra 'od zer gsum zhing khams lam mer shar: rang snang zhi khro'i tshogs su ma mthong nas: gti mug dud 'gro'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: chos dbyings ye shes ting 'dzin 'od lam du:

rnam snang bcom ldan 'das kyis mdun nas bsus: dbyings phyug yum chen ḍāk+kis rgyab nas skyor: bdag sogs bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: rab tu dga' ba'i sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhe sdang dmyal ba'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: me long ye shes ting 'dzin 'od lam du: rdor sems bcom ldan 'das kyis mdun nas bsus: dbyings phyug sangs rgyas spyan mas rgyab nas skyor: bdag sogs bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: dri ma med pa'i sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: nga rgyal pham ltung 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: mnyam nyid ye shes ting 'dzin 'od lam du: rin 'byung bcom ldan 'das kyis mdun nas bsus: dbyings phyug mā ma kī yis rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: rnam par gnon pa'i sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: 'dod chags skye 'chi'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: sor rtogs ye shes ting 'dzin 'od lam du: snang mtha' bcom ldan 'das kyis mdun nas bsus: dbyings phyug gos dkar mo yis rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: bde ba chen po'i sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phrag dog lha min 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: bya grub ye shes ting 'dzin 'od lam du: don grub bcom ldan 'das kyis mdun nas bsus: dbyings phyug dam tshig sgrol mas rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: lhun gyis grub pa'i sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ser snas yi dwags 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: 'da' ka ye shes ting 'dzin 'od lam du: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdun nas bsus:

ḍāk+ki rig ma brgyad kyis rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: kun tu 'od kyi sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bag chags las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: dbyings rig ye shes ting 'dzin 'od lam du: bcom ldan thub pa drug gis mdun nas bsus: sgo ba chen po bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: pad+ma can gyi sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dag pa rig 'dzin mgrin pa'i gnas nas thon: sgra 'od zer ltar 'khrugs pas rngo ma thogs: nyon mongs srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: sku lnga rnam dag ye shes 'od lam du: rig 'dzin yab yum rnams kyis mdun nas bsus: gar mo sgo skyong bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: ye shes chen po'i sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: khrag 'thung lha tshogs klad pa'i nang nas thon: rngam dang me 'od 'khrugs pas rngo ma thogs: skyi g.ya' las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: dran rig lta ba klong yangs 'od lam du: khro chen yab yum bcu yis mdun nas bsus: kau seng sgo ma rnams kyis rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: bya rtsol bral ba'i sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lte ba'i gnas nas thon: 'ja' tshon mdangs ltar shar bas rngo ma thogs: 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: khregs chod lta ba ting 'dzin 'od lam du: ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lngas mdun nas bsus: sgo ma gdong can bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: tshe 'das bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol nas: 'od gsal dbyings chen sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

phrin las lha tshogs gsang ba'i gnas thon: gtum drag 'jigs tshul bstan pas rngo ma thogs: 'khrul snang sgyu ma'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: ka dag ye grol chen po'i 'od lam du: dpal chen yab yum rnams kyis mdun nas bsus: dbang phyug sgo skyong rnams kyis rgyab nas skyor: bka' gter srung ma rnams kyis mtha' nas brten: yang dag sangs rgyas sa la drang du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha'i khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang zhing : chos dbyings ye shes zhing khams mthong bar shog: chu yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang zhing : mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: sa yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang zhing : dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: me yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang zhing : bde ba can gyi zhing khams mthong bar shog: rlung gi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang zhing : las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: sgra 'od zer gsum dgra ru mi sdang zhing : rab 'byams sna tshogs zhing khams mthong bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bdag lus sgyu ma ye shes gzhal yas khang : ka dag bde ba chen po'i 'od lnga'i klong : dran rig lta ba klong yangs shar phyogs su: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams lta na sdug: de ru sangs rgyas rdor sems yab yum bzhugs: sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: bla na med pa'i ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rtsal chen mda' 'phangs bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: dran rig lta ba klong yangs lho phyogs su: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams rnam par brgyan: de ru sangs rgyas rin 'byung yab yum bzhugs: sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: bla na med pa'i ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu khyod kyang :

rtsal chen mda' 'phangs bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: dran rig lta ba klong yangs nub phyogs su: bde ba can gyi zhing khams pad+ma rgyas: de ru sangs rgyas snang mtha' yab yum la: sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: bla na med pa'i ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rtsal chen mda' 'phangs bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: dran rig lta ba klong yangs byang phyogs su: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams bkod pas brgyan: de ru sangs rgyas don grub yab yum la: sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: bla na med pa'i ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rtsal chen mda' 'phangs bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: dran rig lta ba klong yangs dbus phyogs su: stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams pad+ma 'od: de ru sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum la: sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: bla na med pa'i ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rtsal chen mda' 'phangs bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭḥ

ces pas 'phang : smon lam ni: hoḥ kun bzang che mchog 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: dgongs pa zab mo thugs rje'i klong chen gyis: rnam dag 'od gsal mchog gi rtsal phyung nas: srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab tu skem byas shing : mtha' yas 'gro kun byang chub lam bkod nas: thog ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog: ces pas bsngo smon bgyis: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas ky-is: bar do gnad kyi smon lam bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin pad+ma gter bdag gling pas/ lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus pa'o// // dza) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i chos spyod na raka mtsho skem bzhugs so : bla ma dang bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: na mo hūm̐: 'og min 'thug po bkod pa ka dag zhing : rnam dag ngo mtshar rab rdzogs gnas mchog der: sangs rgyas rgya mtsho drwa ba'i rnam rol sku: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po bzhugs: sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: zab zhi thugs la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: ma 'dres snang tshul chu zla'i dbang po bzhin: dbyings rig lam la rtsol med rdzogs pa yis: sa mchog de ru rab tu bgrod par shog: thos bsam sgom gsum nam yang g.yo med kyis: nyon mongs srid pa'i 'ching ba grol bar shog: yengs med dran pa rjes shes bag yod kyis: nam yang ma rig kun rtog sel bar shog: snying rje'i lam drug bslab pas rgyud sbyangs nas: rang rgyud bag med khengs sems grol bar shog: ma gyur 'gro la gtong phod dge rtsa yis: bsod nams 'bras bu'i tshogs chen rdzogs par shog: dad dang shes rab snying rjes rgyud sbyangs nas: chags sdang mig ser zhen pa chod par shog: bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor zung 'jug don gnyis kyis:

ye shes dga' ba'i ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: rdzogs pa'i go rim zab mo brtan pa yis: kun brtags yid kyi mun pa sel bar shog: rtsa thig rlung gi pho nyas lam sbyangs pas: yas bab mas brtan 'ja' lus bskyed par shog: rmi lam 'od gsal chos longs lam sbyangs pas: sna tshogs sprul sku'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: spros bcas spros med zung 'jug nyams len gyis: 'od gsal bde stong ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: dug lnga ro snyom spyod pa'i rlabs sbyangs pas: lhun grub sku lnga'i ye shes 'char bar shog: dran rig gshis lugs ngo bo gnas pa yis: dran pa mi nyams mi brjed gzungs thob shog: gang shar tshogs drug sgyu mar spyod pa yis: shes bya 'khor ba'i bag chags sreg par shog: nam zhig 'dus byas 'thor ba'i bar do ru: rnam smin las kyi 'jigs skrag mi 'byung shog: srid par grub nas dri za'i mngal 'tshol tshe: ma dag rigs drug mngal sgo chod par shog: las dbang rigs drug duḥkha 'khor gyur na: rtse gcig lta bas sdug bsngal sel bar shog: gzhi lam 'bras gsum zab mo'i theg pa yis: tshe rabs chos gter gsang mdzod rnyed par shog: lta sgom spyod gsum gcig shes kun grol gyis: 'khor 'das chos sku'i dbyings su grol bar shog: phung po yal tshe 'od lus drwa ba ru: kun bzang thugs dang dbyer med gcig par shog: phyir mi ldog ste yang dag sa mchog tu: gnas te sa bcu'i go 'phang yongs rdzogs shog: kun tu bzang po'i smon lam ci 'dra ba: de 'drar bdag gyur yon tan rab rdzogs shog: bdag sogs gnas yul bkra shis dge legs shing : don gnyis 'bras bu'i go 'phang der rdzogs shog: ces pas bsngo smon rgyas par bya: sa ma ya: e ma zhing khams rab rdzogs pa'i: gnad kyi smon lam khyad par can: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas/

lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // wa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gter bdag gter srung kyi las byang dregs dpung nag po dgra snying dmar 'byin bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: chos skyong gter srung sgrub pa'i thabs: dregs dpung dgra snying dmar 'byin bstan: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal lha yi lcam: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: ban bon ngan pa bdud kyi rigs: 'dre rgod 'byung po bstan pa'i dgra: de sogs skal ngan bsgral ba dang : sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing phyir: yang gsang snying gi byang bu nyid: dbang thob dam ldan sngags pa yis: yid la bskul ba tsam gyis chog: sgrub par brtson na lta ci smos: de phyir zab rgya khyad par 'phags: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'khor: mchod khang ka cha rten rnams bsrung : gter chos ka gcig phyi na 'brang : spyad na nas bre tsam la myur: phor kha'i mchod pa tsam gyis dgyes: log lta yid 'gyu tsam gyis 'khu: mchod bstod bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub: rbad bskul rtsa sngags tsam gyis chog: bla rten srog yig tsam la 'khor: rjes 'jug dbang thob tsam yang skyong : de phyir dregs pa spu gri'i rtse: bstan pa srung ba'i mel tshe 'di: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dbang thob lung ldan sngags pa yis: chos skyong sgrub pa bya ba'i thabs: dur khrod dam ni shing gcig drung : stegs bu dbus nyid mtho ba la: dug khrag gri khrag chag chag gdab: ma traṃ g.yang gzhi dkyil 'khor dgod: dbus dang phyogs bzhi dkyil 'khor mdog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad dang : de yi phyi rol rtsibs dgu pa: phyi rol dkyil 'khor gzhan dang mtshungs: dbus su thod pa mtshan ldan nang : bla 'khor bla rdo dar snas dril: steng du dar nag gur yang phub:

g.yas su mdung ring nag po la: bla dar gzugs dang bskang rdzas brgyan: g.yon du mdung ring nag po la: ru mtshon zlog sngags rbad sngags bri: rgyab tu mda' mo sgro gsum la: gri rgod snying dang shwa rde'u: me long phur pa rdo rje dang : dar tshon sna lnga ba dan te: rgyan gsum la sogs rgyas par btags: mdun du sman gtor rak+ta bsham: gtor ma'i stod ni spyi mthun ltar: smad ni pad 'dab thod skam ste: nyi shu rtsa gcig dag gi phreng : sku 'bag tsa ka li yang gzugs: rtse mor me ri rgyal mtshan brgyan: lte bar srog yig rtsa sngags bzhag: lho ru tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang : rtag gtor stod zur smad zlum la: nyi shu rtsa gsum dag gis bskor: sha sna snying sna liṅgas brgyan: rak+ta skyems bcas tshang bar bsham: nub tu bum pa ril bu'am: bum rdzas tshang bar chu yis bkang : kha rgyan mgul chings tshang bar byas: me long sin+dhu ra yis byugs: ha ri ni sa hūm̐ srog bcas: hring dza zhes pa'i yi ge bri: de dag bum pa'i kha yang brgyan: byang phyogs rgyun gtor lha grangs ni: dmar gtor sha dang nyungs sgog brgyan: rbad pa'i zor bzlog chung ngur bzhag: de la dug thun nag po gzugs: rdo rje phur pa dag kyang bzhag: phyi rol mi lpags g.yang gzhi yis: 'khor yug dag tu bskor bar bya: ma 'dzoms shog bu 'khor yug la: mi lpags dur khrod chas kyang bri: zur bzhir mi lpags rgyal mtshan rtser: bhan+dha skam po'i tog kyang bskyon: rgyu ma'i lda ldi drwa ba bri: gri bzhi mda' bzhi phur pa bzhi: mdung bzhi me long bzhi dang ni: sbal sbrul rgyan 'phyangs rnams kyang bri: spyi bor mi lpags bla bre ni: gru gsum bsrung bzlog sngags kyang bris: mdun du brub khung nag po ni: phung shul dgu yi sa la bcol: de yang ru tra'i snying gar brtsegs: logs gsum shan pa klu dang gnyan: sku 'bag bris sam 'bur dod bzhengs: bang rim dgu yi ri mo bri:

rgyun lam dregs pa'i tsakli btsugs: de steng ri rab phur pa la: liṅga rgya chings thag pas btags: phyi rol rtsang dang mtshon chas bskor: thun rdzas la sogs bshams pa dang : thun gtor rnams kyang rim bzhin 'bul: mchod gzhung dag ni gzhan dang mtshungs: rang nyid khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dpa' gcig yab yum bskyed kyang rung : mdun tu bka' srung pho brang bsgom: yang na rang nyid bya rog gdong : sde brgyad dpung dang bcas pa bsgom: sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa rtags rdzogs nas: liṅga 'gugs sngags bsad sngags bzla: dgra bo sod rtags byung nas su: sbyin sreg bya'am gtad par byas: dgra bo dpung chen gong non gtso: de nyung dag ni gang byas rung : cung zad 'gyang na mi rgyud chad: rang la ldog cing 'khu ba dang : dgra la rbad kyang mi 'gro na: sku 'bag mgo mjug ldog nas su: thun gyis brab cing tha tshig bsgrag: dgra bo rtsad brlag byung nas su: byad bkrol gtad bkrol 'khor lo bskor: de yang bka' brgyad gzhung bzhin byas: pha rol mthu che mi thub na: kho yi lo shing de yi dgra: gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad ni: gzugs 'gros lo shing de la bskyon: dmod pa bor la zor yang 'phang : de yang kho rang yul du bskyal: de nas cis kyang ma thub na: dregs pa rbad pa'i 'khor lo bskor: de nas dgra bo rtsad nas brlag: dgra bo'i rjes sa shin tu gces: ri bshig bya na gter du sbas: rgyun bsnyen mthu sgrub mi dgos na: las mtha' tsam gyis bsgral las bya: 'grub na dbang bzhi rnams kyang blang : rjes su bla 'khor 'chang bar bya: bka' brgyad bzlog pa'i skabs su ni: dkyil 'khor gzhung las tshang phyir du: zur du sgrub gtor ma lags pa'i: gzhan gyi mchod pa bya mi dgos: las byang sngags la bskyal nas bzhag: dgong mo gtor 'bul rim ltar bya: dkyil 'khor lag len bca' gzhi tshang: sa ma ya: de nas dkyil 'khor skad cig dran rdzogs su: dmigs pa wal gyis 'di ltar bsgom:

rol mo dbyangs chen gzhung ltar la: rkang gling gtser zhing dri gsur btang : hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig dpal chen he ru kaḥ che mchog khro rgyal khrag 'thung smug nag sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal gdangs spyan rtsa 'khrugs: smin ma dbu skra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam brgyan cing dar nag cod pan bskyod: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas bcus brgyan: yum mchog gnam zhal mthing nag gri thod 'khyud: bskal pa'i me dpung bam chen gdan la 'gyings: om̐ shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rtsa sngags gtso gcig ltar na de bzhin byas kyang chog: de nas dpal chen bskyed cing drag sngags kyi sgrub pa ltar na: hūm̐: snang srid klong yangs snod bcud drag po'i zhing : phyi nang dkyil 'khor dur khrod e yi klong : lha srin sde brgyad bsnol ba'i khri steng du: dpal chen che mchog khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag stong khams gling bzhi 'jigs: nyi shu rtsa gcig rngam zhal srid rtser gnon: zhal gdang drag sngags hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: spyan dmar thams cad tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: shangs nas drag po'i rlung 'gyu 'u ru ru: snyan nas grags stong sgra skad di ri ri: dbu skra thod phreng me dpung lhabs se lhab: g.yas pa nyer gcig lcags rdor rtse dgu bsnams: g.yon pa nyer gcig lha srin klad khrag dkrugs: dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa pho nyar 'gyed: bco brgyad zhabs ni gling bzhir dor stabs bgrad: yum mchog rnam zhal mthing nag pang du 'khyud: zhal dgu khro zhing g.yas g.yon bco brgyad la: gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs 'khril yab yum bskal me'i klong du gsal: snang srid snod bcud rang mdangs rol rtsal shar: om̐ shrī he ru ka ma hā kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rang nyid che mchog tu gsal ba'i mdun du dur khrod dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: rang nyid che mchog stobs ldan gsal ba'i mdun: dur khrod chen po me rlung 'tshub rgyas ni: snang srid khro bcu bgrod tshe ya nga ba'i: shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog pho brang dbus: khrag zhag rba rlabs mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i klong : mi ro rta ro ri ltar spungs pa'i gnas: pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng : srog bdag mgon po dpal ldan bya rog gdong : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku che yan lag rags: drag po spyan mig tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: shangs nas rlung g.yos zhal nas rngam mche gtsigs: dbu skra dmar nag stong khams sprin ltar gtibs: thod skam brgyan cing dug sbrul cod pan 'phur: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs nas phyar: g.yon pas bhan dmar rak+ta zhal du 'dren: dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' chas rgyan dang ldan: zhabs gnyis 'gying bag khrag 'thung rol pa'i stabs: yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo srin gzugs ma: zangs mchu ldan zhing mche gtsigs dgra sha za: gri thod 'dzin cing yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: dur khrod chas rdzogs g.yas brkyang g.yon pa 'khril: me ri dmar nag klong du gsal bar bskyed: yab yum sprul pa'i bya rog dmar nag brgyad: rngam mchu brdar zhing mkha' la lam lam 'jums: snang la rang bzhin zang thal ngang du bskyed: om̐ ma hā kā la khā kha mu kha ya: kro ti ni tsa ti baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar phyogs me rlung dur khrod bam gyi steng : lho btsan nag po dpal ldan seṅge'i gdong : zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: thod skam brgyan cing dar nag cod pan 'phur: phyag g.yas btsan mdung g.yon pas dgra snying bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: stag mo ri bkra myur mgyogs shugs 'chang brdzis: yum mchog bdud mo sha za seng gdong 'khril: kha ṭ+wāṃ dgra snying 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: dur khrod chas ldan yab yum me klong gsal: om̐ ma hā dak+ṣi ṇa shu la siṃ ha du li ṇi hūm̐ phaṭḥ

hūm̐: lho phyogs me rlung dur khrod bam gyi steng : ma mo srog bdag e ka dzā ṭi la: dmar nag khro zhal dbu skra thod skam brgyan: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan gsum glog ltar 'gyu: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas nad rkyal bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan 'brug mo mgo dgu chibs: bskal pa'i me 'bar smug nag klong du gsal: om̐ kro ti e ka dzā ṭi rak+mo ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs dur khrod me ri dmar nag klong : gza' bdud nag po khyab 'jug rā hu la: ljang sngon dbu dgu bya rog mgo dang bcu: thams cad khro zhing dbu skra thod skam 'bar: g.yas g.yon dang po ral gri chu srin gdugs: mtha' gnyis mda' gzhu sbrul gyi zhags pa 'khyugs: lte ba'i khro zhal gdangs shing dam nyams za: sbrul mjug 'khyil zhing glog zhags dmar mor chibs: sprin nag sngo mar dug rlangs dbus su gsal: om̐ hri rā hu la ki kang du pra ma ya dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs me rlung dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong : btsan rgod chen po dam can rdo rje legs: sku mdog dmar nag dbu la bswe zhu gsol: khro gtum spyan 'khrugs mche bas ma mchu mnan: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tsit+ta bsnams: 'jol ber sngo khra gsol zhing seṅge chibs: bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag klong du gsal: om̐ badz+ra sa dhū tsa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng : khrag mtsho pad+ma ru tra'i gdan steng du: gnod sbyin btsan rgod khrag 'thung 'bar ba ni: sku mdog dmar nag bswe khrab rmog zhu gsol: dar dmar rtsi ber gsol zhing ru dar brgyan: spyan rtsa rab 'khrugs mche bas ma mchu gnan: phyag g.yas tsan dan beng chen dmag gi gter: g.yon pas btsan mdung zhags pa spring spring 'khyugs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan brgyan: swag lham gsol zhing rag pa rting dkar chibs: me rlung dmar nag 'tshub ma'i klong du gsal:

om̐ yak+sha ma hā shu la tsa tri dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dur khrod 'bar ba baṃ gyi gdan steng du: klu rgyal chen po mun pa stag ring ni: sngo nag dbu dgu sbrul gdengs ral pa bsigs: zhal rnams khro la g.yas g.yon ral gri sbrul: mtha' gnyis dgra satwa nad kyi rkyal pa thogs: rngam pa'i gzugs can dur khrod chas dang ldan: chu srin la chibs me dpung klong du gsal: om̐ nā ga kha dun rā dza dza bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dur khrod dmar nag rngam yangs bam gyi gdan: gnod sbyin chen po mi bdud seng mgo ni: dmar nag zhal gdang thod skam dbu la brgyan: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag thogs: dur khrod chas ldan dred mong mi gzan chibs: srab mda' sbrul nag thod rlon phreng bas brgyan: me ri 'bar zhing rlung nag g.yo nang gsal: om̐ yak+sha siṃ ha du ma ra rak+sha ya dza hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: dur khrod chen po bam chen bsnol ba'i steng : dge bsnyen chen po yak+sha ging dmar ni: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril dbu skra me ltar 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur bu bsgril: dur khrod chas ldan btsan rta dmar zhur chibs: rab 'jigs 'bar ba srog bdag tshul du gsal: om̐ ti pa ra tsa yak+sha ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: 'jigs rung 'bar ba bam gyi gdan steng du: lha chen gnyan po rgyal ba thod dkar ni: zhi ba'i cha lugs dung khrab rmog zhu gsol: phyag gnyis dgra satwa dar mdung zhags pa 'khyugs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan bsnams: lcang shes rlung shugs chibs shing rdzu 'phrul tshul: kha char bu yug 'tshub 'khyil klong du gsal: om̐ a mi dhe wa si ta rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: dug rlung 'bar ba bam gyi gdan steng du: gza' rgod spen pa spu gri mi dmar ni: dbu dgu rngam zhing zhal gdangs khro zhing 'khrugs: dbu skra rab 'bar thod skam dar dmar brgyan: dmar po me zer mdog can phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum spu gri g.yon gsum dgra snying 'dzin:

dur khrod chas ldan snang srid rlung la chibs: myur zhing tsha ngar 'khrigs pa'i klong du gsal: om̐ ki kang tsak+ṣu rak+ta tri hūm̐ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: me rlung 'bar ba klong yangs bam gyi gdan: dam can chen po rak+sha thod phreng ni: smug nag mdog can 'ob zhu bswe khrab gsol: phyag g.yas thod phreng g.yon pas snying phreng 'dzin: ra rgod chibs shing myur mgyogs pho nyar gsal: om̐ badz+ra rak+sha bhan+dha kha la ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dur khrod smug nag bam gyi gdan steng du: srin mo khrag ral gdong dmar chen mo ni: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum spu gri ral gri chu srin bsnams: g.yon gsum bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ tsit+ta 'bar: chibs su phung stag nag po mgo dgu chibs: khrag zhags rgya mtsho mer ba'i klong du gsal: om̐ badz+ra rak+sha kro ti li rak+sha du bh+yo dza dzaḥ hūm̐: de yi phyi rol rtsibs dgu ru: rgya mtsho mer pa'i klong yangs dbus: klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan ni: sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: sbrul gyi gdengs ka bdun dang ldan: nor bu 'bar bas yan lag brgyan: phyag g.yas lcags kyu 'bar ba dang : g.yon pas sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin: sa bdag rus sbal mgo dgu chibs: sngo nag rlung gi sgong bur gsal: om̐ nā ga pra bha ṇi paṃ dza hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad pa: mi nag mgo dgu lag pa brgyad: shin tu khro la mi bdud gzugs: g.yas bzhis lcags kyu rgyu zhags bsnams: g.yon bzhis snying dang mi lpags bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs gnyis myur: om̐ she la du ging rā dza hūm̐ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring ni: dmar nag srin lus 'dab chags sder: lag gnyis lus tshad bcu gsum ring : lcags kyu mi snying dmar po bsnams: lus la sbrul nag stong gis brgyan: zhabs gnyis dor stabs gcer bu 'jigs: om̐ nā ga shu la tsa tri rbad bh+yo dzaḥ hūm̐: shan pa btsan rgod mi dmar ni: gcer bu 'jigs pa'i cha byad can:

phyag gnyis spu gri ngar ma 'dzin: g.yon pas mi lpags g.yang gzhi rdeb: stag sham zhabs gnyis gar sgyur tshul: dgra srog rngam pa'i tshul du gsal: om̐ tsa tri ya shu la ha tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: sman btsun chen mo sngo nag ma: ral bsig phyag g.yas mda' dar la: g.yon pas g.yu yi ne'u le 'dzin: gcer mo 'jigs pa'i nyams gyur bsgom: om̐ bhe ru hi ma mo rak+sha dza dzaḥhūm̐: klu bdud nā ga rak+sha ni: sku mdog sngo nag srin gzugs pa: sbrul nag ral pa khrag gis brgyan: g.yas g.yon sbal sbrul gcer bu'i lus: zhabs dor khrag rlung dbus su gsal: om̐ nā ga kha dun rak+sha dza dzaḥ hūm̐: gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu ni: nag po lcags sdig dgu yis brgyan: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: 'khor lo gtun shing be con dang : rgyu zhags snying dang khrag bkang bsnams: sku smad sbrul mjug dug rlangs gsal: om̐ phe sha pā paṃ ya du dza dzaḥ hūm̐: las mkhan spu gri rlung gshog ni: dmar po mi lus zangs sprel gdong : spu gri gshog pa gcer bu pa: phyag gnyis rlung gri 'khor lo 'dzin: zhabs gnyis bya sder dgra snying bsnun: me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su gsal: om̐ yam shu ghṛ wa dza dzaḥ hūm̐: mon pa nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs: zhal gsum khro zhing ral nag bsigs: g.yas g.yon bam ro pho mo drud: gar bsgyur dgra sha dgyes par bskyed: om̐ ya ma du ra kā la dza dzaḥ hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul pa: sha za gcan spyang nyi khri stong : bya nag rngam 'gyur nyi khri stong : rang 'dra las mkhan bye ba 'bum: dgra srog gcod pa'i pho nya rnams: snang stong 'dzin med ci bzhin du: bdag mdun thugs ka'i sa bon gyis: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

de nas spyan 'dren pa ni rkang gling rol mo drag tu bsgrag: hūm̐: dur khrod rngam brjid rol pa'i klong dkyil nas: mgon po bya rog gdong can gshegs su gsol: sprul pa dur khrod rang rang gnas mchog nas: zhing skyong lha btsan nag po gshegs su gsol: srog bdag e ka dzā ṭi gshegs su gsol: gza' bdud khyab 'jug mgo dgu gshegs su gsol: btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa gshegs su gsol: 'bar ba khrag 'thung chen po gshegs su gsol: klu rgyal mun pa stag ring gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin mi bdud seng mgo gshegs su gsol: dge bsnyen yak+sha ging mar gshegs su gsol: lha chen rgyal ba thod dkar gshegs su gsol: gza' rgod spen pa spu gri gshegs su gsol: dam can rak+sha thod phreng gshegs su gsol: srin mo khrag ral ma mo gshegs su gsol: klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan gshegs su gsol: dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad gshegs su gsol: klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring gshegs su gsol: shan pa btsan rgod mi dmar gshegs su gsol: sman btsun sngo nag chen mo gshegs su gsol: klu bdud nā ga rak+ṣa gshegs su gsol: gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu gshegs su gsol: las mkhan spu gri rlung gshog gshegs su gsol: las byed mon pa nag po gshegs su gsol: phyi nang sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: dam nyams byad ma bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dharma pā la dzaḥdzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: dam nyams ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gdan dbus: khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong nus rtsal shugs: skyed mdzad rin chen gter gyi srung ma rnams: sngon gyi pad 'byung tha tshig dran la bstod: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rak+ta'i yon chab lbu ba phyogs bcur g.yo: dbang po'i me tog ri rab brjid ltar spungs:

sha rus bsregs pa'i dri mchog ngar dang ldan: rkang mar lha ba zhag gi sgron me sbar: gser zhun mdangs ldan mkhris pa'i dri chab gtams: ru tra'i snying bshos dmar nag nang rol brgyan: rkang gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: phyi yi mchod sprin dpag yas zhing bkod 'di: chos skyong gter bdag srung ma'i tshogs rnams la: 'bul lo dam nyams dgra bo cham la phob: sangs rgyas bstan pa rtag tu rgyas par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la kha raṃ khā hi: sogs nas rak+ta l ma hā tsit+ta l go ro tsa na l ba su ta l i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas sman gtor rak+ta ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha'i snod du bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil: ga ṇa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo dbyings dang mnyam: dmar chen bdud rtsi'i zhag g.yo bcud dang ldan: rtag gtor dpal chen bshos bu khyon gyis brgyan: rgyun gtor nar ma spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: 'bul lo sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: dam nyams dgra la chad pa drag po phob: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya: pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra om̐ āḥhūm̐: kha kha khā hi: de nas spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis bskang ba ni: hūm̐: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po bya rog gdong : bka' yi chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod rnam lnga'i dam rdzas bha ling+ta: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol gnyis med mchod pa'i mchog: mi lpags g.yang gzhi bla bre mkha' la bkram: ru tra'i sha rus dur khrod rdza ltar nyil: rta nag g.yag nag khyi nag lug nag dang : bya nag sbrul nag dar nag ru mtshon dang : mda' mdung ral gri rtse gsum thug dang brgyan: dar tshon me long shwa rgyan rtsis kyi bkra: bla 'khor srog 'khor sku 'khor rbad 'khor dang :

zlog 'khor las mtshon bzlog gtor thun gyi rdzas: rten gtor rtag gtor rgyun gtor thun gtor dang : pho brang dur khrod rgyan bkod mdzes pa'i tog: phyi nang mnyes pa'i mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'dis: las mgon bya rog gdong can thugs dam bskang : dpal 'bar zhing skyong lho btsan thugs dam bskang : ma mo sngags kyi bdag mo'i thugs dam bskang : gza' bdud khyab 'jug mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang : dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung thugs dam bskang : klu rgyal mun pa stag ring thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin mi bdud seng mgo'i thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen yak+sha ging dmar thugs dam bskang : lha chen rgyal ba thod dkar thugs dam bskang : gza' rgod shan pa spu gri'i thugs dam bskang : dam can rak+sha thod phreng thugs dam bskang : srin mo khrag ral ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad thugs dam bskang : klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring thugs dam bskang : shan pa btsan rgod mi dmar thugs dam bskang : sman btsun chen mo sngo nag thugs dam bskang : klu bdud nā ga rak+sha'i thugs dam bskang : gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang : las mkhan spu gri rlung gshog thugs dam bskang : las byed mon pa nag po'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsol ba dang : phyi nang bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho gsang ba'i lha tshogs kyi: mchod rdzas ma tshang bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba dang : bskyed rdzogs ma gsal nor 'khrul chad pa dang : le lo btang snyoms 'khrul tshogs ci mchis pa: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol:

ces yig brgya bzla: chos skyong 'khu ba sogs byung na bskang ba gtso che: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed che mchog legs ldan bya rog gdong : dur khrod chas rdzogs srid gsum stobs 'dus pa: mthu stobs dbang phyug khyed la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dpal 'bar chen po zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : dur khrod chas rdzogs rol stabs stag steng bzhugs: dgra srog gcod tshe lho btsan lus bzung ba: ma hā kā la khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: sngags srung chen mo ma mo ral gcig ma: ye shes dbyings kyi gtso mo dmar nag gzugs: ral gris dgra srog gcod cing nad rkyal 'phyo: sngags srung chen mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang sgyur ljang sngon zhal: mkha' la rgyu zhing dgra la thog ser 'beb: rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin cing dgra snying 'dzer: khyab 'jug chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra dam can gyis: pad+ma'i bka' nyan seṅge dkar mo zhon: dam nyams bsgral ba'i tsit+ta zhal du gsol: rdo rje legs pa khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: srog bdag gnod sbyin khrag 'thung chen po ni: me 'od mdog can btsan zhags dgra la 'debs: dmag dpung bskyed cing sangs rgyas bstan pa srung : chos skyong chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: klu rgyal chen po mun pa stag ring ni: sngo nag sbrul ral ral gri dgra la 'debs: bstan dgra bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa: klu bdud chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gnod sbyin chen po mi bdud seng mgo ni: sku mdog dmar nag dred mong smyon pa chibs: bdag la sdang ba'i byad ma'i srog snying phrol: gnod sbyin chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dge bsnyen chen po yak+sha ging dmar ni: rdo rje phyar zhing phur bu bgegs la 'debs: rta dmar bzhon cing stong gsum yud kyis bskor:

dge bsnyen chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: lha yi rgyal po mi dkar zhi tshul 'chang : lha rta zhon cing ru dar dkar po bsnams: rin chen gter srung phyi nang bar chad bsal: rgyal ba thod dkar khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gza' rgod spu gri mi dmar mkha' la rgyu: dam nyams dgra la thog ser myur du 'bebs: dur khrod chas ldan rlung rta chibs mdzad pa: ki kang chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dam can chen po rak+sha thod phreng ni: ra rgod la chibs dgra bo'i snying rtsa len: smug nag 'ob zhu gsol mdzad dregs pa che: gter srung chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: srin mo khrag mdog sha za me 'od gdong : phung stag la chibs dgra bo'i tsit+ta len: mtshon cha drag po char chen dgra la 'beb: khrag ral ma mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: klu mo chen mo gsang ba 'od ldan ni: rol mtsho sa ya stong gi gnyer 'dzin ma: nor bus brgyan cing sgrub la dngos grub ster: klu yi dbang mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: bdud kyi dge bsnyen chen po lag brgyad kyis: lcags kyu gdeng mdzad dgra bo'i snying nas bzung : mi lag tsit+ta 'dzin byed bdud ging che: nag po dgra 'joms khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: klu btsan mi gzan bla 'gugs pho nya ni: brkyang bskum lag pas stong gsum dgra snying snyob: srin lus dmar nag sder mos lcags kyu 'dzin: shan pa lag ring khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: btsan gyi shan pa gcer bu dmar nag gis: g.yang gzhi dmar po dgra yul zhing la rdeb: mchong rgyug tshul gyis dgra la ltas ngan 'bebs: btsan rje dmar po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: sman mo chen mo 'byung lnga'i mnga' bdag mo: mda' dar ne'u le 'dzin mdzad bstan srung ma: mi snying stong la rang snying khengs mdzad ma: g.ya' gangs nags chu'i sman mo che la bstod: hūm̐: nā ga rak+sha klu bdud sngo nag gzugs: sbrul gyi zhags 'dren gling bzhi'i dgra bo 'ching :

gar sgyur cho 'phrul stobs dbang chos 'khor skyong : nā ga rak+sha khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gnyan rgod nag po dbyings la 'gyu byed pa: mi lus lcags sdig mgo dgus dgra sha za: byad ma brnag pa'i snying khrag hub kyis 'debs: gnyan rgod dug gdong khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: las mkhan dmar po spu gri'i gshog pa can: mgo bo zangs sprel sder mo bya yi gzugs: dgra la rbad tshe srog rtsa snying khrag gtub: spu gri rlung gshog khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: mon pa gcer bu shan pa nag po yis: ral nag bsigs shing dgra bo pho mo drud: nang rol 'dren cing gar stabs rdzu 'phrul bsgyur: mon pa chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: phyi nang sprul pa dam can srung ma'i tshogs: thugs dam bskul mdzad dmigs pa'i dgra bo sgrol: bstan pa'i srog skyong sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bdag bstod do: zhes bstod cing phrin las rnams ngag gis brjod: de nas sgrub pa'i thugs dam 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: dam can rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i tshogs: 'dzab kyi thugs dam phrin las rnams: sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan pos bzung : deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: zhes sngags rnams mdun bskyed dam: mjug tu yod pa ltar bzlas sgrub kyi sngags bzla: de nas sngags rdzogs mtshams su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: lcags snod du liṅga dang gtor ma bshams shing : hūm̐: mdun du drag po lcags kyi hom̐: rngam yangs shor med btson khang du: dam nyams dgra bo'i gzugs ling ni: chaig kho rang mngon sum gsal: de nas lan gsum dgra bo'i lus ngag gsal te dgug: hūm̐: dam can chos skyong bka' sdod bden pa'i mthus: gzugs ling 'di la dgra bo myur du khug: las mkhan pho nyas ma shor dam du zungs: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dgra bo dza dzaḥ de nas bsgral ba dang bstab pa cha la bya rung ngo : hūm̐: dam can pho nya chos skyong gis:

dam nyams dgra bo bsgral zhing gtub: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol: ces rtsa sngags kyis 'bul: yang na khā hi gcig pus dbang po rnam brgyad 'bul kyang chog: sa ma ya: de nas dgra bo bkug cing thun gyis brdeg pa ni: sgrub pa las gzhung sngags 'chang gis: rang nyid che mchog gsal ba'i ngang : sngags kyis pho nya'i rgyud la bskul: dgra bo'i rnam shes bla 'khyams ni: nyin mtshan dus drug bkug bya zhing : rgyun du smra ba mi bya ste: dgra bo'i ming byang sham bu bcas: 'gugs pa'i las sngags kha bsgyur bya: om̐ ma hā kā la khā kha mu kha kro ti ṇi tsa ti baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā ḍāk+ki ṇi shu la siṃ ha du li ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ti e ka dzā ṭi rak+mo ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ om̐ hrī rā hu la ki kang du pra ma ya dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ om̐ badz+ra sa dhū tsa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ yak+sha ma hā shu la tsa tri dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ nā ga kha dun rā dza dza dzaḥ om̐ yak+sha siṃ ha du ma ra rak+sha ya dza hūm̐ dzaḥ om̐ ti pa ra tsa yak+sha ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ a dhe wa si ta ra tsa dza hūm̐ dzaḥ om̐ ki kang tsak+ṣu rak+ta tri hūm̐ dza dzaḥ om̐ badz+ra rak+sha bhan+dha kha la ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥ om̐ rak+sha kro ti li rak+sha du bh+yo dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga pra bha ṇi paṃ dza hūm̐ dzaḥ om̐ she la du ging rā dza hūm̐ dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga shu la tri rbad bh+yo dzaḥ om̐ tsa tri ya shu la ha tri dza dzaḥ om̐ bhe ru hi ma mo rak+sha dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga kha na rak+sha dza dzaḥ om̐ phe sha pā paṃ ya du dza dzaḥ om̐ yam shu ghṛ wa dza dzaḥ om̐ ya ma du ra kā la dza dzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags bzla zhing 'grub rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgrub: de nas dgra bo 'gugs pa'i rtsa sngags kyi sham bur: byad ma chaig dza dzaḥ nā ga shu la tri king kā la shag dun tu tra dza dzaḥ ya shag rū pa kā wa tsi dza dzaḥ ma ra du chings ya rbad thun dgra bo dza dzaḥ de nas bsgral thun sbrags pa ni: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur:

ha la du na trag rak+sha tri hur thum kha la ru tra rū pa mā ra ya rmyog thum rbad rbad: srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa 'gas 'gas: mā ra ya khug bam ril shag dgra bo'i lus ngag ma ra du na shig shig: ces thun brdeg cing bsgral bar bya: de nas sreg pa la sham bur kha bsgyur sngags ni: ya ma du ru tra ru tra ri ha na la shag tshal pa dgra bo'i lus ngag yid la ram̐ ram̐: ru tra kha la dun bhan+dha mā ra ya kā wa tsi dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ shig shig tshal pa dun bh+yo bh+yoḥ de nas mnan pa kha bsgyur sham bu ni: ya ma dam sri mā ra ya: satwaṃ bha ya nan: ru tra mā ra ya dgra sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: chaig trig kha dun rbad bh+yo kā wa tsi nan nan: zhes mnan pas nam yang mi ldang myur du sgrol bar nges so: sa ma ya: de nas tha tshig bsgrag cing gtor ma 'bul ba ni: thun gtor bshams nas: hūm̐: ston pa shākya thub pa dang : bar du rig 'dzin thod phreng dang : che mchog khrag 'thung chen po yis: ci ltar bka' bsgos gnyer gtad pa'i: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma rnams: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi tha tshig dran mdzod cig: nyes pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang : bla tshe rnam shes rten dang phrol: nam gyi phar phyed tshur phyed la: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: bla rkun jag pa'i dus la bab: las mkhan pho nya'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo dam ma g.yel: bcol ba'i phrin las ma byas na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin gyi dam yang nyams: na raka rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung : de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: dmigs pa'i dgra bo khug la shog: nyes can dam nyams shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ dharma pā la ya dza ha la ru tra'i snying tsa chod ya rbad ya bh+yoḥ

zhes rgyun gtor ltar na khā his 'bul: dgra chos yin na gzhung bzhin bya: zor ni zur du gsal ltar 'phang : dmigs pa rgyas bsdus blo yis dpag: sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi zur du gsal: spros med dbang bzhi blangs kyang chog: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: dregs pa spu gri dmar po'i skor: gter srung dgra la rbad pa'i thabs: gcig dril sgrub pa zab khyad can: rtags thon myur mgyogs sa ma ya: bka' brgyad sgrub gzhung med pa la: 'di nyid spel du mi rung phyir: gsang rgyas myur du sba bar gyis: dam nyams bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos pad+ma sbas pa'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bsgyur bas/ theg chen a ti yo gi'i bstan pa 'grib pa med cing*/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don gnyis 'grub par bya ba'i slad/ phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas yun du brtan pa'i dge legs 'phel bar stsol/ bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog/ // sarba maṅga laṃ// // zha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gshin po rjes 'dzin mkha' spyod myur lam bzhugs so: kun bzang zhi ba dbyings kyi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mtha' yas sems can lam sgrol phyir: mkha' spyod myur lam sa mkhan bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gshin po'am ni tshe ldan gyi: sgrib sbyang byang bu sbyar ba'i thabs: dkyil 'khor gzhung bsrang sngags la bskyal: de nas bum pa me long dang : khrus dar byang bu pho mo'i gzugs: zhal zas drug dang bgegs gtor drug: tsa ka li sogs rdzas rnams bsags: byang bu gdan dang gos g.yogs la: dkyil 'khor mdun du bzhag byas te: dang po bum chus bsang sbyang ni: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ

hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya: hoḥ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po yab yum mtshan sum cu dang : dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa: gzi brjid kyi 'od dang ldan par bsgom: mdun du skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa pad+ma'i gdan la: chaiga'i phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ dza nṛ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje dang rin chen pad+ma las kyi snying po dang : sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pas chaiga'i rnam par shes pa srid gsum rigs drug gar gnas kyang skad cig gis 'dir mchis par gyur cig: nṛ sa ma ya: dza dzaḥ zhes mngon sum du gsal: shar du gti mug rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa seṅge rab brtan gyis byol song gi sgrib pa sbyong ba: lhor nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo shākya thub pas mi'i sgrib pa sbyong ba: nub tu 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa kha 'bar gyis yi dwags kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba: byang du phrag dog rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa thag bzang ris lha min gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba: 'og tu zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa chos kyi rgyal pos dmyal ba'i duḥkha sbyong ba: steng du pham ltung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa brgya byin gyis lha'i duḥkha sbyong ba: de'i steng mkha' spyod kyi gnas su rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhing khams lha dang bcas pa gsal: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba rigs lnga dang thub pa rigs drug gi lha tshogs spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: de nas tshe 'das sam tshe ldan gang rung la mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs byed pa la gtor ma bsngo ba ni:
