bgegs gtor dang mar me changs bu sogs chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : dmyal ba'i lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ de nas bum pa thogs la: dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni me long ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: zhe sdang sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i zhe sdang gi sgrib pa thams cad mo ha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus bya: de nas zhal zas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa chos rgyal la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das zhe sdang sgrib sbyangs nas: bzod pa'i go cha rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi kan+ti ye swā hā: de nas zhing khams ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni bla ma rdo rje sems: zhing 'di shar phyogs mngon par dga': phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad dmyal ba'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song dmyal ba'i skye sgo chod: om̐ ya ma ya du tshin+dha swā hā: bgegs gtor bran la: hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : yi dwags lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni bla med ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol:

om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga t sogs nas āḥhūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i ser sna'i sgrib pa thams cad pre ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: khrus bya: zhal zas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa kha 'bar la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das 'dod chags sgrib sbyangs nas: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi sa ma dhi ye swā hā: ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: nga ni bla ma rnam snang mdzad: zhing 'di bsod nams phun tshogs can: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad yi dwags yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song yi dwags skye sgo chod: om̐ sa ma ya pre ta tshin+dha ye swā hā: bgegs gtor bran la: hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : byol song lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni chos dbyings ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: byol song sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: om̐ sarba ta thā? sogs nas āḥhūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i gti mug gi sgrib pa thams cad ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhal zas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa seṅge la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das gti mug sgrib sbyangs nas: shes rab gsal ba'i rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi pra dzñā ye swā hā: ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni bla ma rdo rje 'chang : zhing 'di dbus phyogs stug po bkod: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig:

om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ skye sgo gcod pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad dud 'gro'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song dud 'gro'i skye sgo chod: om̐ sa ma ya tri tshin+dha ye swā hā: de nas gtor ma bran la: hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : mi yi lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni sor rtogs ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol lo: 'dod chags sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: om̐ sarba ta thā? sogs nas āḥhūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i 'dod chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad rā ga duḥbi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhal zas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa shākya la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das 'dod chags sgrib sbyangs nas: tshul khrims rnam dag rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi shrī la ye swā hā: ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni bla ma snang mtha' yas: zhing 'di nub phyogs bde ba can: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad skye 'chi'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song skye 'chi'i sgo mo chod: sa ma ya nri tshin+dha ye swā hā: bgegs gtor bran la: hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : lha min bag chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang :

bcud ni bya grub ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: 'thab rtsod sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: om̐ sarba ta thā? sogs nas āḥhūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i phrag dog gi sgrib pa thams cad tir+ya ka bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhal zas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa thag bzang la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das 'thab rtsod sgrib sbyangs nas: brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra wirtā ye swā hā: ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni bla ma don yod grub: zhing 'di byang phyogs las rab rdzogs: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad lha min yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song lha min skye sgo chod: om̐ sa ma ya su tshin+dha ye swā hā: bgegs gtor bran la: hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : lha yi lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni gsal stong ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol lo: ma rig dri ma sbyang du gsol: om̐ sarba ta thā? sogs nas āḥhūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad hā la pañtsa bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhal zas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa brgya byin la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das nyon mongs sgrib sbyangs nas: ye shes lnga yi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra dzñā na pañtsa ye swā hā: ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni bla ma kun tu bzang : zhing 'di 'og min mkha' spyod gnas:

phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad 'khor ba'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song 'khor ba'i skye sgo chad: om̐ sa ma ya a tshin+dha ye swā hā: de nas brda'i sgo phye ba ni: hūm̐: 'di ni kun bzang pho brang ste: bla med dkyil 'khor zhal mjal phyir: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sgo bcad nas: rig pa ye shes 'char sgo phyes: om̐ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas lha zhal mjal ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'khor bar 'khyams pa po: da ni mkha' spyod bzung ba'i phyir: zhi ba dbyings kyi lha la ltos: lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 'bul: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza hoḥ de nas ting 'dzin gyi zas gos gtad pa ni: gsur bsngo zhing : hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rgyu 'bras 'od gsal me long ltos: kun brtags phung po stong pa nyid: rig pa 'chi med ngo bor ltos: om̐ badz+ra rū pa āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: grags stong rang sgra'i tshig la nyon: sna tshogs ma 'gags stong pa nyid: brag cha'i tshul gyis ngo bor ltos: om̐ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: tshor stong dbang pos byad la spyod: 'dzin rtog sna tshogs stong pa'i dbyings: zang thal rjen pa'i gshis la zhog: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: myong stong bde ba'i zhen pa spongs: chags zhen srid pa rang sar stong : ma bcos gnyug ma'i shes pa skyongs: om̐ rā sa āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: phyi nang sgrib med lus la ltos: kun gzhi 'khor 'das ris med do: 'gag med 'od gsal ngang la zhog: om̐ badz+ra spar+she āḥhūm̐: de nas rnam shes mi dmigs par rgyal ba'i thugs su bsre ba ni: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu:

rnam shes rlung gi rta pho la: rig pa gsal ba'i mi phos zungs: dbu ma chos nyid lam la gshegs: klong yangs 'og min zhing khams su: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang : gsang ba dbyings phyug zung 'jug 'khril: yab yum de yi sras nyid du: rlung gi shugs la sems kyi rtsal: rig pa zer gyi gong bu ru: zang thal skar mda' chad pa ltar: phaṭ sgra drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis: ldog med kun bzang thugs la thim: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ ces sgra drag pos rnam shes 'og min zhing du 'phang : de nas byang bu sbar ba'i me hom du: hūm̐: chos dbyings khyab brdal hom yangs su: rang byung ye shes me dpung sbar: phra rags nyon mongs bud shing bsreg: shes bya phung po'i bud shing la: gcig chod lta ba'i me sbar ro: tshogs brgyad rnam shes bud shing la: byang sems brgyad kyi me sbar ro: skye mched bcu gnyis bud shing la: rnam thar bcu gnyis me sbar ro: 'du ba bcu drug bud shing la: stong nyid bcu drug me sbar ro: 'dus byas ma rig bud shing la: rig pa ye shes me sbar ro: dug lnga bag chags bud shing la: 'dzin med chos dbyings me sbar ro: hūm̐ ram̐ ha la pañtsa pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib dang bag chags ngan pa rnams byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ sarba ā wa ra ṇa pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā:

zhes yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing byang thal chur gshegs sam sāts+tsha gdab: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang : khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: grub thob rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga: yongs grags rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyis thugs brtse bas ye shes kyi dbyings nas dgongs su gsol: de dag gi nus mthu la brten nas gong ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang mnyam par gyur cig: da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams su la'ang phan thogs pa thams cad sku tshe ring zhing sku khams bzang ba dang : mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur cig: khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi thugs kyis g.yel ba med pa'i grogs mdzad par gyur cig: 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang : lo 'bras rtag tu rgyas shing dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi nas mtshon gyi bskal pa ngan pa nyams par gyur cig: yul gyi mi nad phyugs nad 'go ba'i nad gdon dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig: rgyu sbyor ba po sbyin pa'i bdag po de rnams kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan nas: rten 'brel dge ba'i legs tshogs thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol du 'phos shing : chaiga' ི 'das pa 'das ma de nyid kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing : lam sgrib gnyis byang : 'bras bu rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig:

dkon mchog gsum la bkur sti dang rim gro bgyis te: zang zing gi chos bcu mi zad ting 'dzin bsgoms pa la sogs pa drang don nges don gyi chos thams cad: smon lam brda ma log par rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug par gyur cig: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du dran pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs rgya chen po thob nas: nam yang mi 'khrul zhing rang dbang thob nas gzhan don du phan thogs pa'i skye ba len nus par gyur cig: rig mtho zhing cho 'brang dang ldan pa'i skye ba len zhing chos dang 'phrad nas: thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs shing spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mngon du gyur nas: mtha' yas 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor nus par gyur cig: tshe 'phrang bdud las sgrol nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub ste: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi zhal mngon sum du mjal ba dang : lung bstan te rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su sangs rgyas par gyur cig: de nas smon lam ni: na mo: kun bzang chos dbyings ye shes ngang nyid las: bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rkyen gyis mi g.yeng bar: shes rab dran pa'i lcags kyus rtsal phyung nas: nam yang mi g.yo rdo rje'i sa thob shog: ces bsngo ba dang smon lam rgyas pa bya zhing bkra shis sogs dkyil 'khor rgyud ltar bsdus: phyi nang rten 'brel don dang ldan par gyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs ma 'ongs sems can don: na raka dong sprugs gdams pa bzhag: thos grol gnad ci gzer bu nyid: 'di yi gdams ngag thebs gyur na: skad cig sangs rgyas the tshom med: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal rong nas khrom gter du gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bshus so//

// za) zhi khro na raka dong sprugs las/ gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga bklag chog tu bkod pa 'brel tshad rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rang rig bla ma kun bzang la/ /btud de gshin don cho ga'i khrigs/ /'brel tshad sdug bsngal rang grol thabs/ /dam pa'i lugs bzhin 'dir gsal bya/ de'ang rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ thog mar dkyil 'khor bdag mdun bsham bkod gzhung bzhin dang*/ dbang bzhi nyer spyod sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ khyad par du gnas 'dren ni/ de'ang gzhung las/ gshin po'am ni tshe ldan gyi: sgrib sbyang byang bu sbyar ba'i thabs: dkyil 'khor gzhung bsrang sngags la bskyal: de nas bum pa me long dang : khrus dar byang bu pho mo'i gzugs: zhal zas drug dang bgegs gtor drug: tsa ka li sogs rdzas rnams bsags: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gzhi dkar steng*/ thub drug gi sku tsaka bshams pa'i mdun/ rigs drug gi dal dgram/ de'ang dmyal ba yi dwags mgo mthur dud 'gro 'phred/ mi lha min lha gsum mgo gyen du bkod pa'i mthar/ pad+ma'i gdan la ming byang tshad ldan bris pa bzhag /gzhan du thub drug la 'bul rgyu'i zhal zas drug dang*/ lan chags sbyong ched gtor chung changs bu mar me cha drug /ming byang gi g.yas g.yon du bza' btung sogs gang dgos tshags su tshud par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i gsol 'debs nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar zhi khro'i gzhung bsrang la las sbyor gyi skabs bye yungs la sngags/ rnam bum dang khrus bum zur gsal ltar bsgrub cing rig pa'i me tog dor/ de nas gsol kha dang skong bshags tshogs mchod drangs pa'i bar song nas/ thog mar dkon mchog la ra mda' sbran pa ni/ thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar zhing*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa': thugs rje dang ldan pa:

mkhyen pa dang ldan pa: brtse ba dang ldan pa rnams thugs rje'i dbang gi gnas 'dir byon cig: dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod pa bzhes shig: thugs rje can khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes: brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas: thugs rje can khyed rnams kyis tshe las 'das pa cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo zhes bya ba 'di ni 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du ni 'gro: 'jig rten 'di ni bor: skyas chen po ni 'degs: grogs ni med: sdug bsngal ni che: skyabs ni med: mgon ni med: dpung gnyen ni med: tshe 'di'i snang ba ni nub: mun nag 'thug por ni 'jug: g.yang sa chen por ni ltung : las kyi dbang gi ni ded: sa tshugs med par ni 'gro: dbang ni med: gcig pur 'gro dgos pa'i dus la bab na: thugs rje can khyed rnams kyis tshe las 'das pa cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo skyabs med pa la skyabs mdzod cig: mgon med pa la mgon mdzod cig: dpung gnyen med pa la dpung gnyen mdzod cig: bar do'i mun nag chen po las skyobs shig: las kyi rlung dmar chen po las zlog cig: gshin rje'i 'jigs skrag chen po las skyobs shig: bar do'i 'phrang ring chen po las sgrol cig: thugs rje can khyed rnams thugs rje ma chung zhig: sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar thugs rje'i shugs myur du phyungs shig: sems can las ngan pa'i dbang du ma gtong zhig: dkon mchog gsum gyi bar do'i sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol: ces ra mda' sbran zhing*/ /de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ bum chus bsang sbyang*/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas/ hoḥ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po yab yum mtshan sum cu dang :

dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa: gzi brjid kyi 'od dang ldan par bsgom: mdun du skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa pad+ma'i gdan la: chaiga'i phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ dza nṛ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de nas rnam shes dgug pa ni/ na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje dang rin chen pad+ma las kyi snying po dang : sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la rten nas tshes las 'das pa chaiga'i rnam par shes pa srid gsum rigs drug gar gnas kyang skad cig gis 'dir mchis par gyur cig: nṛ sa ma ya: dza dzaḥ zhes mngon sum du gsal la rten bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: zhing khams 'di nyid rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas zhing : phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis gus pas gsol ba thob: hoḥ 'jig rten pha rol song ba'i bu khyod nyon: mtshan byang 'di ni lus kyi bla rten yin: snyug ma tshigs drug srog gi bla rten yin: gdugs dang cod pan gos kyi bla rten yin: me long 'di ni sems kyi bla rten yin: mar me 'di ni mthong ba'i bla rten yin: rin chen 'di ni rgyan gyi bla rten yin: dar thag 'di ni lam gyi bla rten yin: pad+ma 'di ni sdod pa'i bla rten yin: mtshan byang 'di la rnam shes rten chos shig /tshe las 'das pa cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya lhan/ de nas gshed dang phral ba ni/ glud gtor bshams la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje dang rin chen pad+ma las kyi snying po dang : sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus 'jig rten 'di nas tshe dus las 'das pa chaig mo la gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod pa: gshin gyi dus su sgrib pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod cing : gnyen 'brel gyi chas su zhugs nas ngan song du 'khrid pa'i gshed ma byed pa: gnas skabs su gson po nye 'brel rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad lan chags gtor ma len pa'i ched du 'dir mchis par gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis dgug la/ byang bu la lan gsum g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing*/ sarba bhigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo?khaṃ ghṛ h+na daṃ ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: gson la bdud dang gshin la lcags: mtho ris bde 'gro'i bgegs byed rnams: gtor chu changs bu mar me dang : 'dod yon glud gtor 'di khyer la: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste 'tshe zhing sdang ba dang : tshe 'das thar pa'i bgegs byed na: rab tu gzhom par gdon mi za: hūm̐: ye shes 'bar ba me yi tshwa tshwa g.yo: sdang mig nyi zla ltar bgrad glog ltar 'khyugs: 'debs pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje'i mtshon char gdengs: de bas so so rang rang gnas su dengs: nyon mongs bdud dang 'byung po rab tu gzhom: om̐ badz+ra kro ta he kā la kro ti li hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya phaṭḥ zhes rol mo'i 'tsham rngam dang bcas te thun gyis brab gu gul bdug cing phyir bskrad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas me dpung rab tu 'bar bas mtshon cha lnga'i gur du gyur te gshed dang bgegs kyis bskal bar mi mthong bar gyur/

om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nas rten la khrus gsol ba ni rten la me long bstan te/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'aud chags bla res bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye a hūm̐/ hūm̐: ye shes sku lnga lhun grub bum pa ru: rnam dag dam tshig chu bo drug gis bkang : deng 'dir rgyal ba'i sku la khrus 'bul na: tshe 'das sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyangs nas ni: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu yongs su smin gyur cig: om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ā bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: sku phyi ba ni/ hūm̐: gtsang zhing dge ba'i rlung g.yab las byung bas: ma dag 'khrul ba dag par byi dor zhing : ku shas sa bon bgyid la sman spos byug: dri med pañtsa li kas sku phyi'o: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥsarba bi shud+dhe bi sho dha ya swā hā: de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag dag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ de nas rten khrus kyi chu slar bum par blugs la ming byang bkru ba ni/ hūm̐: 'di ni pha rol phyin drug chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: rnam shes tshogs drug gnas dag nas: rigs drug skye ba'i sgo chod cig: oṃ dā na shrī la kan+ti nid+ya sa ma dhi pra dzñā ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa rigs drug gi sdug bsngal las grol te pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig:

om̐ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ye kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa'i dug lnga ser sna dang nyon drug gnas su dag nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug rim gyis rdzogs te bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che myur du thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /dug dbyung ba ni/ sgro mdangs g.yab la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ /dkon mchog gsum por dug mi mnga'/ /mchog gsum bden pas dug bcom mo/ / rtsa sngags mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i dug gsum rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ 'byung bzhi thogs la/ 'byung bzhi dug gi pha yin te/ /'byung bzhi dug gi ma yang yin/ /yum chen bzhi yi byin rlabs kyis/ /tshe 'das khyod la dug med shog / rtsa sngags mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i 'byung dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i dug thams cad rigs kyi yum bzhi'i bden pas shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ 'byung bzhi khrus chab dang bcas phyir dor/

tshe las 'das pas gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig / ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de nas rigs drug gi gnas nas 'dren par byed pa la drug las/ dang po dmyal ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa la/ lan chags sbyong ba dang*/ dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba/ tshogs bsag pa/ zhing khams ngo sprod pa/ rigs drug gi skye sgo gcod pa dang lnga/ thog mar 'dren pa rigs drug sogs skyabs yul rnams gsal zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rigs drug gi dal rnams rigs drug gi gnas dang dbyer med pa dang*/ de dag gi gtso bo thub pa drug dang dkyil 'khor gyi thub pa drug tha dad med par gsal ba la/ shar du gti mug rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa seṅge rab brtan gyis byol song gi sgrib pa sbyong ba: lhor nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo shākya thub pas mi'i sgrib pa sbyong ba: nub tu 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa kha 'bar gyis yi dwags kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba: byang du phrag dog rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa thag bzang ris lha min gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba: 'og tu zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa chos kyi rgyal pos dmyal ba'i duḥkha sbyong ba: steng du pham ltung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo thub pa brgya byin gyis lha'i duḥkha sbyong ba: de'i steng mkha' spyod kyi gnas su rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhing khams lha dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba rigs lnga dang thub pa rigs drug gi lha tshogs spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐:

de nas rigs drug dal la las bum chus bran tshul dang*/ ming byang dmyal ba'i dal du bzhag la/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can la: zhe sdang drag po'i las dbang gis: na raka dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes: btso sreg sdug bsngal bsam las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag grol mdzod: brtse ba chen po'i bzung du gsol: mtshams med byas pa'i sdig can ngan song du mi bgrod pa'i thabs med kyang lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi mthus rmi lam ltar skad cig gcig la ngan song las thar ba rgyal po ma skyes dgra lta bu'o/ /de nas lan chags sbyang ba ni/ bgegs gtor dang mar me changs bu chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: namaḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : dmyal ba'i lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ glud de byang bu la g.yon du bskor zhing phyir dor/ las bum thogs shing me long gi ngos khrus byas la/ hūm̐: 'di ni me long ye shes chu: zhe sdang dri ma sbyang slad du: snang stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: nyon sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: yig brgya dang bo dhi brjod/ tshe las 'das pa'i zhe sdang gi sgrib pa thams cad mo ha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes bkru zhing bye mas brab/ de nas zhing khams ngo sprod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni bla ma rdo rje sems: zhing 'di shar phyogs mngon par dga': phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas rnam bum thogs la/ dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni me long ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: zhe sdang sgrib pa sbyang du gsol:

oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma y yig brgya dang*/ om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus bya/ de nas thub par gtang rag gi zhal zas mchod g.yog gis bkyags la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa chos rgyal la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das zhe sdang sgrib sbyangs nas: bzod pa'i go cha rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi kan+ti ye swā hā: thub pa'i mdun 'bul/ de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad dmyal ba'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song dmyal ba'i skye sgo chod: om̐ ya ma ya du tshin+dha swā hā: dmyal ba'i dal bsdus te phyir dor tshul dang bar du rdo rjes bcad tshul bya/ byang bu yi dwags kyi dal du spos la/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can la: ser sna drag po'i las dbang gis: pre ta yi dwags gnas su skyes: bkres skom sdug bsngal bsam las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag grol mdzod: brtse ba chen po'i bzung du gsol: bgegs gtor bran la/ hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : yi dwags lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ glud phyir dor/ hūm̐: 'di ni sor rtogs ye shes chu: 'dod chags sgrib pa sbyang slad du: grags stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: bag chags sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: yig brgya dang bo dhi brjod/ tshe las 'das pa'i ser sna'i sgrib pa thams cad pre ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes bkru zhing bye mas brab/ de nas zhing khams ngo sprod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni bla ma rnam snang mdzad: zhing 'di bsod nams phun tshogs can: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ

de nas rnam bum thogs la/ dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni bla med ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: yig brgya dang*/ om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga t sogs nas āḥhūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus bya/ de nas thub par gtang rag gi zhal zas mchod g.yog gis bkyags la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa kha 'bar la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das 'dod chags sgrib sbyangs nas: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi sa ma dhi ye swā hā: de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad yi dwags yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song yi dwags skye sgo chod: om̐ sa ma ya pre ta tshin+dha ye swā hā: yi dwags kyi dal bsdus te phyir dor tshul dang bar du rdo rjes bcad tshul bya/ byang bu dud 'gro'i dal du spos la/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can la: gti mug drag po'i las dbang gis: tir+ya dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes: bkol spyod glen lkug brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag grol mdzod: brtse ba chen po'i bzung du gsol: bgegs gtor bran la/ hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : byol song lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ glud phyir dor/ hūm̐: 'di ni chos dbyings ye shes chu: gti mug sgrib pa sbyang slad du: gsal stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: las sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: yig brgya dang bo dhi brjod/ tshe las 'das pa'i gti mug gi sgrib pa thams cad ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes bkru zhing bye mas brab/ de nas zhing khams ngo sprod pa ni/

hūm̐: nga ni bla ma rdo rje 'chang : zhing 'di dbus phyogs stug po bkod: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas rnam bum thogs la/ dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni chos dbyings ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: byol song sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: yig brgya dang*/ om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga t sogs nas āḥhūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus bya/ de nas thub par gtang rag gi zhal zas mchod g.yog gis bkyags la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa seṅge la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das gti mug sgrib sbyangs nas: shes rab gsal ba'i rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi pra dzñā ye swā hā: de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad dud 'gro'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song dud 'gro'i skye sgo chod: om̐ sa ma ya tri tshin+dha ye swā hā: dud 'gro'i dal bsdus te phyir dor tshul dang bar du rdo rjes bcad tshul sogs bya/ byang bu lha min gyi dal du spos la/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can la: phrag dog drag po'i las dbang gis: gdug rtsub lha min gnas su skyes: 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag grol mdzod: brtse ba chen po'i bzung du gsol: bgegs gtor bran la/ hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : lha min bag chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ glud phyir dor/ hūm̐: 'di ni bya grub ye shes chu: phrag dog sgrib pa sbyang slad du: tshor stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: rtog sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o:

yig brgya dang bo dhi brjod/ tshe las 'das pa'i phrag dog gi sgrib pa thams cad tir+ya ka bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes bkru zhing bye mas brab/ de nas zhing khams ngo sprod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni bla ma don yod grub: zhing 'di byang phyogs las rab rdzogs: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas rnam bum thogs la/ dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni bya grub ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: 'thab rtsod sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: yig brgya dang*/ om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga t sogs nas āḥhūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus bya/ de nas thub par gtang rag gi zhal zas mchod g.yog gis bkyags la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa thag bzang la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das 'thab rtsod sgrib sbyangs nas: brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra wirtā ye swā hā: de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad lha min yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song lha min skye sgo chod: om̐ sa ma ya su tshin+dha ye swā hā: lha min gyi dal bsdus te phyir dor tshul dang bar du rdo rjes bcad tshul sogs bya/ byang bu lha'i dal du spos la/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can la: nga rgyal drag po'i las dbang gis: 'dod khams lha yi gnas su skyes: ltung ba'i sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag grol mdzod: brtse ba chen po'i bzung du gsol: bgegs gtor bran la/ hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang : lha yi lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ

glud phyir dor/ hūm̐: 'di ni mnyam nyid ye shes chu: nga rgyal sgrib pa sbyang slad du: bde stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: rmongs sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: yig brgya dang bo dhi brjod/ tshe las 'das pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad hā la pañtsa bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes bkru zhing bye mas brab/ de nas zhing khams ngo sprod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni bla ma kun tu bzang : zhing 'di 'og min mkha' spyod gnas: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas rnam bum thogs la/ dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni gsal stong ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol lo: ma rig dri ma sbyang du gsol: yig brgya dang*/ om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga t sogs nas āḥhūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus bya/ de nas thub par gtang rag gi zhal zas mchod g.yog gis bkyags la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa brgya byin la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das nyon mongs sgrib sbyangs nas: ye shes lnga yi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra dzñā na pañtsa ye swā hā: de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad 'khor ba'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song 'khor ba'i skye sgo chad: om̐ sa ma ya a tshin+dha ye swā hā: lha'i dal bsdus te phyir dor tshul dang bar du rdo rjes bcad tshul sogs bya/ byang bu mi'i dal du spos la/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can la: nyon mongs 'dod pa'i las dbang gis: 'dod khams mi yi gnas su skyes: brel phongs sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag grol mdzod: brtse ba chen po'i bzung du gsol: bgegs gtor bran la/ hūm̐: byang chub thar lam sgrub pa la: gnod pa'i gson bdud gshin lcags dang :

mi yi lan chags sbyang slad du: gtor chung changs bu mar me bsngo: tshims par gyis la phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ glud phyir dor/ hūm̐: 'di ni mtha' grol ye shes chu: 'dod chags sgrib pa sbyang slad du: rig stong dri yis legs bsgos chus: shes sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bgyi'o: yig brgya dang bo dhi brjod/ tshe las 'das pa'i 'dod chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad rā ga duḥbi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes bkru zhing bye mas brab/ de nas zhing khams ngo sprod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni bla ma snang mtha' yas: zhing 'di nub phyogs bde ba can: phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol 'dun pa bskyed: dkyil 'khor pho brang 'di zungs shig: om̐ na mo hūm̐ tsakra pū ru sha ya dzaḥ de nas rnam bum thogs la/ dbang bskur zhing khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni sor rtogs ye shes ngang : tshe 'das dbang bskur khrus gsol lo: 'dod chags sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: yig brgya dang*/ om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga t

sogs nas āḥhūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus bya/ de nas thub par gtang rag gi zhal zas mchod g.yog gis bkyags la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa shākya la: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas 'bul: tshe 'das 'dod chags sgrib sbyangs nas: tshul khrims rnam dag rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra ṇi shrī la ye swā hā: de nas skye sgo gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'di'i man chad skye 'chi'i yul: ma chags ma zhen yar la 'phos: ngan song skye 'chi'i sgo mo chod: sa ma ya nri tshin+dha ye swā hā: mi'i dal bsdus te phyir dor tshul dang byang bu dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bzhag tshul byas nas slob dpon gyi mdun du dbang stegs la bzhag /sa gzhi spos chus sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal phul la/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wā ra ma ṇa ye swā hā sa mig dar dgab/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog 'thor/ skyabs sems sdom bzung ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung*/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ tshe 'das nyid dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/

/zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos 'gags med klong yangs nas: sna tshogs dbang po'i lam la shar ba yi: bde chen rgyal po lhan skyes 'dus ma byas: stong gsal 'dzin med nam mkha'i 'khor lo can: mi rtog ye shes kun bzang zhi khro'i lha: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gcig 'dus phyir: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: phyag byar 'os? dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t skad cig gis tshe las 'das pa nyid dpal kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dag pa chos sku'i klong nas sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi/ sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas bde ba'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra a be sha ya a āḥ btags pa brjod la rol mo sgrog tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ de nas mig dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: 'di ni kun bzang pho brang ste: bla med dkyil 'khor zhal mjal phyir: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sgo bcad nas: rig pa ye shes 'char sgo phyes: om̐ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ mig dar bsal/ de nas me tog 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'khor bar 'khyams pa po: da ni mkha' spyod bzung ba'i phyir: zhi ba dbyings kyi lha la ltos: lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 'bul: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza hoḥ de nas rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal med khang du/ bcud kun bzang zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'dus pa'i ngo bo bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med bum pa ru:

bla med dam tshig bdud rtsis bkang : skal ldan spyi bor bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des sku'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: lhun grub rang byung bhan+dha ru: sku lnga ye shes rdzas kyis bkang : skal ldan mgrin par bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me long thogs la/ hūm̐: ka dag ye shes snying po'i mdangs: rol rtsal shar ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid: skal ldan snying khar bzhag pa yis: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: bud+dha tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtso gtor thogs la/ hūm̐: rmad byung bla med dam tshig rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: rat+na ghu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang ma lus pa thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga gnas su dag /ye shes lnga mngon du gyur/ 'bras bu sku lnga thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sa gzhi spos chu? gtso bo'i ji ltar? de nas ting 'dzin gyi zas gos gtad pa ni/ tshe las 'das pa skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur/ 'dod yon gyi dngos po rnams/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod yon gyi dngos po zad mi shes pa nam mkha' gang bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri ro reg /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul/ /zag med dga' bdes rtag tu tshim par shog om̐ gu ru bud+dha dzñā na badz+ra sa twa pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rgyu 'bras 'od gsal me long ltos: kun brtags phung po stong pa nyid: rig pa 'chi med ngo bor ltos: om̐ badz+ra rū pa āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: grags stong rang sgra'i tshig la nyon: sna tshogs ma 'gags stong pa nyid: brag cha'i tshul gyis ngo bor ltos: om̐ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: tshor stong dbang pos byad la spyod: 'dzin rtog sna tshogs stong pa'i dbyings: zang thal rjen pa'i gshis la zhog: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: myong stong bde ba'i zhen pa spongs: chags zhen srid pa rang sar stong : ma bcos gnyug ma'i shes pa skyongs: om̐ rā sa āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: phyi nang sgrib med lus la ltos: kun gzhi 'khor 'das ris med do: 'gag med 'od gsal ngang la zhog: om̐ badz+ra spar+she āḥhūm̐: de nas rnam shes mi dmigs pa rgyal ba'i thugs su bsre ba ni: hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rnam shes rlung gi rta pho la: rig pa gsal ba'i mi phos zungs: dbu ma chos nyid lam la gshegs: klong yangs 'og min zhing khams su: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang : gsang ba dbyings phyug zung 'jug 'khril: yab yum de yi sras nyid du: rlung gi shugs la sems kyi rtsal: rig pa zer gyi gong bu ru: zang thal skar mda' chad pa ltar:

phaṭ sgra drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis: ldog med kun bzang thugs kar thim: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ ces sgra drag pos rnam shes 'og min gyi zhing du 'phang*/ de nas byang bu sbar ba'i me hom du/ hūm̐: chos dbyings khyab brdal hom yangs su: rang byung ye shes me dpung sbar: phra rags nyon mongs bud shing bsreg: shes bya'i phung po'i bud shing la: gcig chod lta ba'i me sbar ro: tshogs brgyad rnam shes bud shing la: byang sems brgyad kyi me sbar ro: skye mched bcu gnyis bud shing la: rnam thar bcu gnyis me sbar ro: 'du ba bcu drug bud shing la: stong nyid bcu drug me sbar ro: 'dus byas ma rig bud shing la: rig pa ye shes me sbar ro: dug lnga bag chags bud shing la: 'dzin med chos dbyings me sbar ro: hūm̐ ram̐ ha la pañtsa pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib dang bag chags ngan pa rnams byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ sarba ā wa ra ṇa pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing byang thal chur gshegs sam sāts+tsha gdab/ de nas bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang : khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: grub thob rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga: yongs grags rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyis thugs brtse bas ye shes kyi dbyings nas dgongs su gsol: de dag gi nus mthu la brten nas gong ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang mnyam par gyur cig: da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams su la'ang phan thogs pa thams cad sku tshe ring zhing sku khams bzang ba dang : mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur cig: khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi thugs kyis g.yel ba med pa'i grogs mdzad par gyur cig:

'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang : lo 'bras rtag tu rgyas shing dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi nas mtshon gyi bskal pa ngan pa nyams par gyur cig: yul gyi mi nad phyugs nad 'go ba'i nad gdon dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig: rgyu sbyor ba po sbyin pa'i bdag po de rnams kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan nas: rten 'brel dge ba'i legs tshogs thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol du 'phos shing : chaiga' ི 'das pa 'das ma de nyid kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing : lam sgrib gnyis byang : 'bras bu rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig: dkon mchog gsum la bkur sti dang rim gro bgyis te: zang zing gi chos bcu mi zad ting 'dzin bsgoms pa la sogs pa drang don nges don gyi chos thams cad: smon lam brda ma log pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug par gyur cig: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du dran pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs rgya chen po thob nas: nam yang mi 'khrul zhing rang dbang thob nas gzhan don du phan thogs pa'i skye ba len nus par gyur cig: rigs mtho zhing cho 'brang dang ldan pa'i skye ba len zhing chos dang 'phrad nas: thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs shing spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mngon du gyur nas: mtha' yas 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor nus par gyur cig: tshe 'phrang bdud las sgrol nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub ste: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi zhal mngon sum du mjal ba dang :

lung bstan te rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su sangs rgyas par gyur cig: de nas smon lam ni: na mo: kun bzang chos dbyings ye shes ngang nyid las: bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rkyen gyis mi g.yeng bar: shes rab dran pa'i lcags kyus rtsal phyung nas: nam yang mi g.yo rdo rje'i sa thob shog: ces bsngo ba smon lam rgyas pa bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma 'bul ba sogs gzhung ltar mtha' dbyung bar bya'o/ /de ltar zhi khro na raka dong sprugs las gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga bklag chog tu bkod pa 'brel tshad rang grol zhes bya ba 'di ni rtsa ba gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang sor bzhag la/ phyag bzhes khungs thub cing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba gter chen karma gling pa'i/ zhi khro'i gnas 'dren mkhas mchog chags med zhabs kyis bzhed srol dang mthun par go rim gsar du bsgrigs shing kha 'geng dgos pa'ang rang gzhung dang rigs mthun gzhan las blangs te/ gab dkrug med par chu 'babs kyi tshul du bklag chog par bkod pa 'di'ang zab gter 'di nyid kyi bstan zhabs su skyes shing*/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam mgon chos kyi blo gros nas rgyal ba'i sprul sku'i mtshan gyi cod pan bstsal yang*/ don gyi char lugs gnyis kyi bya gzhag bzang po'i yon tan gyi dri mas ma gos shing*/ nyes skyon gyi gong bur gyur pa phyogs nyul gyi khyung sprang o rgyan gsang sngags bstan 'dzin zhes 'bod pas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa me pho khyi'i lor nya'i khyim du nyi ma'i lha ldan mgron du khug pa'i yar gyi ngo*/ dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa/ res gza' bcu drug 'od ldan dang rgyu skar gyi bu mo gso ba'i lha mo lhan cig tu rtsed 'jor rol ba'i 'grub sbyor gyi dus bzang por/ gu ru'i sgrub gnas bal yul yang le shod kyi char rang gnas su grub par bgyis pas/ glog klad sor mo'i gar pa o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis bgyis pa/

'dis kyang gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zag med chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa dang*/ lus skyed kyi pha ma gnam lcags bkra shis don 'grub dang*/ pad yag gtsos pa'i bzang ngan 'brel thogs ma lus pa khams gsum srid pa'i rgya las grol te/ kun bzang gdod ma'i dbyings su byang chub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // 'a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhi khro'i las mtha' gshin po'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so: bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: e ma rang byung mtsho skyes pad sdong las 'khrungs shing : skyon bral 'jigs med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: phyogs bcu'i zhing 'dir mtshungs med rigs kyi gtso: sangs rgyas sku dngos bslu med pad 'byung gi: bka' yi gdams pa gsang ba'i bcud phyung nas: kho mo bdag la gnang ba'i go rim 'di: mi brjed rin chen brda ru legs par gzugs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' bskal pa snyigs ma ru: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de yang 'jig rten 'dir snang gi bag chags du mar 'byams klas pa'i ngan goms 'khrul ba'i rang gzugs: rigs drug sdug bsngal gyi chu bo la rtag tu byings pa rnams 'dus byas tshe'i 'du ba 'phros nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams kyi duḥkha'i mya ngan sbyong byed: gshin don sreg chog gi go rim spyi dang bye brag rdzas kyi rnam dbye khyad par bca' gzhi lag len rnams nye bar brtsams pa 'grigs chags su dgod pa ni: thog mar dkyil 'khor lha gzhung gi dal du rab rdul tshon 'bring thang sku tha ma 'bru tshom bcas 'byor ldan gyi skabs dang bstun par bya: de'i dbus su bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings tshang ba: rdo rje'i gzung gis thag pa: dung zhal: me long : rigs lnga'i tsakli bcas: g.yas su kun bzang gi gtor ma: phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i gtor ma: mtshams bzhir phrin las bzhi'i gtor ma: me lha'i gtor ma:

gzhan yang sman gtor rak+ta: phyi rol mchod pa sna lnga: de'i mdun du thub pa rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor: de'i phyi rol rigs drug gi tshom bu: de'i phyi rol rigs drug gi sbyang chas: dkyil 'khor de'i mdun g.yas phyogs su snod gtsang gi nang rigs drug sbyang ba'i byang bu: g.yon du skye sgo gcod pa'i byang bu: rgyab tu dri bzang : chu: khrus bum: mdun du snang gsal lnga: mtshams bzhir bud shing sreg pa'i dpal 'bar dang ku sha drug bsnol thabs kyis mtshon pa: gzhan yang spar kha ho'i phyag rgya snang brgyad bsdus pa'i gtor ma khyung stag 'brug bya rus sbal phag bum pa dar tshon gyi rgyang bu lo gzugs bshos bu 'khor bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba: me dar dkar dmar mthing gsum rlung g.yab gsum: hom gzar blugs spur sbyang tsan dan ba lu rdo rje ge sar bcas dri bzang gis ngar btags pa'i spur khang gi gdan rim pa bzhi: de'i steng dkyil 'khor cha tshang : de'i steng du pad+ma bum pa'i mchod rten rnam pa can de yang byang sems kyi rigs: ma yin na li khri dang bang mdzod med pa'i pad+ma kha bya: byang sems la sgo bzhi thab ni sku gsum don bzhi: phal pa la dug gsum sbyang ba'i sgo zhes so: de yang thog mar zhe sdang nas bzung g.yas skor du me sbar ro: sa ma ya: da ni mchod pa 'grigs chags su dgod pa ste: thog mar phyi mchod nang mchod gtor mchod dang mar khu bcas: yam shing shug pa'am yu sor bcu gnyis pad+ma kha shing ku sha dūrba mar zan rin chen sna lnga 'bru sna lnga dar sna lnga: shing 'bras sna tshogs zas sna tshogs gzhan yang las kyi rim pa gzhung dang bstun pa'i mchod pa bsham: de yang rab bdag mdun bum gsum las dang bzhi: 'bring bdag mdun las gsum: tha ma bdag mdun gnyis te gang tsam 'jug pa'i mchod rdzas dgram: thog mar gzhung gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga tshar gcig btang ngo : rgyas pa ltar bum bskyed yang gzhal yas kha bsgyur:

mdun bskyed me lha'i lto bar gzhal yas kha bsgyur: las bzhi kha bsgyur: de ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang ltar bya ba blo yis dpag: gzhung gi cho ga sogs nas gzhung chu kyang bsgrubs: btags grol gyis 'khor ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang phral bas gshin po'i spyi bor bzhag: sa ma ya: thog mar bkram pa'i rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: he ru ka pa'i chas su zhugs nas: thabs shes kyi hom gzar blugs snod len pa ni: dgang gzar la:

oṃ sarba pā tra swā hā: oṃ thabs kyi rol pa las byung ting 'dzin gyi: dpa' bos rdo rje'i snod mchog g.yas su thogs: oṃ oṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ āḥ shes rab bde stong dga' bzhi snyom 'jug gi: dpa' mo zab lam chos 'byung g.yon du thogs: blugs gzar la: oṃ sarba shu bha kam̐ swā hā: a a a a mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ zung 'jug phyag rgya rdzas rnams hom gzar blugs snod gnyis reg tsam bya zhing : hūm̐: chags med bde stong ye shes rnam rol gyi: skye med sna tshogs rdzas kun byin gyis rlabs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: oṃ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: zhes rdzas rnams thabs shes kyi bsgyur: de nas spur khang la bsang chu 'thor zhing sngags 'dis sbyang : oṃ badz+ra mu ya la ya ya maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐ dzñā hūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis gnyos: de nas phyogs gtsang gi snang brgyad bsngo ba ni: thog mar lo bdag 'khor bcas kyi gtor ma thogs la phyogs gtsang du bsngo ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang : hūm̐: srid pa ma srid ye thog tu: spros bcas dngos med mtha' 'das las: rtag chad mu bzhi'i 'du 'phros kyis: snang tsam snod kyi 'jig rten chags: de srid rten 'brel bcu gnyis las: 'gyu 'phros rlung dang dal gcig tu: lo zla zhag dus rgyu ba yi: gza' dang rgyu skar sa bdag dang : brtan ma dus 'dzin gsang nyul dang : gzhan yang gdug sems 'chang ba yi: sgra gcan nag po gdong dgu dang : zin phung g.yu mdzo sngon mo dang : gnam khyi nag po mche ba can: hal khyi nag po ral pa can: phung zor nag po spu gri can: nyi ma nag po 'dab ma can: zla ba nag po kha dug can: dus 'dzin gser gyi ske rags can: gzhan yang zhag dus 'khor ba sogs: gnam lo rgyal po zla ba blon: zhag de dmag gi dus tshod mtshon: spar sme sa 'dzin gnas bdag sogs: byams brtse'i sems kyis 'dir gshegs la:

rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dang : gser skyems khri dkar stong nag 'bul: gzugs 'gros yas stags sna tshogs 'bul: srid pa'i sde tshogs dgyes gyur nas: ro 'don gshin byed dur 'debs sogs: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gis: bya ba ci dang ci mchis nga : ko long sdoms la ru nga dang : phrag dog gdug sems ma 'chang bar: zhi ba bde legs phan sems kyis: snying rje'i bsam pa sgrub skyed la: phyogs kyi g.yo 'khrug zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ye dharma dhā tu+u ya bhū mi pa ti ma ho rā ga bo dhi saṃ bha ya bha wan+tu swā hā: de nas bsngo zhing 'bul ba ni: snang brgyad spyi gzhung phyogs su 'bul: sa bdag srung bzhi steng 'og phyogs su bskyal: hūm̐: srid pa ye thog sku mkhar gyi: rim pa bcu gsum gong shed nas: tshangs pa brgya byin sde tshogs la: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la bya khyung khra bo 'bul: khyung dmar gshog pa ma rdebs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa ye swā hā: gnam gyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: steng phyogs su bskyal: hūm̐: shar phyogs shing gi sku mkhar nas: skyed byed shing gi mi bo cher: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la mtshal stag skya bo bsngo: stag skyas kha ni ma gdangs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ ra tri mu pa le ye swā hā: shar gyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar du 'bul: hūm̐: lho phyogs me yi sku mkhar nas: gso byed me yi mi bo cher: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la g.yu 'brug sngon mo bsngo: g.yu 'brug mjug ma ma g.yug cig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhurba tri sa ya sa ma ti swā hā: lho yi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lho ru 'bul: hūm̐: nub phyogs lcags kyi sku mkhar nas: brtan pa lcags kyi mi bo cher:

gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la bya ni ze dmar bsngo: bya dmar gshog pa ma sprugs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhi bhu sa ha ti ta tri ye swā hā: nub kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub tu 'bul: hūm̐: byang phyogs chu yi sku mkhar nas: kun gso chu yi mi bo cher: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la rus sbal rgya bo bsngo: rus sbal rkan sgra ma rdebs shig: gnam lo'i rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ saṃ bhak+ṣa ka taṃ dza ya swā hā: byang gi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang du 'bul: hūm̐: 'og phyogs sa yi sku mkhar nas: 'gyur med lha mo bstan ma cher: 'byung ba'i sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la phag dang bum pa 'bul: dur phag nag po ma 'khun cig: gnam lo sa bdag 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhū mi pa ti ya sa du ho swā hā: 'og gi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: 'og phyogs su 'bul: de nas shel tshig dang 'bru sna gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon rnams phyogs mtshams su rim bzhin 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'byung lnga'i stag yos dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod phur bu chen po dang : smin drug la sogs shar skar drug: spar sme gsum mthing zin la sogs: shing gi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar phyogs su 'bul: hūm̐: shar lho'i mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i 'brug: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod sgra gcan skar ma skag: spar sme bzhi ljang zon la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor:

gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar lhor 'bul: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'byung lnga'i sbrul rta dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod nyi ma mig dmar dang : rta chen la sogs lho skar drug: spar sme dgu dmar li la sogs: me yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lho ru 'bul: hūm̐: lho nub mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i lug: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod spen pa sa ga dang : spar sme gnyis nag khon la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lho nub tu 'bul: hūm̐: nub phyogs 'byung lnga'i sprel bya dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod pa wa sangs dang ni: snron la sogs te nub skar drug: spar sme dwa dang bdun dmar sogs: me yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā:

nub tu 'bul: ham̐'u: nub byang mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i khyi: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod mjug ring byi bzhin dang : spar sme drug dkar khen la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub byang du 'bul: hūm̐: byang phyogs 'byung lnga'i phag byi ba: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' mchog zla ba lhag pa dang : mon gre la sogs byang skar drug: spar sme gcig dkar khams la sogs: chu yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang du 'bul: hūm̐: byang shar mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i glang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod rā hu skar bra nye: spar sme brgyad dkar ging la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang shar du 'bul: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dbus gnas pa'i: lo zlar 'khor ba'i sa bdag dang : gza' dang rgyu skar 'gyu ba sogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang : nyul le bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: mthun pa'i yas stags 'di bzhes la: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs shig:

lha dang dpal du bskyed par gyis: ko long ru nga zhi ba dang : phrag dog gdug sems ma 'chang zhig: oṃ ma ma kun ta shra bā ṇa ye swā hā: dbus su phul lo: de nas spar kha ho'i phyag rgya phyogs su bstan cing : sa bdag gi sgrib shing gtong ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe sangs rgyas bco ldan 'das: byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams gzigs: srid snang tshogs drug zil gyis mnan: snod kyi 'gyu ba phra rags bcom: 'byung lnga'i 'phro 'du dbang du bsdus: ye shes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis: lo zla snyoms shing dgra gshed zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: ye shes ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: de 'og bsam yas mchims phu ru: gtsug lag sa 'dul bgyis pa'i tshe: dregs 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rdo rje mi shigs phyag rgya yis: myang 'das snod bcud shugs las mnan: srid pa gsum gyi sgrib shing btab: lha 'dres 'khrugs grol gdug rtsub zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: spar kha ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: 'byung ba kun gyi phrag dog rnams: srung ba 'di yis zhi gyur cig: lo yi dgra gshed bsal du gsol: oṃ shang shang shing shing dha rod dha la ma ru pa ye a par yang gyang ta shrī sarba e haṃ ya ti twa shud+dhe ho dzñā na badz+ra pañtsa ye swā hā: lo zla zhags dus kyi dgra dang gshed kha dur kha bye ba thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: zhes pas phyogs su 'dzugs: de nas spur khang gi nang du ro drangs la kha shar phyogs su bstan te bzhag: tshe 'das kyi rnam shes 'gugs pa ni: phung po'i za 'dre'am rigs drug gi gshed dang phral ba ni: sbyang chas ngar mi gtor chung mar me changs bu ting lo bcas spur khang gi thogs nas lan gsum bskor la phyi rol du bskrad: hūm̐: mngon dga'i zhing khams bgrod pa la: gnod par byed pa'i za 'dre dang : stag yos gnyis kyi shi gshed sogs: gson bdud gshin lcags ma lus kun:

khyad par zhe sdang las gyur pa'i: dmyal ba'i duḥkhar khrid pa'i tshogs: lan chags bdud kyi sde rnams la: gtor chung changs bu mar me dang : ting lo 'bras chang bcas pa bsngo: gshin lcags gdug pa zhi ba dang : rig drug duḥkha sbyang gyur cig: oṃ sarba swa bhā pā paṃ na ye bi shwa dha ye swā hā: gson bdud gshin lcags u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces pas sbyangs: hūm̐: dpal ldan zhing khams bgrod pa la: gnod par byed pa'i za 'dre dang : rta sbrul gnyis kyi shi gshed sogs: gson bdud gshin lcags ma lus kun: khyad par nga rgyal las gyur pa'i: lha yi duḥkhar 'khrid pa'i tshogs: lan chags bdud kyi sde rnams la: gtor chung changs bu mar me dang : ting lo 'bras chang bcas pa bsngo: gshin lcags gdug pa zhi ba dang : rigs drug duḥkha sbyang gyur cig: oṃ sarba swa bhā pā paṃ na ye bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: gson bdud gshin lcags u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces pas sbyang : hūm̐: bde chen zhing khams bgrod pa la: gnod par byed pa'i za 'dre dang : bya sprel gnyis kyi shi gshed sogs: gson bdud gshin lcags ma lus kun: khyad par 'dod chags las gyur pa'i: mi yi duḥkhar 'khrid pa'i tshogs: lan chags bdud kyi sde rnams la: gtor chung changs bu mar me dang : ting lo 'bras chang bcas pa bsngo: gshin lcags gdug pa zhi ba dang : rigs drug duḥkha sbyang gyur cig: oṃ sarba swa bhā pā paṃ na ye bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: gson bdud gshin lcags u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ zhes sbyang : hūm̐: las rab zhing khams bgrod pa la: gnod par byed pa'i za 'dre dang : byi phag gnyis kyi shi gshed sogs: gson bdud gshin lcags ma lus kun: khyad par phrag dog las gyur pa: lha min duḥkhar 'khrid pa'i tshogs: lan chags bdud kyi sde rnams la: gtor chung changs bu mar me dang : ting lo 'bras chang bcas pa bsngo: gshin lcags gdug pa zhi ba dang : rigs drug duḥkha sbyang gyur cig:

oṃ sarba swa bhā pā paṃ na ye bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: gson bdud gshin lcags u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces pas sbyang : hūm̐: 'og min zhing khams bgrod pa la: gnod par byed pa'i za 'dre dang : khyi 'brug gnyis kyi shi gshed sogs: gson bdud gshin lcags ma lus kun: khyad par gti mug las gyur pa'i: byol song duḥkhar 'khrid pa'i tshogs: lan chags bdud kyi sde rnams la: gtor chung changs bu mar me dang : ting lo 'bras chang bcas pa bsngo: gshin lcags gdug pa zhi ba dang : rigs drug duḥkha sbyangs gyur cig: oṃ sarba swa bhā pā paṃ na ye bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: gson bdud gshin lcags u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces pas sbyang : hūm̐: mkha' spyod zhing khams bgrod pa la: gnod par byed pa'i za 'dre dang : glang lug gnyis kyi shi gshed sogs: gson bdud gshin lcags ma lus kun: khyad par ser sna las gyur pa'i: yi dwags duḥkhar 'khrid pa'i tshogs: lan chags bdud kyi sde rnams la: gtor chung changs bu mar me dang : ting lo 'bras chang bcas pa bsngo: gshin lcags gdug pa zhi ba dang : rigs drug duḥkha sbyang gyur cig: oṃ sarba swa bhā pā paṃ na ye bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: gson bdud gshin lcags u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ

ces pas sbyang dor: de nas khrus bum gyis khrus bstsal ba ni: thog mar zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la khrus bya: hūm̐: ji ltar dam pa de dag la: ngo mtshar lha yis khrus gsol ltar: de ring rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: rnal 'byor bdag gis khrus gsol lo: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon la: bdag 'dzin nyon mongs sgrib bral yang : 'gro ba'i bag chags sbyang slad du: ye shes lnga yi khrus chab 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: sku gsum rdo rje dkyil 'khor la: rang bzhin bden pa'i shugs 'chang chus: sems can sgrib pa sbyang ba dang : bag chags ma lus sbyang bar stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas sku gsum thugs kyi khrus chu rnams slar khrus bum la blugs te gshin po la khrus bstsal: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: kun bzang ka dag snying po'i chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bstsal pas: tshe rabs bag chags sbyang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i chaiga'i shes bya'i sgrub pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bag chags kyi sgṛb pa las kyi sgrib pa rnams kyis kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'gro don mdzad: sku lnga lhun grub byang chub chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bstsal pas: tshe rabs bag chags sbyang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe las 'das pa chaig mo' ི shes bya'i sgrib pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa las kyi sgrib pa rnams kyis kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig:

oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: sna tshogs gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku: dam tshig ye shes rdo rje'i chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bstsal pas: tshe rabs bag chags sbyang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu lu ru hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe las 'das pa chaig mo'i shes bya'i sgrib pa dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa las kyi sgrib pa snams kyis kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: bde stong skye med rang byung chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bstsal pas: 'khor ba'i duḥkha mi myong zhing : byang chub thar lam bgrod par shog: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu lu ru hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe las 'das pa chaig mo'i shes bya'i sgrib pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa las kyi sgrub pa snams kyis kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: 'di skabs rnam shes spar: zhes pas khrus chu thams cad phung po'i steng du gtor: de nas phyogs bzhi'am gsum mam gnyis sam sgo rnams la shing tshang zab gsar brtsegs: me sbar mkhan sdig can ma yin pa gcig gis bya: sa ma ya: thog mar mchod rdzas thams cad kyi 'bag pa bsang nas: bgegs bskrad te dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hri phaiṃ phaiṃ: auṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ zhes pas mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i snod rin po che las grub pa'i nang du mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa: bdud rtsi'i bcud phun sum tshogs pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin las byung zhing zad mi shes pa nam mkha' mtha'i dang mnyam par gyur: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ

oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: de nas me thab bskyed pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ti ya thā raṃ zhes pas rlung me chu dang sa yis btegs pa'i steng du ye shes kyi rlung lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid dang ldan par zla phyed rdo rje'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba: bud shing gis gang ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bcu pa'i lte bar yi ge raṃ yongs su gyur pa las: dam tshig gi me lha sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis he ru ka'i rnam pa can g.yas pas rdo rje dang g.yon pas dril bu bsnams pa: ral pa kham nag spyi bor gzengs shing tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: zhabs brgyad gar stabs can me rab tu mched pa'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i phyi rol tu 'dab ma bcur khams lnga rnam par dag pa'i me lha yab lnga ni mthing dkar ser dmar ljang gu'i 'od dang ldan pa: rlung lnga rnam par dag pa'i me lha yum lnga ni mthing 'od dkar gsal ser mdangs dmar skya ljang khu rlung gi rang bzhin mdangs dang ldan pa: thams cad gtso bo'i chas dang mthun pa ste rang bzhin du tsaṇ+ḍa 'bar ba'i shugs dang ldan par gsal ba'o: de'i phyi rol tu me lha drang srong brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad kyang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags thams cad sreg pa'i rang bzhin can te: gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi me lha rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs te dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par nyi ma dang tsha ba'i ngad zung du 'jug pa ltar gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min gnas nas ye shes rab bskyod pa:

rnam pa bskul ba'i cha tsam snang ngo ru: skye med me rlung tsaṇ+ḍa'i phrin las pa: shar lho drang srong me lha ag+ne'i tshogs: thabs shes zung 'jug rang bzhin me sbar nas: bag chags du ma'i phung khams sbyang ba'i phyir: rang bzhin klong nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye dzñā na raṃ sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol nas phyag mchod ni: hūm̐: ye shes 'bar ba'i rang bzhin snying po'i lha: skye mched bcu gnyis sgrib sbyang bgyi ba'i phyir: sreg byed tshwa tshwa 'khyil ba'i dal du bzhugs: nyon mongs bud shing sreg la phyag bgyid cing : dug lnga las kyi rnam smin sbyang slad du: dgyes pa'i mchod pa du ma 'bul ba dang : phyi mchod sna tshogs yid 'ong spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman raka gsang mchod sbyor sgrol sogs: mthun rdzas 'dod yon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'di: bcom ldan me lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dge bcu'i bar chod zhi phyir bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas dug lnga'i bag chags sgrib sbyang chad: rang bzhin rol rtsal me dpung gzi brjid bskyed: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: de skabs ku sha me'i 'og tu mnan pa'i sngags 'di bgrang nas rgyas gdab: oṃ ri ri li li ram bu ra ta u u ṭha ṭhā nan: phyogs su drangs te gdam: de nas sbar ba ni: dpal 'bar thogs nas: shar sgo nas: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung gdod nas rnam dag kyang : byad las sna tshogs gya gyu 'phro ba yi: rnam pa ris med gcig dang tha dad du: sgyu ma tsam du snang ba'i cha tsam gyi: tshe 'das 'khrul 'byams yid kyi bag chags rnams: ka dag kun grol chen po'i me sbar bas: rab rib gti mug a 'thas sregs su gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu lu ru hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: hūm̐: 'gag med mkha' la mtha' dbus gzhal 'das kyang : 'gog bral zang thal 'gro ba'i ngang shugs kyis: snang la 'dzin med stong pa'i char 'das kyang :

rang bzhin shugs kyis thugs rje'i rtsal 'byin pas: tshe 'das smra brjod ngag gi bag chags rnams: lhun grub bde chen snying po'i me sbar bas: dngos 'joms mtha' bzhi'i yul 'dzin sregs su gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu lu ru hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das rang bzhin skye med kyang : snod gzugs phra rag bdag dang gzhan 'dzin pas: sna tshogs so so'i rnam pa du ma ru: grub kyang snying rje'i sprul sku'i rang mdangs mthus: tshe 'das bsdus bya'i lus kyi bud shing la: kun gzhi ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas: rigs drug sa bon bag chags sregs su gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu lu ru hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: hūm̐: thabs kyi yab drug dag gis spel ba'i blos: gnas drug srid pa'i rdzing skyil bud shing la: shes rab yum chen drug gi me sbar bas: tshe 'das rten 'brel bcu gnyis rgyud dag ste: dag pa 'ja' lus 'od skur rab grol nas: sna tshogs rgyal ba'i zhing mchog mthong ba yis: phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang thob par shog: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes pas mes khyab par bya zhing sbar te skabs 'dir mda' dar gsum me hom gyi rnam par 'dzugs: om̐ raṃ tsakra ye swā hā: me lha rang bzhin rlung gis g.yab pa ni: hūm̐: dpa' bo thabs drug ye shes me dpung la: gsang ba shes rab drug gi rlung g.yab pas: tshe 'das rigs drug bag chags bsreg pa dang : skye gnas rnam pa bzhi yi sgo bcad nas: sa bcu dang ni lam lnga bgrod par shog: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: de nas me lha'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan drang srong ye shes me yi lha: 'bar ba'i mdangs 'byin gzi brjid tshwa tshwa 'phro: 'khor ba'i bud shing bag chags bsregs pa yi:

he ru ka drug bde chen yum mchog drug: snang srid klong las khyab pa'i gar bsgyur ba: 'jigs byed me lha 'khor dang bcas pa yis: mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i bsreg rdzas sna tshogs 'di: tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyang phyir bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas thar lam byang chub bgrod par shog: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra a dhi bh+ya a dhi bh+ya ma hā shrī ye ha bh+ya ka bh+ya swā hā: oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ni swā hā: mtshams 'dir mchod pa rgyas pa zhig gtong : de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin snying po'i yab mchog ka dag dang : dbyings phyug thams cad skyed pa'i kun gzhi yum: 'byung lnga rnam dag rang byung dpa' bo lnga: rlung lnga rtsal mched g.yo ba'i dpa' bo lnga: zung 'jug rol pa 'bar ba'i tsaṇ+ḍa li: snod bcud gcig bsdus drang srong bcu gnyis la: shes sgrib nyon mongs sbyang phyir bstod par bgyi: khyed la khyad du phrin las bcol ba ni: 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol 'phos pa yi: tshe 'das yid lus srid par 'khyams pa 'dis: tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang : phrag dog ser sna'i dbang gyur las ngan gyi: rgyu ru bsags pa ci mchis thams cad kun: sbyin sreg cho ga 'di yis sbyang gyur cig: ye shes rang bzhin spor mdzod drang srong tshogs: sku lnga'i zhing khams mngon du 'gyur bar shog: badz+ra a pa ra tsa na dharma la bh+ye hri dha ya swā hā: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa ni: hoḥ raṃ raṃ zhes pas me lha'i lto bar ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga ldan las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid tshang zhing gdan phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros: sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs shing phar 'phros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod pas tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu mngon du gyur: tshur 'dus pas phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa gnas 'gyur te bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor rnams nam mkha'i dbyings la 'ja' ldang ba ltar snang la rang bzhin dang bral ba'i ngang du gsal ba'o:

oṃ bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍa la gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ye swā hā: zhes pas cho ga'i gzhung bsrangs nas mchod pa la bskyal te phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dang po mar khu tshar gcig mchod pa sngags 'di dang sbyar: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā: a hu ti sarba pū dza khā hi: lan bdun nam 'os mtshams kyis dpag par bya'o: de nas sgrib sbyang gi byang bu rnams mar khu zung gis mchod la: oṃ sarba a ka sha nir ya ya ka a wa ra ṇa pā paṃ a hu ti ye durga ti pa ri shwa dha ya war+ṇa na laṃ duḥkha bi shwa dha ya swā hā: dbus phyogs nas mchod: mar khu la: om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta bhe ro tsa na ye dzñā na a bhi pra ya bha wa tu swā hā: gong bzhin no: om̐ sarba pu ra wa mo ha a ra ṇa pā paṃ a dhu ti ye durga te pa ri shwa dha ya war+ṇa ni lam ta duḥkha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: shar du mchod: mar khu la: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra sa twa ye dzñā na a bhi pra ya bha wa tu swā hā: gong bzhin no: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki ṇa ma tsar+ya a wa ra ṇa pā paṃ a dhu ti ye durga ti pa ri shwa dha ya war+ṇa si ti duḥkha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: lho ru mchod: mar khu la: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta rat+na saṃ bha ye dzñā na a bhi pra ya bha wa tu swā hā: gong bzhin no: oṃ sarba pañtsa ma ra ga ha sha a wa ra ṇa pā paṃ a hu ti ti ye durga ti pa ri shwa dha ya war+ṇa ra ga ti duḥkha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: nub tu mchod: mar khu la: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a mi dhe wa ye dzñā na a bhi pra ya bha wa tu swā hā: gong bzhin no: oṃ sarba ut+ta ra a ri sha a wa ra ṇa pā paṃ a hu ti ye durga ti pa ri shwa dha ye war+ṇa mar ga duḥkha bi shwa dha ye swā hā: byang du mchod: mar khu la: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a mo gha sid+dhi ya dzñā na a bhi pra ya bha wa tu swā hā: skye sgo gcod pa'i sngags 'di tshar drug bris la mchod:

oṃ sarba bhi ṇa a ṭa na ra ka'i pre ta ka tir+ya ka duḥkha ga dhi ta ye pā paṃ a hu ti ye durga te pa ri shwa dha ya shwa dha pa war+ṇa bi shwa dha ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa chaig mo'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang nas skye gnas ngan pa'i sgo thams cad chod par gyur cig swā hā: khyab par mchod: mar khu la: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ā li kā li oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.a sarba karma hrī dha ya swā hā: gong bzhin no: sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i sngags rnams tsan dan gyi shing la dri bzang gtams pa'i mtshal gyis bris nas zhi khro'i gzungs kyis sngags: de nas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: thog mar phyi mchod la: dkyil 'khor dang bstun nas: me tog: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: spos la: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: mar me la: oṃ ā lo ke swā hā: dri chab la: oṃ gan+dhe swā hā: zhal zas la: oṃ badz+ra ne wi d+ye swā hā: rol mo la: oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā: gzugs la: oṃ badz+ra rū pa bi shwa sarba swā hā: sgra la: oṃ dun+dhi bhi ghin+ḍa swā hā:
