dri la: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe shang kha na ra swā hā: ro la: oṃ badz+ra bho ga puṇ+yai swā hā: reg byar: oṃ pañtsa ka spar+she swā hā: sku'i mchod pa me long la: oṃ badz+ra wang se a dar+sha swā hā: gsung gi mchod pa pi waṃ la: oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye gīrti ye swā hā: thugs kyi mchod pa bum pa rnam rgyal la: oṃ badz+ra bhi dza ya ga lak+ṣa swā hā: yon tan gling bu la: oṃ badz+ra swa ra ma le ye swā hā: phrin las me tog gi phreng ba la: oṃ badz+ra nīrti puṣ+pe ma li ta swā hā: sna tshogs mchod pa bkra shis rtags brgyad las: gdugs la: oṃ maṅga la tsakra swā hā: gser nya la: oṃ maṅga la se na mar+pa swā hā: dung dkar la: oṃ maṅga la shag swā hā: me tog la: oṃ maṅga la ka ma ku murta swā hā: bum pa la: oṃ maṅga ga la ka ma sha ga la lak+ṣa swā hā: dpal be'u la: oṃ maṅga la sha shwa ta ye swā hā: rgyal mtshan la: oṃ maṅga la dh+wa dza ya swā hā: 'khor lo la: oṃ maṅga la rat+na tsakra swā hā: rgyal srid sna bdun gyi 'khor lo la: oṃ maṇ+ḍal tsakra swā hā: nor bu la: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na swā hā: btsun mo la: oṃ sa sti rat+na swā hā: blon po la: oṃ pu ru kha rat+na swā hā: glang po la: oṃ ha sti rat+na swā hā: rta mchog la: oṃ ā shwa rat+na swā hā: dmag dpon la: oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na swā hā: nang mchod 'bul ba ni: bdud rtsi la: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā: rak+ta la: oṃ ma hā ra ga a mṛ ta swā hā: ye shes sman mchod la: oṃ dzñā na a mṛ ta swā hā: gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: tshogs la: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra la swā hā: rmad byung 'brang rgyas la: oṃ ga ṇa pha la ye swā hā: gtor ma la: oṃ bha ling+ta pū dza swā hā: gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni: mar khu'i nang du dam rdzas bsres la ting 'dzin dang bcas nas: oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu dzñā na sa ma ye bo dhi bhik+ṣa ye swā hā: rdzas kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: zas mchog la: oṃ sarba pu tsa ta bu la ye swā hā:

ku sha la: oṃ sarba tri na la ya swā hā: yam shing la: oṃ mu la da ha na ya swā hā: dūrba la: oṃ sarba bhi ṣa ka swā hā: rdzas lnga la: thog mar mig dbang la: oṃ bh+rūm̐ tsak+ṣu swā hā: sgra dbang la: oṃ rte tra na ku ye swā hā: dri dbang la: oṃ gh+ri ni dziṃ ye swā hā: ro dbang la: oṃ dzi ha kham ye swā hā: yid spyod la: oṃ ma ne na ye hūm̐ swā hā: sman lnga las: dzā ti la: oṃ bha tra o ṇa ye swā hā: a ru ra la: oṃ sarba dzī to bhik+ṣa ka swā hā: li shi la: oṃ sarba gh+ra na bhik+ṣa ka swā hā: gi waṃ la: oṃ sarba ne ṭa bhik+ṣa ka swā hā: tsan dan dkar dmar la: oṃ sarba bho kha tsan dha mu la swā hā: 'bru lnga la: nas: oṃ sarba ge pa ra a dhe swā hā: 'bras la: oṃ sarba pa lu pra yu ta swā hā: gro la: oṃ sarba ghe dhu ma ye swā hā: khre la: oṃ sarba spri yang gu swā hā: sran ma la: oṃ sa se li ta ye swā hā: phra 'bru gsum las: so ba la: oṃ pa ra kha u pa ta swā hā: til dkar la: oṃ sarba si si ta la swā hā: til nag la: oṃ sarba ka la swā hā: dkar gsum las: mar thud zho gsum la: oṃ sarba nu su ṣaṃ swā hā: mngar gsum las: sbrang bu ram ka ra la: oṃ ri sma a mṛ ta bi shwa swā hā: shing 'bras sna tshogs la: oṃ sarba bhu ka ta pha la ye swā hā: zhun sna tshogs: oṃ ra sa me pur+ṇa swā hā: rgyan rin po che sna tshogs las: gser la: oṃ sarba sa le sbram swā hā: dngul la: oṃ sarba ru bya ni swā hā: zangs la: oṃ sarba ta ma ye swā hā: lcags la: oṃ sarba lo ha ye swā hā: rag la: oṃ sarba bi ta tra swā hā: mu tig la: oṃ sarba mug ti ka swā hā: mu men la: oṃ sarba mu gu tra swā hā: dung ngam shel la: oṃ sarba ke la sha swā hā: g.yu la: oṃ sarba pi ro tsa swā hā: byi ru la: oṃ sarba dru ma swā hā: gzi la: om̐ tro ha ri swā hā: spos shel la: oṃ sarba darke ta na swā hā: gos reg bya sna tshogs las:

dar dkar la: oṃ ku ma ṭa sirti swā hā: dar ser la: oṃ ku mu ṭa si ti swā hā: dmar po la: oṃ ku mu tra ra ga ti swā hā: sngon po la: oṃ ku mu tra ni lam du swā hā: ljang gu la: ku mu ta ṭa mar ga na swā hā: sna tshogs la: ku mu tra pañtsa li ta ka swā hā: za 'og sna tshogs la: oṃ ma hā bha tra spar+she sha ra si bhi shwa swā hā: zhes rdzas thams cad rdzogs nas bstod pa gtong : phrin las bcol ba la: zhi ba'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hoḥ bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gsang ba'i sbyin sreg bla na med pa'i mchod pa phul ba la brten nas: 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe dus las 'das pa chaig mo'i shes bya'i sgrib pa dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang las kyi sgrib pa rnams kyis kun nas bslang ba'i sgrib pa dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: khyad par du'ang rigs drug gi duḥkha dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro mi lha ma yin lha la sogs pa las ngan 'gror skye ba'i sgo chod par gyur cig: gzhan yang 'byung ba khams lnga'i bag chags byang ba dang tshe rabs nas srog bcad kyis tshe thung ba'i lan chags: rdung btsogs kyis nad mang ba'i lan chags: 'phrog bcom gyis nor dbul ba'i lan chags: phra ma'i mi kha sdang ba'i lan chags: la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rigs drug tu skye ba'i las bsags pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig: hūm̐: bcom ldan gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: zhi khro 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems la: mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i mchod gtor dgyes byed 'bul: nyon mongs sdig sgrib bag chags zhi gyur nas: mngon dga' dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

rgyas pa la: hūm̐: bcom ldan gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: zhi khro 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems la: mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i mchod gtor dgyes byed 'bul: bsod nams ye shes tshogs mchog rgyas gyur nas: dpal ldan dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dbang la: hūm̐: bcom ldan gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: zhi khro 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems la: mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i mchod gtor dgyes byed 'bul: rlung sems dran rig dbang du 'dus gyur nas: bde chen dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ye bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: drag po la: hūm̐: bcom ldan gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: zhi khro 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems la: mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i mchod gtor dgyes byed 'bul: dge bcu bsgrub pa'i bar chod tshar bcad nas: las rab dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭ e daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: mar khu la: hūm̐: bcom ldan gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: zhi khro 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems la: mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i mchod gtor dgyes byed 'bul: tshogs gnyis yang dag 'bras bu mngon gyur nas: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ.oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ dzñā na pañtsa ye kha kha khā hi: de nas thub pa drug la mar khu 'bul zhing : hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa chos rgyal gyis: bsreg rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das dmyal ba'i skye sgo chod:

dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ mu ne mu ne dharma mu ne ye swā hā: thub pa kha 'bar la: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa kha 'bar gyis: bsreg rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das yi dwags skye sgo chod: dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ mu ne mu ne dharma mu ne ye swā hā: thub pa seṅge la: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa seṅge yis: bsreg rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das dud 'gro'i skye sgo chod: dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ mu ne mu ne dharma ye swā hā: shākya thub pa la: hūm̐: bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis: bsreg rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das mi yi skye sgo chod: dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ mu ne mu ne dharma ye swā hā: thub pa thag bzang la: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa thag bzang gis: bsreg rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das lha min skye sgo chod: dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: au+auṃ mu ne mu ne dharma ye swā hā: brgya byin la: hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa brgya byin gyis: bsreg rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das lha tshe'i skye sgo chod: dag pa'i zhing la drang du gsol: oṃ mu ne mu ne dharma ye swā hā: zhes thub pa rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor dang sa baun bstun: de nas me lha'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan nyon mongs zhi byed me lha rgyal: sgyu ma tsam du snod kyi drang srong tshul: yang dag rang byung ye shes rlung lnga yi: rol rtsal ma 'gags tsaṇ+ḍa 'bar ba'i shugs: thabs shes skye 'gag bral ba'i ngang la mchod: mdangs ldan ye shes lnga yi gzi 'od kyis: rten 'brel bcu gnyis bud shing rab tu bsreg: bsdus bya srid pa'i bag sgrib sbyong byed lha: drang srong ag+ne 'khor dang bcas pa la: bsreg rdzas 'dod yon dgyes pa'i gtor mchod 'bul: tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyang phyir bzhes su gsol: ngan 'gro'i skye sgo 'gag phyir bzhes su gsol: byang chub thar lam bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol:

bde chen zhing mchog bgrod phyir bzhes su gsol: sangs rgyas 'thob phyir dgyes dgongs bzhes nas kyang : sbyin sreg brtsam pa'i las bzhi lhun grub ste: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma lus mthar phyin nas: don gnyis yang dag chos sku rab mngon shog: oṃ ag+ne ye a hu ti e daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes 'bul: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu chog ni: hūm̐: snang ba thabs la stong pa shes rab kyi: rang bzhin cho 'phrul rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: rol rtsal ma 'gags snod du shar ba las: 'byung khams rnam dag bcom ldan me yi lha: ye shes rab 'bar dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dgongs pa mi dmigs zang thal dbyings su hoḥ chu zla 'ja' tshon sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin: gnyug ma lhan skyes ka dag a ru ldang : a a āḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor bsdu: bsngo smon gyis legs par rgyas gdab: de'ang bskyed rdzogs la goms 'dris yod pa rnams kyis zhag bdun nam zhag gsum spur khang rgya'i gdams la bzhag: slar khrus gsol bgyis nas gdung rtags sogs bya: tha mal pa rnams la 'phral du thal sol grang ba dgos na bum chu bsres pa'i chus thal sol ngar phab: sa dpal bzang bar sna sogs 'dod pa dang bstun: me mdangs brtag pa ni: kha dog dkar ba'i zlum po sprin ltar 'khyil ba ni byang chub ldan: dmar po 'tshub 'bar thub tu song na 'dod srid kyis mir skye: ser po phyogs bcur g.yos na bde 'gro thob dka': ljang khu tshig sgra che na sdig bshags 'bungs: sngon po zang thal 'ja' 'od 'khyil na mkha' spyod du bgrod: me kha dog nag cing thur du 'gro ba 'bar na ngan 'gror skye: thog ma'i dud pa gang 'phro ba'i phyogs su skye ba len: dud pa 'phral du logs na skye ba nye bar len: yun ring 'byams na skye ba ring du 'phro: 'od drwa ba'i me lce gsum 'phros mtshams su sku gsung thugs kyi rtags 'byon: spur khang sdig can gyis brtsegs pa dang :

mchod g.yog sdig can yin na ring bsrel mi 'byung : sdig can grib can gyi kha rlangs phog na ring bsrel mi 'byung : de bas mchod rdzas gtsang ba dang grib la 'dzem: phal pa tha mal la ci yang ma ltos so: de'ang sbyin sreg zhes pa ni: dug lnga'i bag chags kyi lus de la: rang byung zhi khro'i ye shes me ldan pas bag chags dang bcas pa'i bsdus bya sreg: mchod sbyin gyi yul ni: tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bsreg rdzas su bsgyur nas 'bul ba'o: dgos ched ni: bag chags nye bar 'khor ba'i g.yar khang de'i sreg sbyong ngo : spur bas shes bya'i bag chags dag cing dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du tshud pa'i rnam pa can no: 'di la lugs mi 'dra ba 'byung ste la la bsten bcas: rnam shes spar chog khrus dang dbang bcas pa'i sreg blugs: la la rnam shes za 'dre mi phral nas bsreg: la la phung po gang tshogs kyi rnam pa las ma g.yos pas du ma zhig snang rung : don la gzhung 'di ni gong bzhin sbyang spel sgyur gsum gyi nang don dang mthun pa'i sreg chog go: de nas phyi nang gi rdzas rnams kyang shin tu chog par bya zhing phyag bzhes slob dpon gyi rgyud dang mthun par phyi nang gi chos kyi go yul brda ma log pa zhig la bsten par bya: sa ma ya: e maḥ ka dag nam mkha' ji lta'i 'od klong nas: kun gzhi ji bzhin nyi zla ltar 'phags pas: rol rtsal ma 'gags 'od zer phyogs bcu ru: 'phros pas mtha' yas srid pa'i 'dul bya'i zhing : rab rib mun pa'i smag rgya las grol phyir: 'od gsal dbyings rig rgyud sde'i 'khor lor bzhag: tshogs gnyis skal ldan las 'phro mtha' can la: rdzogs ldan smin nas rtsod ldan yang mtha' ru: mi 'da' gnyer ba'i tha tshig ci bzhin du: gegs med rang bzhin shugs kyis 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags khyi'i lor gdan drangs shing sbrul lor sbas tshal du shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

// ya) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi/ zhi khro'i las mtha' gshin po'i sbyin sreg gi zin bris sngon med gsar du bskrun pa thugs rje lcags kyu'i lde mig ces bya ba zhib rgyas nges can du bkod pa bzhugs pa'i dbu dang*/ gang gis mtshungs zla med pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /blo ldan yid 'phrog gnas lnga rigs pa yi/ /'chad dang rtsom la rab 'byams blo ster ba'i/ /kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma phyag gi gnas/ de'ang gshin don sbyin sreg go rim zhib rgyas su 'god pa la/ dang po dgos ched ci zhe na/ slob dpon rin po che'i zhal nas/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i yon tan gang*/ /gang zag khyad 'phags gdung yin na/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa mthar phyin byed/ /rnal 'byor pa sogs yin na ni/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i lam mchog bgrod/ /skye bo tha mal pa yin na/ /ngan song rigs drug duḥkha sbyong*/ zhes gsungs/ de la dang po yo byad bsags pa/ bar du gzhung bsrangs la/ tha ma sbyin sreg bya ba sogs grangs phye ste/ dang po yo byad bsags pa ni/ de nyid las/ thog mar dkyil 'khor rang gzhung gi /dal du rab rdul tshon/ 'bring thang sku/ tha ma 'bru tshom bcas 'byor ldan gyi skabs dang bstun par bya/ de'i dbus su bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings tshang ba rdo rje gzung gi thag pa dung zhal me long rigs lnga'i tsakli dang*/ g.yas su kun bzang gi gtor ma phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i gtor ma bcas/ kun bzang zhi chog bya bar de'i gtor ma/ bum pa chad brtan sman raka sogs rang rang gi gzhung bzhin sbyin sreg gi ca lag 'og tu mchod pa ltar bsham/ spros la dga' na bsreg rdzas g.yas la mchod gzhi g.yon/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin g.yon du mchod gzhi dkyil 'khor gang byed gong ltar dang*/ g.yas su sbyin sreg ni gzhi dkar gtsang gi steng du rang gzhung las bshad pa bzhin/ dbus su me lha'i gtor ma/ mtshams bzhir phrin las bzhi'i gtor ma/ de'i mdun du rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor gyi sku rten/

de'i phyi rol du rigs drug gi tshom bu sa bon/ de'i phyi rol du rigs drug gi sbyang chas/ de'i g.yas phyogs su snod kyi nang du rigs drug sbyang ba'i byang bu/ g.yon du skye sgo gcod pa'i byang bu/ rgyab tu dri bzang gi khrus chu/ mdun du snang gsal lnga bzhir bud shing sreg pa'i dpal 'bar ku sha drug bsnol thabs kyis mtshon pa/ gzhan yang spar kha ho'i phyag rgya snang brgyad bsdus pa'i gtor ma/ khyung 'brug stag bya rus sbal bum pa phag /dur mtshon byang bu bzhi/ me dar gsum/ rlung g.yab gsum/ hom gzar blugs sogs bsham/ de mthar rang gzhung las/ las kyi rim pa dang bstun pa'i mchod pa bsham/ zhes gsungs pas/ da ni 'grigs chags su byas te/ dang po me lha'i byon skyems la mchod pa thams cad tshang ba tshar gcig /bar du dkyil 'khor gzhung gi cho ga la rab brgya 'bring lnga bcu tha ma lnga bdun sogs zhing 'byor cha tshang*/ mjug tu me lha'i gshegs skyems cha tshang gcig sogs tsho gsum du phye ste/ dang po phyi mchod/ gzugs sgra dri ro raig bya/ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ sman raka gtor gsum/ 'brang rgyas rmad byung*/ zas mchog /ku sha yam shing shug pa ba lu sogs dkar zhing ro mngar ba/ lo ma dang ldan pa sdig sbyangs sngags kyi sham bu rin chen khu bas shog bu la bris te dkris pa pad+ma srid sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad/ dūrba/ dbang po lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ 'bras bu gsum/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ shing 'bras sna tshogs/ gser dngul zangs lcags bcas/ rin chen sna lnga/ dar sna lnga bcas gzhi dang dpag pa'i thad kar sbreng tshar du dgod/ bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun sogs tsakli bzos pa rab/ ma rnyed tshe thams cad dpar btab pa'o/ /zan la bca' ba phyag srol bzhin bya ste/ yar gzhi bsham bkod phul du phyin par bsgrubs nas/ sa mig gang yin du phyin te/

sa bdag lto 'phye'i skor thig ni/ sangs rgyas gling pa/ rat+na gling pa/ karma chags med/ bstan bcos baiḍūr+ya dkar po sogs zhal mthun gyi rtsa tshig ni/ lto 'phye sa thig la/ cha chen bcu la cha phran dgu dgur dbye bas/ phyogs rer re mig dgu bcu re 'byung ba la/ bsdom sum brgya drug cu ni zhag grangs dang mthun pa 'byung ngo*/ lto 'phye'i mgo bo ston phyogs ni/ dpyid gsum mgo nub kha byang bstan/ /dbyar gsum mgo byang kha shar blta/ /ston gsum mgo shar kha lhor bstan/ /dgun gsum mgo lho kha nub bstan/ /de yang dpyid dus mgo nub bstan/ /mjug ma shar phyogs kun la 'gre/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ zla mgo 'dzin tshul yang hor zla bcu gnyis pa dpyid ra stag sogs ma nor bar/ tha chung bzhi yi gnam stong dang*/ /ra ba bzhi yi tshes gcig la/ /zur thig g.yas g.yon cha phran steng*/ /'bring bzhi'i bco lnga bcu drug la/ /tshangs thig bzhi yi g.yas g.yon gyi/ /cha phran steng nas de kho nar/ /nyin zhag re la re mig re/ /bskyod cing g.yas su 'khor bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin nyin zhag sum brgya drug cu sogs gang bab tshes grangs kyi re mig de/ gdengs ka dbus ma dang mjug ma'i rtse byas la tshangs thig gdab/ lus kyi tshad cha chen gnyis yin la/ tshes grangs gang babs de dbus ma'i tshangs thig yin no/ /gzugs ni klu gzugs gdengs ka dgu dang ldan pa/ gzhog g.yon 'og tu byas pa'i lag g.yon rna bar gtad/ lag g.yas dku la brten zhing nor bu thogs pa bris/ tshangs thig dbus nas cha phran nyer 'dun gzhal la 'og tu cha phran bco brgyad dang*/ mdun du cha phran dgur brtsis pas bar ni dngos grub kyi sa mig yin par gsungs so/ /de ltar phyogs brtags shing dngos grub kyi sa btsal zhing sa slong bya/ dbus mtho byang shar gzhol stegs bu me long ngos ltar bya ste/ dar ras dkar po'i bkab ste/ de steng 'bru'i tshom bu dgod/

maṇ+ḍal khar sku rten bshams pa'i mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis nyer spyod lnga bsham/ yan lag bdun pa gang red kyi mthar/ rang gzhung gi skyabs sems song nas/ sa rin gyi gtor ma gser skyems bshams nas 'di skad do/ /

hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gtso: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: log 'dren dam sri dam la 'dogs: hūm̐: nyon cig steng phyogs la gnas pa'i: sum cu rtsa gsum man chod nas: na raka dmyal khams yan chod kyi: lha srin gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang : sa 'di 'dzin pa srung ma'i tshogs: 'byung ba phra mo man chad la: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po dang : 'dod yon longs spyod gtor ma 'bul: mnyes nas byang chub sems ldan mdzod: de ring pho brang sa 'di stsol: khyed rnams ko long gdug sems dang : log sbyor 'tshe ba'i bsam pa spongs: ci ste sdang sems ldan gyur na: dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam yang bkral: na raka chen po'i dmyal bar ltung : de bas sngon gyi dam tshigs srungs: sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs phrin las mdzod: oṃ bhū mi pa ti dza i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi khā hi: de nas bstan ma lto 'phye la sa slong ba ni: gser skyems dang bha ling bcas bsngo zhing : oṃ āḥhūm̐: nga ni 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ nyon cig bstan ma sa bdag tshogs: de ring sa 'dul chen mo kun: khyed rnams gser skyems 'di bzhes la: pho brang 'bar ba'i sa stsol cig: dkyil 'khor sa 'di phul ba'i mthus: khyod rnams byang chub lam du 'god: lto 'phye sa 'dzin chen po yang : sdang sems 'tshe ba zhi gyur cig: ci ste dam la mi gnas shing : pho brang 'debs par bar chod na: ting 'dzin khro bo thugs khros te: rdo rje gnam lcags bya khyung 'bebs: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi khā hi: zhes sa rko ba'i mal du 'bul/ de nas dbus kyi 'bru phud cung zad sa sdeb dbus su na: sku rten dang mchod pa bsal te: slob dpon gyis las bum bzung zhing chag chag gdab/ zhal shar du gyu zhing bum chu'i sa re 'pho bar bya/

de'ang slas ma drag pa/ gang ma drag pa/ rig mas sa bcags shing 'jam par brdung*/ hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje ye shes gsang ba'i chu: rnam dag yon tan dri ma med pa'i rdzas: smon lam dbang gis byang chub sems bskyed mchog: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sa gzhir chag chag 'debs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya gaṅga a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun rgyu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: rang byung rten 'brel 'char ba'i rtog: gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i dal bcag ste: dbang chen mkha' klong yangs par gsal: auṃ sarba dharma bh+rūm̐ mi haṃ: de nas thig skud dal gyi nyis 'gyur bas ma thung bar dar tshon sna lnga la dril/ dal shes rab yin pas dmar po/ thig thabs yin pas dkar po bya/ rdo rje slob dpon nub la bzhugs/ gzungs ma shar du bzhengs te/ dang po ye shes kyi thig mkha' la gdab pa ni/ gnyis ka'i g.yas kyi thig skud smin mtshams bzung*/ g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyi mas nas yar gcus te gyen du nam mkhar gdab bo/ /de nas shar nub kyi tshangs thig dgod/ de bzhin du slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas pas lho byang gi tshangs thig gdab bo/ /slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du phyin nas shar du log thig gdab bo/ /slob dpon srin dang slob ma rlung lhar gnas la nub kyi log thig gdab/ slob dpon dbang ldan slob ma rlung lhar phyin la rgyab sprod byas te byang gi log thig gdab bo/ /slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du rgyab sprod byas la lho'i log thig gdab/ slob dpon me slob ma rlung du phyin te byang shar gyi zur thig gdab bo/ /slob dpon srin dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas lho nub byang shar gyi zur thig gdab bo/ /chos sku'i gnam thig gdab pa ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi ka dag dbyings kyi klong : rang byung rig pa'i rtsal shar te: mi 'gyur rdo rje spro ba'i lam: gsang ba dbyings kyi klong du thob: oṃ badz+ra saṃ skṛ ta gu h+ya dharma hoḥ

zhes gdab bo/ /longs sku'i mgrin thig par gdab pa ni: hūm̐: rgyu rtsal ma 'gags lam gyis shar: gsal stong snying po thabs kyi chos: shes rab drwa ba'i dbyings su spro: longs sku de bzhin thig gdab bo: om̐ badz+ra gi waṃ ti hūm̐ āḥ zhes gdab bo: sprul sku'i sa thig gdab pa ni: hūm̐: lhun grub rang byung de bzhin dbyings: 'khor lo lnga ldan dkyil 'khor gtso: rang byung bde chen kun da'i rgyud: shes rab stong pa'i 'khor lo gdab: oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu bh+yaḥ zhes gdab bo: de nas rgyu 'byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la gdab pa ni: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes ldan dge ba'i grogs: gsang ba'i brda skad 'byin pa'i dbyangs: gar sgyur bskyed mdzad brda 'byin ma: rnam dag rdo rje'i thig thob cig: oṃ swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 dharma gar+bhe āḥ zhes tshangs thig drang por gdab bo: de nas bcu drug gi thig gdab bo: tshon rtsi rnams zhib la mdangs che bar bya zhing : dang po 'byung ba rim brtseg phyir: dbus su gzhi ljang gu 'og tu bzhag: rdo rje'i ra yis tām̐ḥzhes bri: de steng dmar po pām̐ḥbris bzhag: de steng dkar po bzhag mām̐ḥzhes bri: de steng ser po bzhag lām̐ḥzhes bri: de steng sngon po bzhag mūm̐ḥzhes bri: hūm̐: rang byung sna lnga bsnol brtsegs thab: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rang byung rang shar de bzhin ngang : 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus de ltar bstim: oṃ yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ hūm̐: de ltar so sor blangs te phyogs mdog tu bzhag nas: oṃ tām̐ ā hrī hūm̐: zhes bri: hūm̐: zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod chags dang : gti mug ma spangs dbyings su dag: ye shes lnga ldan lam gyis shar: kun rgyu gnas pa sa bon bh+rūm̐: oṃ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe haṃ: zhes pas mtshon byin rlabs lnga ser dang gdong ma thug bar la bdag mdun zhal sprod yong ba bya dgos te/ lo'i lnga ser ni/ byi lo nub byang*/

glang lo nub/ stag lo byang shar/ yos lo lhor/ 'brug lo byang*/ sbrul lo lho nub/ rta lo shar/ lug lo shar lho/ bya lo nub byang*/ khyi lo shar/ phag lo byang shar du gnas/ zla ba'i lnga ser ni/ gang shar zla ba de'i bdun zur gnas pas/ byi rta ru chod/ glang lug phung gyod/ stag sprel bdun zur/ khyi 'brug thog rdzis/ phag sbrul mche brdar/ bya yos bye bral yin pas dpyad shes bya/ zhag gi lnga ser ni/ gcig tsho gsum la shar lho/ gsum tsho gsum lho/ bzhi tsho gsum lho nub/ drug tsho gsum nub byang*/ bdun tsho gsum la byang*/ brgyad tsho gsum byang shar/ dgu tsho gsum sa steng*/ bcu tsho gsum sa 'og gnas yul bzhin shes par bya/ de nas thig tshon 'gom pa'i nyes pa spang ba'i phyir/ oṃ sarba bā+e ga tra ma hūm̐: zhes brjod la kyang thig tshon thams cad nam mkhar btegs te/ de'i 'og nas thams cad 'gro bar bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje dang khu tshur g.yon pas thog mar dbang ldan nas brtsam te bri/ grogs kun gyis gang bder bri ste: rab dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs dur khrod rdo rwa me ri'i dbus su sa bon pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de ltar ma grub tshe thig chen brgyad po grub zin nas/ mtheb srin gyis sbyar skud sna 'dzin/ gru mo'i rtse ru tshad byas la/ de nyid lteb nas dbus su bzung*/ /zlum spo bskor bas thabs kyi rgya/ /dbus na phyi ru 'jal ba zhing*/ /cha de dkrugs pa'i phyed ngos nas/ /mchu dang kha khyer bar dang*/ gnyis bsdus sprul pa'i 'khor lo grub/ kha 'phyang bzhi ru 'byung ba yin/ grwa bzhir rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan bri/ gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus grub nas/ hūm̐: snod bcud stong gsal zang thal klong : āḥskye med ngo bo rtsal snang las: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dur khrod pho brang wal gyis gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dharma dhā tu bh+yaḥ zhes pho brang gsal lo/ /de nas pho brang zhal khebs byas pa'i steng du/

gdan rim pa bzhi'i steng du pad+ma bum pa mchod rten gyi rnam pa can/ de'ang byang sems kyi rigs: ma yin na seng khri dang bang mdzod med pa'i pad+ma kha bya/ byang sems la sgo bzhi bya/ thab ni sku gsum don dang bzhi/ phal pa la dug gsum sbyang ba zhes so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma la byang chub mchod rten/ rab byung la mchod rten dkar po/ dge bsnyen la pad+ma dmar po kha khyer lta bu/ rgyal po la sngon po gtsug tor lta bu/ blon po la dkar skya za ma tog lta bu/ phal pa la ser skya gdan khri lta bu/ mo la sngo skya sil ma'i 'bras bu lta bu/ byis pa la dmar ser lhung bzed kyi dbyibs/ rgyal po chen po dang blon chen la khri'i phyogs mtshams su rgyal mtshan ba dan bum pa sogs brgyad brgyad dang steng du gdugs sogs 'khor bar bya/ sgo bzhi la rgyal chen sde bzhi srung bzhi sogs bri srol yod/ de'i nang du bud shing zlum por brtsegs te me tshang sogs legs par bzo bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi gzhung bsrang ba ni/ rgyud las/ /thabs dang rdzas sogs gtso mi che/ sngags dang ting 'dzin gtso che'o/ /zhes gsungs/ rang gzhung las/ thog mar gzhung gi dkyil 'khor cho ga tshar gcig gtong*/ rgyas par bum bskyed gzhan yang kha bsgyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang rang gi cho ga'i gzhung bsrang*/ bsnyen mtshams nas khrus bum bya/ der gzhal yas khang bum bskyed ltar la/ lha bskyed nas bzung bsnyen pa bya ste/ sgom bzlas kyi rim pa phul du phyin par bya/ de nas chos skyong tshogs bskang*/ tha ma bsgral ba sogs bya/ gsum pa sbyin sreg la 'jug pa ni/ gar gos dkar po rigs lnga'i dar dpyangs dkar po chun rgyan sogs kyis spras te/ rgyud las thog mar mchod rdzas rnams/ bgegs bskrad de 'bag pa bsang*/ zhes gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor rang gzhung gi bgegs bskrad bsreg rdzas rnams thun gyis brab/ de nas bsang sbyang ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:

ha ho hrīḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas: auṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bar brjod/ de nas rdo rje dril bu bzung ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur te/ rang gi lag mthil g.yon du zla ba'i gdan la 'khod par bsam rnal 'byor dril blang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: zhes brjod de rdo rje lan gsum gsor nas thugs kar 'dzin/ mūm̐ dhā tu shwa ri satwaṃ: dril bu dkur brten/ sbyin sreg ma tshar bar rdor dril dang 'bral mi rung bar bshad do/ /de nas dgang gzar blangs te/ oṃ sarba ba tra swā hā: oṃ thab kyi rol pa las byung ting 'dzin gyis? nas a a a āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ḥ dgang gzar kha sbyar te rdzas thams cad la reg cing : hūm̐: chags med bde stong ye shes rnam rol gyis/ sogs nas/ sarba kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: bar brjod/ yam shing la oṃ shrī ya swā hā: mar khu la/ auṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: 'bru sna thams cad/ oṃ dziṃ swā hā: rdzas thams cad la/ auṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā: byin rlabs tshar nas dgang gzar kha phral mi rung ba bshad do/ /des byin rlabs tshar nas/ rang gzhung las/ spur khang gi nang ro drangs shar phyogs su bstan te: zhes gsungs pa bzhin bzhag ste/ gang zag gi gdung yin na/ bka' brgyad ltar tsan dan gur gum gi waṃ rnams mtshal gyi chur sbyar te bris la/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu sngags sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na sa man+ta bha tra sid+dhi hūm̐: dpral bar/ oṃ sa twa sid+dhi hūm̐/ mgrin par/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hrī sid+dhi dzaḥ thugs kar/ om̐ bud+dha dharma gu ru sid+dhi dzaḥ lte bar/ om̐ rol mo rat+na saṃ bha sid+dhi dzaḥ gsang bar/ om̐ ma ghā sad+dhi dzaḥ dpung g.yas su/ om̐ badz+ra yo ga ṇa tshur+dhi ma hā sid+dhi dzaḥ g.yon du/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni tshur+dhi ma hā yo gi sid+dhi dza dzaḥ bla g.yas la/ auṃ lo ka kro ta sid+dhi dzaḥ

g.yon du/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ḍan e dza hūm̐ sid+dhi dzaḥ de la spro na lha'i gzung spyi ltar bri/ dri bzang gis sbyar te bal ras kyis dkri bar bya/ rigs lnga'i me zhu sogs sbyar ro/ /rol mo dang byin 'bebs bya/ ༈ phal pa la stod skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ 'og sgo'am rkang mthil la/ yi dam rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ oṃ du sa ma ya tshin+dha ye swā hā: gsang bar rtsa sngags sham bu/ oṃ pre sa ma ya tshin+dha ye swā hā: lte bar rtsa sngags sham bu/ auṃ tri sa ma ya tshin+dha ye swā hā: ngan song gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs shing skye sgo khegs pa'o/ /spyi bor bka' brgyad rang gzhung gi btags grol dang thig le brgya pa sogs sbyar/ spur ldan khebs zhes steng du 'khor lo dang 'og tu pad+ma 'dab brgyad sbyar lugs zhig kyang snang*/ de nas snang brgyad bsdus pa'i gtor ma phyogs gtsang su phul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: srid pa ma srid ye thog tu: sogs nas/ sa bha ya bha wan+tu swā hā: de nas srung bzhi khyung 'brug stag bya rus sbal bum pa phag bcas gong gsal ltar gong du dkar gtor lo gtugs bshos bu'i bskor ba de mchod mchan/ rnams phyogs ma 'chol bar 'don pa dang sbrags te 'bul/ de nas srid pa ho'i phyag rgya bstan te/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bcom ldan sangs rgyas kyi: sogs nas/ de nas zhi khro'i rigs drug gnas 'dren gyis tshe 'das kyi rnam shes bkug ste: de nas rigs drug gi gshed dang phral ba ni/ mar me changs bu ting lo gtor chung bcas/ re re bzhin bshams te 'don pa dang sbrags la dor/ de nas rten khrus ni/ sku rten khrus sder nang du bzhag ste/ hūm̐: ji ltar dam pa de dag la: sogs kyis khrus phul zhing slar khrus chu rnams bum par blugs/ sku phyi ba dang na bza' 'bul ba sogs bya/ gshin po la khrus bstsal ba ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: sogs nas khrus bya/ de nas zhi khro'i rigs drug gnas 'dren gyi zas gtad bya ba ni/

hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rgyu 'bras 'od gsal me long ltos: sogs kyis bsngo/ de nas rnam shes spar ba ni/ hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rnam shes rlung gi rta pho la: sogs kyis spar/ de nas sbyin sreg ni gzhung gi / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra t-iṣ+ṭha raṃ sogs nas/ me lha spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal rnams bya ste/ ku sha chun po drug /las bum gyis chus bsang*/ 'o mas sbang*/ pad kor gyis blang*/ rgya gram bya ste rtse mo shar du bstan la bzhag /me lha'i gdan bya/ drug po thabs kyi kha khyer ni/ ku sha ba glang mjug ma ltar snga ma'i rtsa bas phyi mo'i rtse mo non par byas la/ me mgo mnan pa'i sngags 'di bgrang*/ oṃ ri ri li li raṃ bu raṃ ta u u ṭha ṭhā nan/ brjod/ de nas me sbar ba ni/ sdig can ma yin pa zhig gis 'di ltar/ rang gzhung las/ thog mar zhe sdang nas bzung g.yas bskor du gsungs pas/ shar nas sbar te/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung gdod nas rnam dag kyang : sogs kyis sbar/ rlung g.yab kyis g.yab ste/

hūm̐: dpa' bo thab drug yab kyis spel ba'i blos: sogs me dar gsum hom gyi rnam par gong du 'dzugs/ me mdangs brtags pa ni/ rang gzhung las/ kha dog dkar po zlum la 'khyil ba byang chub dang ldan/ dmar po 'tshub 'bar nub tu song ba 'dod sred gyis mir skye/ ser po phyogs bcur g.yon na bde bgro thob dka'/ ljang gu tshig sgra che na sdig bshags la 'bung ngo*/ sngon po zang thal 'ja' 'od 'khyil na mkha' spyod du bgrod/ me kha dog nag cing thur du 'gro ba 'bar na ngan 'gror skye/ thog ma'i dud pa gang du song bar skye ba len/ dud pa 'phral du logs na skye ba nye bar len/ yun ring 'byams na skye ba ring du 'phro/ gang zag la 'od drwa ba'i me lce gsum 'phros mtshams sku gsung thugs kyi rtags 'byon/ spur khang sdig can gyis brtsegs pa dang mchod g.yog sdig can yin na ring bsrel mi 'byung*/ sdig can dang grib can gyi kha rlangs phog na ring bsrel mi 'byung*/ de bas mchod rdzas gtsang sbra dang grib la 'dzem/ phal pa tha mal la ci'ang ma ltos so/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan drang srong ye shes me yi lha: sogs kyis mthar/ byon skyems mchod pa thams cad tshang bar 'bul/ de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ hoḥ ye shes me lha'i dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gsang ba'i sbyin sreg bla na med pa'i mchod pa phul ba la brten nas 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du 'phros shing tshe dus las 'das pa zhes kha bsgyur/ rang gzhung las/ mdun bskyed me lha'i lto bar zhal bsgyur zhes gsungs pas/ ho raṃ raṃ zhes pas me lha'i lto bar ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga ldan las grub pa/ sogs? sa ma ye swā hā/ bar dang*/ de nas rang gzhung gang yin gyi/ lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal mchod pa sogs bya/ de nas rgyud las/ gang zag mchog yin na dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang dbyer med par bskyed la mchod pa'i tshul du 'bul/

phal pa la bsreg rdzas dang sha khrag bcas dbyer med par 'bul/ zhes gsungs/ dmigs pa ni dgang gzar gyi khar lha'i sa bon 'khor bar bsam/ me lha zhal cung zad gdang ba'i ljags la ram̐ yig gis mtshan pas bsreg rdzas thams cad bzhes par bsams shing lag gnyis rdor dril dang khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas/ g.yas kyi blugs gzar gyis bsreg rdzas g.yon gyi dgang gzar du blugs shing gru mo pus mgo las ma 'da' bar kha sbyar nas thab la g.yas bskor gyis 'bul/ yam shing byang chub shing du bsams te rtse mo phar bstan la 'bul/ rtsa sngags kho na'i grangs brgya stong sogs bsags te 'bul ba phyag bzhes yin/ de tshe mi tshig gis bar ma chod par smra bcad bya/ sgrib sbyang gi gzungs bris pa'i byang bu rnams bar skabs su 'bul/ mthar dar tshon gyi rdzas rnams rdzogs par phul la/ bar mtshams kun la phrin las bcol ba ni/ hoḥ bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs? de nas mchod pa rdzogs pa dang sngar ltar gzhung gi bstod pa bya/ yang sngar ltar me lha'i byon skyems ltar gshegs skyel phul te/ hūm̐: bcom ldan nyon mongs zhi byed me lha'i rgyal: sogs?nas/ gnyug ma lhan skyes ka dag āḥru ldang : a a āḥ bar brjod/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya/ rang gzhung las/ de nas bskyed rdzogs kyi goms 'dris yod pa rnams zhag bdun nam gsum du spur khang rgyas gdab bzhag /slar gdung rtags 'byin nas khrus gsol sogs bya/ zhes gsungs pas/ gdung khang bal ras kyis dkris/ the'us rgyab/ nang re bzhin byin 'bebs dang lha khrus sogs bya/ yang gzhung las tha mal pa rnams 'phral du thab sol grang ba dgos na bum chu dang bsres pa'i chus thal sol ngar phab: sa dpal bzang ba'i sna sogs 'dod pa dang bstun/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ chos sku 'od snang thugs rje'i rtsal po che/

/chos zab sbyin sreg gnas 'dren lcags kyu yi/ /chos thun zin bris lde mig 'di bris pas/ /chos dbyings skye med pa la 'gro rnams 'god/ ces mchod tshig gis de tsam gyis btud cing*/ 'di ltar dgos chad ci zhe na/ mtshan ldan bla ma thos bsam sgom gsum gyis yon tan mngon du rgyas shing nyams rtogs ting 'dzin gyi 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ ngag dbang grags pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bkas bskul ba dang rten 'byung lha reg dkar po spyi bor phebs pas/ bka' gyen du ldog ma nus pa'i khul du o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhabs rdul gtsug gi rgyan du khur ba snyoms las sprang po 'chal can ār+ya'i ming gis bstan 'gro ris su ma chad pa'i chos skal du bsams te/ yon tan gze rgyal gnas kyi ri sul du thun mtshams su bsgrubs pa dge/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyas gyur cig/ // ra) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ zhi khro na raka dong sprugs kyi zin bris 'don sgrigs bcas bzhugs so// e ma rgya gar mkhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /yang zab bcud dril snying gi thig le las/ /na raka dong sprugs zin bris 'don sgrigs bri/ /chos skyong srung mas legs tshogs phrin las sgrubs/ /dang po thog mar dal thig btab nas/ dkyil 'khor zhal kha bdag la gyu nas su/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gtso gtor dang rnam rgyal bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kha rgyan lnga ldan 'jog /de'i shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po/ mdun du sman gtor dang mtshams la yum gtor bcas dang*/ dang po sman mchod brgya rtsa brgyad/ rak+ta brgya rtsa brgyad/ me tog brgya rtsa brgyad/ bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ tshogs tshom bu bcas brgya rtsa brgyad re'i grangs 'dod/ de'i mthar me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang bcas mchod pa'i yo byad du ma bsham/

de'i mthar chos srung gtor ma dang bskang gso'i gtor ma chad brtan bcas nyer mkho rnams bsham/ sngon 'gro dkar bgegs rang lugs ltar bya'o/ /'don sgrigs skor/ ༈ dang po theg chen dgu ldan dkyil 'khor gzhung gi skyabs sems dang dkar gtor bgegs gtor btang nas mtshams bcad/ rim bzhin mchod pa'i mtshams su mchod pa byin rlabs sbyar byin 'bebs gzhal yas lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal nas/ sman mchod mtshams su bdud rtsi lag mchod sbyar/ bstod pa'i mtshams su 'dzab bskul btang zhing bsnyen pa byas nas thun mtshams 'jog cing*/ ye shes lha tshogs kyi stong tshig 'bul/ dbang bzhi len nas 'dir rang lugs bskang gso gtong*/ de nas dang po/ lus kyi phyag rabs dug lnga rang grol/ ngag gi bshags pa rdor sems sgom bzlas/ yid kyi lta ba'i klong bshags gnyis med ru tra'i smre bshags bcas 'don/ de nas tshogs byin rlabs spyan 'dren tshogs phud 'bul/ zhi khro'i bskang mchod byin rlabs bya/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: stong gsum khyon ltar nas bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bar 'don/ hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i? sogs/ brda bskang ye shes chen mo 'don/ hūm̐: gti mug ngo bo? sogs gzhung gi bskang thung bshags pa bsgral bstab bya/ 'di'i mtshams mar me'i smon lam bar do'i rtsa tho thos grol chos spyod na raka mtsho skem sogs kyis mtshams sbyar bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gzhung du 'jug /tshogs la rol lhag ma btang*/ bskul mtshams su chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul/ chad mdo brtan ma rta bro bkra shis bsngo smon bcas gzhung ltar bya zhing mi dmigs stong pa nyid kyi ngang la rtag chad mtha' bsal/ rdo rje sems sku wal gyis gsal ba'i ngang spyod lam la 'jug par bya/ zhes dge bshes bzang ldan gyis 'don sgrigs 'khyer bde dgos zhes bskul ngor 7 rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i slob ma tha shal pa sbyang ba'i yon tan dang thos pa'i shes rab sogs ni med mod/

'on kyang la gong du kun dga' blo gros kyis bgyis pas shes ldan rnams kyi thugs kyis mi khrel bar zhu/ zhi khro dkar gling bla ru'i lugs kyi 'don lugs ltar/ dpe de la blangs nas bton na bde mo yod/ 'di la 'don lugs bde mo mi 'dug /gzhan la zur mang lugs/ kaḥthog lugs/ rdzogs chen lugs/ gnas lugs/ sogs du mar phyag len yod tshod las 'di bla lugs dang bstun na 'gal cha med bsam/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // la) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi las tshogs snang brgyad kyi cho ga lha 'dre dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so// ༁ྂ: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye/ 'dir gson gshin gyi bya ba ci byed kyang lo zla zhag dus kyi sa bdag snang srid yul lha sogs la gtor mas brngan zhing bcol ba ni/ gzhi dkar gyi steng du dkar gtor dgu dang srung bzhi khyung phag bum pa 'bru sna shel tshig gser skyems shing rtsi rgyang bu dar tshon: gzhan yang ho'i phyag rgya rus sbal khog pa sogs bca' gzhi tshang bar bsags la: rang nyid 'jam dpal lam snang srid zil gnon gu ru pad+ma'i skur gsal zhing mchod rdzas rnams kyi 'bag pa ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang : oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams dag par gyur: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? khaṃ swā hā: 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t nam mkha'i mdzod de las so so'i thugs bzhed ci lta ba'i mod la dbang po lnga'i bdud rtsi dug lnga'i gsos su gyur pa cir yang 'gyur bar gyur: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā? mgron rnams rang rang gi mdun du mchod rdzas ci 'dod par gsal bar gyur: oṃ dzñā na ā wa lo ki ti na maḥs man+t bdag gi lus zhing gi rdul gyi grangs su song bas yar mchod 'os pa dang mar snying rje'i mgron thams cad la pham rgyal med par blo kha rdzogs pa 'bul bar gyur:

na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ? mgron thams cad dam tshig la gnas nas bdag gi sdongs grogs ci dgos pa thams cad byed par gyur: hūm̐: srid pa ye srid ye thog tu: spros bral dngos med mtha' las 'das: rtag chad mu bzhi'i 'du 'phros kyis: snang tsam snod kyi 'jig rten chags: de srid rten 'brel bcu gnyis las: 'gyu 'phros rlung dang dal gcig tu: lo zla zhag dus rgyu ba yi: gza' dang rgyu skar sa bdag dang : brtan ma dus 'dzin gsang nyul dang : gzhan yang gdug sems 'chang ba yi: sgra gcan nag po gdong dgu dang : zin phung g.yu mdzod sngon mo dang : gnam khyi nag po mche ba can: hal khyi nag po ral pa can: phung zor nag po spu gri can: nyi ma nag po 'dab ma can: zla ba nag po kha dug can: dus 'dzin gser gyi ska rags can: gzhan yang zhag dus 'khor ba sogs: gnam lo rgyal po zla ba blon: zhag de dmag mi dus tshod mtshon: spar sme sa 'dzin gnas bdag sogs: byams brtse'i sems kyis 'dir gshegs la: rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dang : gser skyems khri dkar stong nag sogs: gzugs 'gros yas stags sna tshogs 'bul: srid pa'i sde tshogs dgyes gyur nas: ro 'don gshin byed dur 'debs sogs: de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis: bya ba ci dang ci bgyis kyang : ko long sdoms la ru nga dang : phrag dog gdug sems ma 'chang bar: zhi bas bde legs phan sems kyis: snying rje'i bsam pa sgrub skyed la: phyogs kyi g.yo 'khrug zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ye dharmā dhartu ya bhūṃ mi pa ti ma ho rā ga bo dhi sam+bha ya bha wan+tu swā hā: srung bzhi 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i ye thog sku mkhar gyi: rim pa bcu gsum gong shed na: tshangs pa brgya byin sde tshogs la: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la bya khyung khra bo 'bul: khyung dmar gshog pa ma rdebs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa ye swā hā:

gnam gyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: steng phyogs su 'bul: hūm̐: shar phyogs shing gi sku mkhar nas: skyed byed shing gi mi bo cher: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la mtshal stag skya bo bsngo: stag skyas kha ni ma gdangs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ ra tri mu pa le ye swā hā: shar gyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar du 'bul: hūm̐: lho phyogs me yi sku mkhar nas: gso byed me yi mi bo cher: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la g.yu 'brug sngon mo bsngo: g.yu 'brug mjug ma ma g.yug cig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhurba tri sa ya sa ma ti swā hā: lho yi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lhor 'bul: hūm̐: nub phyogs lcags kyi sku mkhar nas: brtan pa lcags kyi mi bo cher: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la bya ni ze dmar bsngo: bya dmar gshog pa ma sprugs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhi bhu sa ha ti ta tri ye swā hā: nub kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub tu 'bul: hūm̐: byang phyogs chu yi sku mkhar nas: kun gso chu yi mi bo cher: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la rus sbal rgya bo bsngo: rus sbal rkan sgra ma rdebs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ saṃ bhak+ṣa ka taṃ dza ya swā hā: byang gi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang du 'bul: hūm̐: 'og phyogs sa yi sku mkhar nas: 'gyur med lha mo bstan ma cher: 'byung ba sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la phag dang bum pa 'bul: dur phag nag po ma 'khun cig: gnam lo sa bdag 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhū mi pa ti ya sa du ho swā hā: 'og gi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: 'og phyogs su 'bul: de nas shel tshig dang 'bru sna gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon rnams phyogs mtshams su rim bzhin 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: shar phyogs 'byung lnga'i stag yos dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod phur bu chen po dang : smin drug la sogs shar skar drug: spar sme gsum mthing zin la sogs: shing gi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar phyogs su 'bul: hūm̐: shar lho mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i 'brug: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod sgra gcan skar ma skag: spar sme bzhi ljang zon la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar lhor 'bul: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'byung lnga'i sbrul rta dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod nyi ma mig dmar dang : rta chen la sogs lho skar drug: spar sme dgu dmar li la sogs: me yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā:

lho ru 'bul: hūm̐: lho nub mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i lug: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod spen pa sa ga dang : spar sme gnyis nag khon la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lho nub tu 'bul: hūm̐: nub phyogs 'byung lnga'i sprel bya dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod pa wa sangs dang ni: snron la sogs te nub skar drug: spar sme dwa dang bdun dmar sogs: me yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub tu 'bul: ham̐'u: nub byang mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i khyi: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod mjug ring byi bzhin dang : spar sme drug dkar khen la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub byang du 'bul: hūm̐: byang phyogs 'byung lnga'i phag byi ba: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' mchog zla ba lhag pa dang : mon gre la sogs byang skar drug: spar sme gcig dkar khams la sogs: chu yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor:

gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang du 'bul: hūm̐: byang shar mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i glang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod rā hu skar bra nye: spar sme brgyad dkar ging la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang shar du 'bul: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dbus gnas pa'i: lo zlar 'khor ba'i sa bdag dang : gza' dang rgyu skar 'gyu ba sogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang : nyul le bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: mthun pa'i yas stags 'di bzhes la: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs shig: lha dang dpal du bskyed par gyis: ko long ru nga zhi ba dang : phrag dog gdug sems ma 'chang cig: oṃ ma ma kun ta shra bā ṇa ye swā hā: dbus su phul lo: de nas spar kha ho yi phyag rgya phyogs su bstan cing : sa bdag gi sgrib shing gtong ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe sangs rgyas bco ldan 'das: byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams gzigs: srid snang tshogs drug zil gyis mnan: snod kyi 'gyu ba phra rags bcom: 'byung lnga'i 'phro 'du dbang du bsdus: ye shes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis: lo zla snyoms shing dgra gshed zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: ye shes ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: de 'og bsam yas mchims phu ru: gtsug lag sa 'dul bgyis pa'i tshe: dregs 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:

rdo rje mi shigs phyag rgya yis: myang 'das snod bcud shugs las mnan: srid pa gsum gyi sgrib shing gdab: lha 'dres 'khrugs grol gdug rtsub zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: spar kha ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: 'byung ba kun gyi phrag dog rnams: srung ba 'di yis zhi gyur cig: lo yi dgra gshed bsal du gsol: oṃ shang shang shing shing dha rod dha la ma ru pa ye a par yang gyang ta shrī sarba e haṃ ya ti twa shud+dhe ho dzñā na badz+ra pañtsa ye swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra dang gshed kha dur kha bye ba thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: zhes pas phyogs su 'dzugs: snang brgyad snying po ni: oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a byi la maṇ+ḍa le maṇ+ḍa le swā hā: zhes ci nus bzla'o: mthar bkra shis brjod cing phrin las kyi bya ba gang dgos la 'jug go: 7 zhes pa 'di bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi zhi khro'i gzhung nas khol du phyung zhing cung zad kha sab 'os 'dug pa rang blos brgyan te/ bdag ngag dbang dkon mchog bstan rgyal gyis sbyar bas/ nyes mchis rtsa gsum chos srung gter bdag tshogs la bshags shing*/ dge ba'i cha mchis ris med 'gro la bsngo/ sarba maṅga laṃ// sha) phyag rgya chen po ye shes mthong grol las: bdun tshig gnas lung gi cho ga ye shes 'od phung bzhugs so : bde gshegs zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: gang zhig dal 'byor mi yi lus blangs kyang : yang dag mchog gi lam la ma zhugs sam: las kyi dbang gi tshe yi dus byas pa: sgrib sbyong rigs drug gnas nas 'dren pa'i thabs: ye shes 'od phung pad+ma dbang gi bkod: de la dngos grub bsnyen pa'i bla ma yis: zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang : rjes su bzung byin rus bu mtshon byang sogs: dri bstan dang bcas lho yi phyogs su dgod: steng du dar gdugs phyogs bzhir 'phan dar brtag: sgrub rdzas dbang rdzas sbyang khrus yo byad bsham:

las kyi gzhung bsang mchod bstod spro bsdu bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la: thugs rje'i gzugs yul chaig de: gson po'i cha lugs rim bzhin gsal: bar do'i gnas nas gshegs par 'gugs: bden pa brdar zhing rten la bzhugs: kyai ma: nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: 'byung bzhi byer sdud lus kyi phung po 'khor: gces pa'i gnyen bral ser sna'i nor rdzas lus: yid lus rten bca' bag chags 'khrul phyir bying : dbang med 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lag tu tshud: 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can 'dir shog la: bla ma slob dpon ma yengs dran par gyis: gdung shugs drag pos rigs drug gar gnas kyang : rtsa bral shugs kyis thogs med 'dir shog la: mtshan byang rnam shes 'di la dbang med phob: chaig mo nṛ dza dzaḥ kyaiḥ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: zhing 'dir bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dal: mos gus gdung bas gsol ba thob: 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'dren pa yi: khyod kyi bla ma nga yin pas: las nyon sdig sgrib sbyangs pa la: dga' dang gus pa'i bsam pa skyed: mos shing gdung ba'i brtan par bzhugs: pad+ma kā ma la ye satwaṃ: kyaiḥ tshe 'das 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis: srid pa'i grong la bskor bskor nas: lus ngag yid gsum chad cing dub: ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung : lus ngag yid gsum bde bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis chab kyis bran: 'gal rkyen gshed dang phral ba ni: kyeḥ nyon cig bgegs dang lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: gson la bdud dang gshin la lcags pa dang : srog gcod bla khyer gshed mar gyur pa kun: mchod sbyin 'dod yon glud gtor 'di khyer la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro thar pa'i bgegs byed na: ye shes 'bar ba'i pho nya'i mtshon tshogs kyis: stong khams gang bas bgegs tshogs rdul du rlog: sum+bha nis bskrad: rten la gu gul bdug:

thun gyis brab cing srung mtshams bcad: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la skyabs gsol sgrib pa sbyang ba ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: dam chos ma lus 'dus pa'i gsung : chos dbyings skye med rnam dag thugs: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: tshad med thugs rje'i shugs phyu+ung bden stobs skyed: dbus phyogs mthing gsal rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing : thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor tshom bu 'bum phrag lnga: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: rnam shes nam mkha'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: me long ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar gsal rnam par snang mdzad zhing : sku yi dkyil 'khor tshom bu 'bum phrag lnga: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: gzugs phung sa yi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: chos dbyings ye shes rnam dag don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: lho phyogs ser gsal rin chen 'byung ldan zhing : yon tan dkyil 'khor tshom bu 'bum phrag lnga: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: tshor chung chu yi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: nub phyogs dmar gsal snang ba mtha' yas zhing : gsung gi dkyil 'khor tshom bu 'bum phrag lnga: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: 'du shes me yi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: byang phyogs ljang gsal don yod grub pa'i zhing : phrin las dkyil 'khor tshom bu 'bum phrag lnga:

gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: 'du byed rlung gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: lhun grub rang gsal bde ba chen po'i zhing : 'dus ma byas pa khyab bdag chos kyi sku: kun bzang yab yub gsal stong bde stong ngang : gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: yid chos shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: klong chen ye shes dbyings grol don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: phyogs mtshams rang gsal sems dpa' sems ma'i zhing : rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshom bu brgyad khri bcas: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi nas: sgo ba yab yum bka' sdod pho nya bcas: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: rtag chad mtshan 'dzin sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: rang byung rig pa gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: ka dag nam mkhas khyab pa'i klong chen po: kun bzang yab yum lhun grub thugs rje'i 'od: bde gshegs zhi ba'i rang mdangs 'od zer las: 'bar ba'i khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor rab 'byams la: ye shes rang gsal byang sems 'od 'phros pas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: rang rig byang chub sems kyi don rtogs shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: mkhyen brtse'i ye shes rgyas pa'i klong yangs nas:

'gro drug rgyud sbyong bcom ldan thub pa drug: gang 'dul phrin las ma 'dres gsal rdzogs su: tshe 'das thugs rjes bzung zhing skyabs su gsol: hūm̐: zhe sdang spangs pas mgo nag khro bo'i tshul: bzod pa'i tshul ston me chu khram shing bsnams: dmyal ba'i thub pas srid pa'i me long ston: dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: om̐ mu ne ye swā hā: da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tum hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: ser sna spangs pas drang srong khro bo'i tshul: sbyin pa'i tshul ston dbul phongs thal bar 'joms: yi dwags thub pas yid bzhin re ba skong : yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: oṃ mu ne triṃ swā hā: pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tum hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: gti mug spangs pas gzugs mdzes 'phags pa'i sku: shes rab chen pos ma rigs mun pa sel: byol song thub pas shes rab pu sti bsnams: byol song glen lkugs sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hā: ma thā ma thā sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tum hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: 'dod chags nyon mongs spangs pas tshul khrims ldan: brtson 'grus chos ston le lo rnam par dag: mi yi thub pas gseg shang par bu bsnams: mi yi brel phongs sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: oṃ mu ne truṃ swā hā: nṛ bi shwa mu la tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: phrag dog spangs pas lha min thub pa ste: tshul khrims chos ston khong khro'i bag chags sbyang : stobs mchog rtsal ldan dpal bskyed go cha can: khro gtum 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: oṃ mu ne kreṃ swā hā: glo sha khaḍ+ga hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nga rgyal kun spangs lha yi gzugs 'dzin cing : bsam gtan chos ston nga rgyal bag chags sbyangs: lha yi thub pa brgya byin pi waṃ bsnams: 'pho ltung bzod dka'i sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: oṃ mu ne k+ṣaṃ swā hā: dā+e wa tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ

hūm̐: khams gsum rigs drug srid pa'i steng 'og nas: gdul bya gang la gang 'dul thugs rje can: ye shes rol pa'i phrin las rab 'byams kyis: 'gro drug dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: nirma ka ya sarba sa twa a su nṛ tri pre du sarba pā paṃ da ha bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas rigs drug gis gnas nas dbyung ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: zhe sdang dbang gis dmyal bar skyes: tsha grang sdug bsngal ya re nga : ser sna'i dbang gis yi dwags skyes: bkres phongs sdug bsngal yi re mug: gti mug dbang gis byol song skyes: glen lkugs sdug bsngal mun re nag: 'dod chags dbang gi mi ru skyes: 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yi re ngal: phrag dog dbang gi lha min skyes: 'thab rtsod sdu bsngal dbal re tsha: nga rgyal dbang gis lha ru skyes: 'pho ltung sdug bsngal nyam re thag: 'khor ba'i gling na bde ba med: 'gro drug gnas nas 'dir shog cig: skyabs gsol thugs rje'i mchog gis bzung : a su nṛ tri pre du dza dzaḥ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bzhag go: de na sdig sgrib bkru ba ni: ming byang gzugs la me long phyar: hūm̐: rang bzhin bkra shis bum pa nas: ting 'dzin brgyad ldan dag byed khrus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: dug lnga'i dri ma dag gyur cig: ye shes lnga dang ldan par shog: oṃ ru lu? sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra na bi shud+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs mchog gsal dag rdo rje sems: me long ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: zhe sdang sgrib pa yongs dag nas: tsha grang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra na bi shud+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku mchog mi 'gyur rnam par snang :

chos dbyings ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: gti mug sgrib pa yongs dag nas: glen lkugs sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: oṃ bai ro tsa na oṃ: sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra na bi shud+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung mchog bde chen snang mtha' yas: sor rtogs ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: 'dod chags sgrib pa yongs dag nas: bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra na bi shud+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: phrin las lhun grub don yod grub: bya grub ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: phrag dog sgrib pa yongs dag nas: 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: oṃ ā mo gha āḥ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra na bi shud+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: yon tan lhun grub rin chen 'byung : mnyam nyid ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: nga rgyal sgrib pa yongs dag nas: 'pho ltung sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: oṃ rat+na saṃ bha trām̐: sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra na bi shud+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku lnga lhun grub de bzhin gshegs: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i chus: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: bag chags sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha na ye shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba karma a wa ra na bi shud+dhe swā hā:

smon lam ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: ye shes pha rol phyin drug chus: nyon mongs dug lnga rnam dag pas: 'gro drug sdug bsngal kun dag nas: phar phyin drug ldan ye shes gsal: byang chub lam bgrod sangs rgyas shog: de nas rgyud drug dug sbyang ni: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'od zer gyis: gnas drug rigs drug sa bon bsreg: sku lnga ye shes rdzogs par dmigs: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ a su nṛ tri pre du sarba pā paṃ da ha na shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla zhing til dang bye mas brab: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: las las skyes shing las la brten: las kyi tshe 'phos snying rje'i yul: skyabs bral mgon med sems can khyod: dug lnga'i bag chags a 'thas pas: rigs drug gnas su 'khyams pa la: ye shes rgyal ba rigs mchog lnga'i: thugs rje byams pa'i 'od zer gyis: dug lnga yongs su sbyong bar mdzad: sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom nas: dug bral ye shes lnga ldan shog: sngags dang bcas te brab par bya: de nas tshogs bsags lan chags sbyang : dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis brlab: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan gyi: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsngo yis: mtho ba srid pa'i rtse mo nas: dma' ba na raka yan chod kyi: khams gsum 'gro drug sems can la: so so'i longs spyod ldan gyur nas: tshe 'das bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shing : chos kyi longs spyod mi zad pas: 'gro ba sems can don byed shog: de nas chos bshad brten bca' ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: 'tsho ba'i tshe zad khyod nyid 'dir nyams te: kun kyang mi rtag 'chi ba'i chos can yin: shes pa bar dor yud kyis 'khyams pa la: skyabs med mgon med dpung gnyan zad pa'i tshe: dkyil 'khor lha dang slob dpon dran par gyis: mos gus dag snang bskyed pa'i dus yin no:

rin chen pho brang yid 'ong bskyed pa'i gnas: gdugs chen 'di ni gzhal yas bla rten yin: mtshan byang 'di ni lus kyi bla rten yin: snyug ma tshig drug srog gi bla rten yin: rin chen 'phan ldan rgyan gos bla rten yin: dwangs gsal me long sems kyi bla rten yin: dar zab pad+ma sdod pa'i bla rten yin: dri gos nor rdzas bag chags bla rten yin: dar thag sna lnga lam gyi bla rten yin: sgrib med 'od gsal mar mes shul mtshon pa'i: stegs bu 'di la rnam shes rten chos la: dkyil 'khor lha la sgo gsum ltos med 'bul: phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis gus pas gsol ba thob: ces pas thugs rjes sam ni mched lcam dang : tshe 'das yid du 'ong ba'i mi zhig gis: mtshan byang thogs la phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: de ltar nyin zhag drug tu thun bzhi ru: bkrus sbyang phyag 'tshal bshags pa tshogs bskang sogs: dong sprugs bzhin du phrin las rdzogs par byang : zhag grangs bdun nam brgyad kyi bar: 'bad pas tshe 'das sdig pa dag pa'i rtags: grol ba'i mtshan ma byung na dkyil 'khor bzhag: kyaiḥ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med: ngan song sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab: brten pa'i sems kyi gnas 'dir byon: zhing 'di 'og min chos kyi dbyings: zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du: khyod kyi sgo gsum smin par bya: ye shes lnga grol gdeng ldan pa'i: kun bzang sa la 'khod par gyur: dga' 'o skyid do bde bar gshegs: ye shes gsal ba'i gdan la bzhugs: pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: zhes rgyun du brtse ba'i nye du yi: dri ldan mtshan byang bzung nas dkyil 'khor la: gus phyag bya zhing dbang rnams bskur: mtshan byang dkyil 'khor gzhung dang nyin gcig gam: zhag bdun gyi bar du gzhung bsrang : longs spyod kyi gos zas gtad: de ltar mchod pa'i nub mo tho rangs khar: 'gro drug sgo bgag 'khor rgyun 'brel pa bcad:

kyeḥ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'dis bcad pa man chod nas: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sa yin pas: rigs drug gnas la bde ba med: bor cig spongs shig rigs kyi bu: dmyal ba tsha grang sdug re bsngal: yi dwags bkres skom 'phang rab dmugs: dud 'gro blun zhing rmongs pa myong : lha min 'thab rtsod snying re 'dar: lha rnams pham ltung nyams re thag: mi rnams brel phongs 'gyur ba mang : 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rang bzhin la: ma chags ma zhen rigs kyi bu: skye 'chi 'khor ba'i rgyun chod cig: de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i phyir: byang chub chen po'i lam bstan pa ni: kyaiḥ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: sa 'dis bcad pa yan chod nas: bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams yin: chos sku rtog bral nam mkha' la: longs sku ye shes 'od zer 'bar: sprul sku 'gags med so sor gsal: bcom ldan kun bzang yab yum la: rigs lnga byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: srid pa sbyor ba yongs su zad: rnam grol bde ba'i dngos grub mnyes: zhing gi yon tan bsam mi khyab: bu khyod de ru lam bstan pas: kun bzang zhi khro'i mtshan bzung la: 'ja' zer 'od lnga'i lam nas gshegs: zhing mchog de ru 'gro bar gyis: zhes pas lam bstan par byas te mi ldog pa'i sar 'god phyir: skye med chos kyi dbyings su bstim pa ni: kyaiḥ rtog pas 'khrul ba'i sems can la: skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad: sems nyid stong pa'i ngo bo la: skye dang 'chi ba ma dmigs pas: skye 'chi bral ba'i gdengs thob nas: khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyun chad 'gyur: rigs kyi bu khyod de rtogs na: skye 'chi 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chod: rnam dag bde ba chen por bzhugs: a āḥ zhes pas mnyam par bzhag: chos nyid mi g.yo brtan pa'i phyir: bden pa'i smon lam 'debs pa ni: e maḥ tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : lha dang slob dpon thugs rje yis: ngan song gsum po'i rgyun bcad nas:

mtho ris bde chen gnas su drangs: sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje dang : dam chos bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs dang : dge 'dun bden pa'i sngags kyi mthus: ngan song gsum gyi sgo bkag nas: mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phyes te: sems la skye 'chi med pas na: byang chub snying po ma thob bar: sa lam bar chad kun grol te: sangs rgyas sa la phyin par shog: de nas mtshan byang bsreg pa ni: kye hūm̐: dug gsum rnam dag hoṃ khung du: ye shes gsal ba'i me sbar nas: tshe 'das dug lnga'i bag chags bsregs: rang snang rtog pas rang 'od la: rang byung ye shes me sbar nas: nyon mongs bag chags thams cad bsregs: bya rtsol med par ye sangs rgyas: 'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub: ye shes lha dang gnyis su med: sprul sku'i 'gro don spyod par shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ dzñā na badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes sreg thal ba sāts+tsha gdab cing gshegs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa gtong ba dang : dal bsdus dkyil 'khor bsngo smon gzhung bzhin bya: shul phyags me chus gtsang sbra dang : brten pa bu gcig rgyud rgyal lan gsum dang : logs bder bkra shis brtsegs pa tshar gcig sgrog: rmad byung rten 'brel dge bas shi sgab bcad: tshe 'das de la dbang skal zas dang nor: sdig dang ma 'dres dge ba'i rtsa bar bsngo: de yis tshe 'das sgrib pa kun byang nas: ngan song las thar thar pa'i lam du zhugs: gsang sngags bden pas mtho ris gnas su 'gro: dam log mtshams med spyad kyang ngan song khegs: nges par lam du zhugs na rang bzhin grol: de phyir skyabs med bar do'i sems can la: rten 'brel mtshams sbyar myur lam 'di kho na: ma 'ongs las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: thugs mchog rdo rjes rgyud 'khrugs pa bsdebs/ lung gcus pa bsrangs/
man ngag gab pa yongs su phyung ba'o/ /dge'o maṅga laṃ shu bhaṃ// //
